short_description.id: Abasy adalah iblis dalam mitologi Sakha (Yakut) yang menghuni dunia bawah, digambarkan sebagai monster bermata satu yang menunggang naga.
short_description.en: The abasy are demons of Sakha (Yakut) mythology who live in the underworld, described as one-eyed monsters riding dragons.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi orang Sakha atau Yakut, abasy adalah iblis yang menempati lapisan bawah alam semesta, "kerajaan kegelapan". Mereka konon roh orang yang sudah lama meninggal, tinggal dekat kuburan atau tempat sepi, dan melayani Arson-Duolai, penguasa orang mati yang menelan jiwa dan menyebarkan penyakit. Abasy dapat ditenangkan dengan persembahan darah.
long_description.en: In the mythology of the Sakha or Yakuts, the abasy are demons who occupy the lower level of the universe, the "kingdom of darkness". They are said to be spirits of the long dead, living near graves or in deserted places, and serve Arson-Duolai, ruler of the dead, who swallows souls and spreads disease. The abasy can be appeased with blood sacrifices.

long_description.id: Mereka digambarkan sebagai raksasa bergigi besi, bermata, berlengan, dan berkaki satu, yang menunggang naga berkepala dua dan bepergian dalam kelompok tujuh. Dalam epos Olonkho mereka pemakan manusia, dipimpin raksasa besi berkepala tiga, Alyp Khara Aat Mogoidoon. Ungkapan Yakut "melihat abaasy" berarti membenci.
long_description.en: They are pictured as iron-toothed giants with one eye, one arm and one leg, riding two-headed dragons and travelling in groups of seven. In the Olonkho epics they are man-eaters led by the three-headed iron giant Alyp Khara Aat Mogoidoon. The Yakut phrase "to see abaasy" means to hate.

role.en: Servants of the ruler of the dead.

famous_for.en: One-eyed and riding dragons.

short_description.id: Adar Llwch Gwin adalah burung legenda dalam tradisi Wales yang sangat besar dan cerdas, sering dikaitkan dengan griffin, milik pejuang Drudwas ap Tryffin.
short_description.en: The Adar Llwch Gwin are legendary birds of Welsh tradition, very large and intelligent and often linked with the griffin, belonging to the warrior Drudwas ap Tryffin.

long_description.id: Adar Llwch Gwin adalah makhluk legenda dalam tradisi Wales (Welsh) yang digambarkan sebagai burung-burung sangat besar dan cerdas, sering dianggap berkerabat dengan griffin. Burung-burung itu diberikan kepada pejuang bernama Drudwas ap Tryffin oleh istri perinya. Namanya berasal dari kata Wales adar ("burung"), llwch ("debu"), dan gwin ("anggur"). Mereka konon memahami bahasa manusia dan mematuhi perintah apa pun dari tuannya.
long_description.en: The Adar Llwch Gwin are legendary beings of Welsh tradition, pictured as huge, clever birds often thought related to the griffin. The warrior Drudwas ap Tryffin received them as a gift from his fairy wife. The name comes from the Welsh adar ('bird'), llwch ('dust') and gwin ('wine'). They were said to understand human speech and obey any command their master gave.

long_description.id: Ketika Drudwas hendak bertarung dengan Arthur, ia memerintahkan burung-burung itu membunuh orang pertama yang memasuki medan perang; namun Arthur terlambat, dan burung-burung itu menyerang Drudwas sendiri ketika ia masuk lebih dulu, lalu mencabiknya. Dalam puisi Wales abad pertengahan kemudian, frasa Adar Llwch Gwin dipakai untuk segala jenis burung pemangsa termasuk elang dan alap-alap, juga untuk orang pemberani. Menurut legenda, burung-burung itu menyanyikan sebuah lagu untuk meratapi kematian tuannya, liriknya dikaitkan dengan Llywarch Hen. Menurut artikel br, mereka adalah burung roh (evned speredek) yang sering dibandingkan dengan griffin dalam mitologi Britania.
long_description.en: When Drudwas was about to fight Arthur he ordered the birds to kill the first man to enter the battle; but Arthur was delayed, and the birds turned on Drudwas himself as he stepped onto the field first, tearing him apart. In later medieval Welsh poetry the phrase Adar Llwch Gwin came to mean all birds of prey, hawks and falcons included, and brave men too. Legend says the birds sang a song mourning their master's death, its words attributed to Llywarch Hen. According to the br article they are spirit birds (evned speredek) often likened to the griffin in British myth.

famous_for.en: Understand human speech.

did_you_know.id: Adar Llwch Gwin mencabik tuannya sendiri, Drudwas, karena ia yang pertama memasuki medan perang yang ia perintahkan untuk diserang.
did_you_know.en: The Adar Llwch Gwin tore apart their own master, Drudwas, because he was first onto the battlefield he had told them to attack.

short_description.id: Adar Rhiannon ("burung-burung Rhiannon") adalah tiga burung ajaib dalam Mabinogi yang nyanyiannya dapat membangunkan orang mati dan menidurkan yang hidup.
short_description.en: The Adar Rhiannon ('birds of Rhiannon') are three magic birds of the Mabinogi, able with their song to rouse the dead and send the living to sleep.

long_description.id: Dalam cerita prosa tertua Britania, Mabinogi, Adar Rhiannon atau "burung-burung Rhiannon" adalah tiga burung ajaib yang nyanyiannya dapat "membangunkan orang mati dan menidurkan yang hidup". Mereka juga memengaruhi ruang secara ganjil: bisa berada jauh tetapi terdengar sangat dekat. Mereka dikaitkan dengan Rhiannon, Ratu Dyfed, yang dianggap dewi kuda Britania yang telah dimanusiakan.
long_description.en: In Britain's oldest prose tales, the Mabinogi, the Adar Rhiannon or 'birds of Rhiannon' are three magic birds whose singing is said to raise the dead and put the living to sleep. They bend space strangely, seeming close at hand while far away. They are tied to Rhiannon, Queen of Dyfed, thought to be a British horse goddess made human in the tales.

long_description.id: Dalam Culhwch and Olwen, raksasa Ysbaddaden Bencawr menuntut burung-burung itu sebagai salah satu tugas pernikahan Culhwch, agar menghiburnya pada malam terakhir hidupnya. Dalam cabang kedua Mabinogi, Branwen ferch Llŷr, tujuh orang yang selamat dari perang dengan Irlandia berpesta di Harlech selama tujuh tahun ajaib sambil dihibur tiga burung Rhiannon; terjemahan Lady Guest menyebut burung-burung itu tampak jauh di atas laut tetapi terdengar jelas seolah dekat.
long_description.en: In Culhwch and Olwen the giant Ysbaddaden Bencawr demands the birds as one of Culhwch's bridal tasks, to soothe him on the last night of his life. In the Mabinogi's second branch, Branwen ferch Llŷr, the seven survivors of the war with Ireland feast at Harlech for seven enchanted years to the song of the three birds; Lady Guest's translation says they seemed far off over the sea yet sounded as clear as if close by.

famous_for.en: Sang at Harlech.

short_description.id: Aitvaras adalah roh alam dalam mitologi Lituania, berwujud ayam jantan berekor api, yang menetap di rumah dan membawa emas serta gandum curian.
short_description.en: Aitvaras is a nature spirit of Lithuanian mythology, shaped like a rooster with a fiery tail, which settles in a house and brings stolen gold and grain.

long_description.id: Aitvaras adalah roh alam dalam mitologi Lituania, dikenal juga dengan nama lain seperti Pūkis, Damavykas, dan Spirukas, dan identik dengan Pūķis dari Latvia. Ia tampak seperti ayam jantan putih atau hitam dengan ekor menyala seperti meteor; di luar rumah ia sering digambarkan sebagai burung berpenampilan naga. Jika mati, ia berubah menjadi percikan api.
long_description.en: Aitvaras is a nature spirit of Lithuanian mythology, also known by names such as Pūkis, Damavykas and Spirukas, and identical to the Latvian Pūķis. It looks like a white or black rooster with a meteor-like fiery tail; outdoors it is often described as a bird with a dragon's appearance. When it dies it becomes a spark.

long_description.id: Aitvaras bergerak dengan terbang, umumnya berapi, tetapi dapat berubah rupa. Ia menetap di sebuah rumah dan biasanya menolak pergi, membawa keberuntungan sekaligus kesialan bagi penghuninya: ia memasok emas dan gandum curian, yang sering menyeret keluarga itu ke dalam masalah. Jika dibuat marah, ia membakar rumah.
long_description.en: The aitvaras moves by flying, is usually fiery, but can change its appearance. It lodges in a house and mostly refuses to leave, bringing both good and bad luck to the household: it supplies stolen gold and grain, often landing the family in trouble. If angered, it burns the house down.

long_description.id: Makhluk ini pertama kali disebut pada 1547 oleh Martynas Mažvydas. Sumber berbeda soal asal-usulnya: satu menyebutnya menetas dari telur ayam jantan berumur 9 hingga 15 tahun, sementara sumber lain menyebut telur ayam jantan berumur tujuh tahun atau buah zakar kuda jantan hitam. Menurut banyak sumber, aitvaras dapat dibeli dari iblis dengan menukar jiwa pembelinya.
long_description.en: The being was first mentioned in 1547 by Martynas Mažvydas. Sources differ on its origin: one says it hatches from the egg of a rooster aged 9 to 15 years, another from the egg of a seven-year-old rooster or the testicle of a black stallion. According to many sources an aitvaras could be bought from the devil in exchange for the buyer's soul.

short_description.id: Ala adalah iblis perempuan cuaca buruk dalam folklor Bulgaria, Makedonia, dan Serbia, yang menggiring awan badai berisi hujan es ke ladang untuk merusak panen.
short_description.en: The ala is a female demon of bad weather in Bulgarian, Macedonian and Serbian folklore who drives hail-bearing storm clouds over fields to ruin the crops.

long_description.id: Ala (jamak ale) adalah makhluk mitologis perempuan dalam cerita rakyat orang Bulgaria, Makedonia, dan Serbia. Ia dianggap iblis cuaca buruk yang tugas utamanya menggiring awan guntur pembawa hujan es ke ladang, kebun anggur, atau kebun buah untuk menghancurkan atau menjarah hasil panen. Ale juga sangat rakus: mereka gemar memangsa anak-anak, bahkan dipercaya mencoba menelan Matahari atau Bulan sehingga terjadi gerhana, dan dunia akan kiamat jika mereka berhasil.
long_description.en: The ala (plural ale) is a female mythical being in the folk tradition of Bulgarians, Macedonians and Serbs. She is held to be a demon of bad weather whose chief task is to steer hail-bearing thunderclouds over fields, vineyards or orchards to ruin or plunder the harvest. Ale are also ravenous: they like to devour children and are even believed to try swallowing the Sun or Moon, causing eclipses, and the world would end should they succeed.

long_description.id: Wujud ala digambarkan beragam dan sering samar: angin hitam, makhluk raksasa tak berbentuk jelas, monster bermulut besar yang mirip manusia atau ular, naga betina, atau burung gagak. Ia juga bisa mengambil berbagai rupa manusia atau hewan dan merasuki tubuh seseorang. Keragaman ini diduga karena ala merupakan perpaduan iblis cuaca buruk Slavia dengan iblis serupa dari penduduk pra-Slavia di Balkan tengah. Ale dikatakan tinggal di awan, danau, mata air, tempat terpencil, hutan, gunung yang tak ramah, gua, atau pohon raksasa.
long_description.en: The ala's form is described in many, often vague ways: a black wind, a huge creature of unclear shape, a big-mouthed humanlike or snakelike monster, a she-dragon, or a raven. She may also take various human or animal shapes and possess a person's body. This variety is thought to come from the ala being a blend of a Slavic bad-weather demon with a similar demon of the pre-Slavic people of the central Balkans. Ale are said to live in clouds, lakes, springs, remote hidden spots, forests, harsh mountains, caves or giant trees.

long_description.id: Bertemu ala membahayakan kesehatan jiwa dan raga, bahkan nyawa, tetapi kebaikannya bisa diperoleh bila ia didekati dengan hormat dan percaya; ia membuat orang kesayangannya kaya dan menyelamatkan mereka saat kesulitan. Musuh-musuhnya yang kuat adalah naga; dalam kisah yang sudah dikristenkan, Santo Elia mengambil peran naga, dan elang juga dipandang sebagai pelindung yang mengusir ala dari ladang. Dalam tradisi Bulgaria, badai dan awan hujan es ditafsirkan sebagai pertempuran antara naga atau elang yang baik melawan ala yang jahat.
long_description.en: Meeting an ala endangers mind, body and even life, yet her favour can be won by approaching her with respect and trust; she makes her favourites rich and saves them in hard times. Her mighty foes are dragons; in Christianized tales Saint Elijah takes the dragons' place, and eagles too are seen as defenders that drive ale from the fields. In Bulgarian tradition, every thunderstorm or hail cloud was understood as a fight in which a benevolent dragon or eagle confronts the wicked ala.

long_description.id: Asal nama ala diperdebatkan. Beberapa kamus menurunkannya dari kata Turki ala, "ular", sedangkan pendapat lain mengaitkannya dengan kata Yunani untuk hujan es, χάλαζα; menurut Marta Bjeletić, ala dan hala berasal dari kata Proto-Slavia Selatan *xala, dari akar yang menandakan amukan unsur-unsur alam. Banyak orang juga menganggap ala saudara perempuan naga, dan orang Serbia di Kosovo percaya bahwa siapa pun yang melihat kepalanya langsung menjadi gila.
long_description.en: The origin of the name ala is disputed. Some dictionaries derive it from the Turkish ala, "snake", while another view ties it to the Greek word for hail, χάλαζα; according to Marta Bjeletić, ala and hala come from Proto-South-Slavic *xala, from a root meaning the fury of the elements. Many also hold that the ala is the dragon's sister, and Serbs in Kosovo believed that anyone who saw her head went instantly mad.

short_description.id: Alerion adalah burung heraldik elang tanpa paruh dan cakar, dan dalam bestiari abad pertengahan burung mitis yang hanya sepasang hidup pada satu waktu dan menenggelamkan diri setelah telurnya menetas.
short_description.en: The alerion is a heraldic eagle without beak or claws, and in medieval bestiaries a mythical bird of which only one pair lives at a time, drowning itself once its eggs hatch.

long_description.id: Alerion atau avalerion awalnya istilah heraldik untuk elang, lalu untuk anak elang yang digambarkan tanpa paruh dan cakar; tiga alerion menghiasi lambang Lorraine sejak abad ke-13, konon terilhami kisah Godefroy dari Bouillon yang memanah tiga anak elang putih. Asal katanya mungkin dari bahasa Jerman Adler, "elang".
long_description.en: Alerion or avalerion was first a heraldic term for an eagle, then for an eaglet shown without beak or claws; three alerions have adorned the arms of Lorraine since the 13th century, supposedly from a tale of Godfrey of Bouillon shooting three white eaglets. The word may come from German Adler, 'eagle'.

long_description.id: Dalam bestiari abad pertengahan alerion adalah burung mitis sedikit lebih besar dari elang yang hanya sepasang hidup pada satu waktu; mereka bertelur dua butir setiap 60 tahun dan menenggelamkan diri setelah telur menetas. Peta Hereford menempatkannya dekat Hydaspes dan Indus.
long_description.en: In medieval bestiaries the alerion is a mythical bird somewhat larger than an eagle, of which only one pair lives at a time; they lay two eggs every 60 years and drown themselves once these hatch. The Hereford Map places it near the Hydaspes and the Indus.

famous_for.en: The three alerions of Lorraine.

description.id: Peta abad pertengahan yang mencantumkan avalerion.
description.en: The medieval map naming the avalerion.

claims.quote: Alerion (sometimes known as Avalerion) is a term for a heraldic bird. Historically, it referred to the regular heraldic eagle. Later, heralds used the term alerion to refer to "baby eagles" or "eaglets".

statement.id: Alerion (kadang Avalerion) adalah istilah untuk burung heraldik; awalnya merujuk elang heraldik biasa, lalu dipakai para ahli heraldik untuk "anak elang".
statement.en: Alerion (sometimes Avalerion) is a term for a heraldic bird; it first meant the ordinary heraldic eagle and later 'eaglets'.

claims.quote: To differentiate them from mature eagles, alerions were shown as an eagle displayed inverted without a beak or claws (disarmed).

statement.id: Untuk membedakannya dari elang dewasa, alerion digambarkan sebagai elang tanpa paruh dan cakar.
statement.en: To distinguish them from mature eagles, alerions were shown as eagles without beak or claws.

claims.quote: Medieval bestiaries use alerion for a mythological bird described as somewhat larger than an eagle of which only a single pair was said to live at any time. A pair of eggs was laid every 60 years; after hatching, the parents drowned themselves.

statement.id: Bestiari abad pertengahan memakai nama alerion untuk burung mitologis yang sedikit lebih besar dari elang, yang hanya sepasang hidup pada satu waktu; mereka bertelur dua butir setiap 60 tahun, dan setelah telur menetas induknya menenggelamkan diri.
statement.en: Medieval bestiaries use alerion for a mythological bird somewhat larger than an eagle, of which only one pair lived at a time; they laid two eggs every 60 years, and after hatching the parents drowned themselves.

claims.quote: The term avalerion is used on the Hereford Map near the Hydaspes and the Indus, possibly based on a description by Pliny.

statement.id: Nama avalerion tercantum pada Peta Hereford dekat sungai Hydaspes dan Indus, mungkin berdasarkan deskripsi Plinius.
statement.en: The term avalerion appears on the Hereford Map near the Hydaspes and the Indus, possibly from a description by Pliny.

claims.quote: An example is the arms of the Duchy of Lorraine (or, on a bend gules, 3 alerions abaisé argent). It supposedly had been inspired by the assumed arms of crusader Geoffrey de Bouillon, according to a tale that he killed three white eaglets with a bow and arrow when out hunting.

statement.id: Contohnya lambang Kadipaten Lorraine dengan tiga alerion perak, yang konon terilhami kisah tentara salib Godefroy dari Bouillon yang memanah tiga anak elang putih saat berburu.
statement.en: An example is the arms of the Duchy of Lorraine with three silver alerions, said to be inspired by a tale that the crusader Godfrey of Bouillon shot three white eaglets while hunting.

claims.quote: The word's ultimate origin is unclear, possibly adapted from the German Adler or Adelar ("eagle"). It is found in 12th-century French as alérion and in medieval Latin as alariōnem (a large eagle-like bird).

statement.id: Asal katanya tidak jelas, mungkin dari bahasa Jerman Adler atau Adelar, "elang"; dalam bahasa Prancis abad ke-12 alérion dan Latin abad pertengahan alariōnem.
statement.en: The word's origin is unclear, perhaps from German Adler or Adelar, 'eagle'; it appears in 12th-century French as alérion and in medieval Latin as alariōnem.

claims.quote: Alerion atau avalerion adalah burung mitologis. Menurut geografer dan ahli hewan buas abad Pertengahan, wujudnya "agak kecil, tetapi lebih besar daripada elang" dan hidup di dekat Hydaspes dan Indus

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Indonesia juga menyebut alerion burung mitologis yang menurut ahli geografi dan bestiari abad pertengahan sedikit lebih besar dari elang dan hidup dekat Hydaspes dan Indus.
statement.en: The Indonesian article also calls the alerion a mythological bird that medieval geographers and bestiarists placed near the Hydaspes and Indus, somewhat larger than an eagle.

claims.quote: Als Wappen Lothringens erscheint sie seit dem 13. Jahrhundert häufig zu dritt auf rotem Schrägbalken.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Jerman, alerion sejak abad ke-13 sering muncul bertiga pada pita miring merah dalam lambang Lorraine.
statement.en: According to the German article, since the 13th century the alerion has often appeared in threes on a red bend in the arms of Lorraine.

short_description.id: Alkonost adalah burung legendaris berkepala perempuan dalam cerita rakyat Rusia, pasangan sekaligus kebalikan dari burung Sirin, dan melambangkan kebahagiaan.
short_description.en: The Alkonost is a legendary woman-headed bird of Russian folklore, the companion and opposite of the Sirin bird, symbolising happiness.

long_description.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Rusia, Alkonost adalah burung berkepala perempuan yang selalu dipasangkan dengan Sirin. Alkonost mewakili hal-hal baik seperti kebahagiaan dan surga, sedangkan Sirin mewakili bencana dan kemalangan; meski begitu, keduanya dikaitkan dengan meramalkan atau mendatangkan kematian. Alkonost dikatakan tinggal di Rai, tempat orang mati, dan menurut sumber lain berdiam di sungai surgawi Efrat. Sebuah sumber menyebut makhluk ini bersikap baik kepada manusia, berbeda dengan Sirin.
long_description.en: In Russian folklore the Alkonost is a woman-headed bird always paired with the Sirin. The Alkonost stands for good things such as happiness and paradise, while the Sirin stands for disaster and misfortune; yet both are linked with foretelling or bringing death. The Alkonost is said to live in Rai, where the dead dwell, and another source places it on the paradise river Euphrates. One source says it is well disposed towards people, unlike the Sirin.

long_description.id: Nyanyiannya begitu indah sehingga siapa pun yang mendengarnya melupakan segala hal. Alkonost bertelur di pantai lalu menggulirkan telurnya ke laut; selama telur itu berada di air, laut tenang, tetapi saat menetas timbul badai dahsyat. Menurut cerita rakyat, pada pesta apel Juru Selamat Sirin menangis di kebun apel pada pagi hari, lalu Alkonost datang sore harinya dengan gembira dan mengibaskan embun dari sayapnya sehingga buah di pohon tempatnya bertengger mendapat daya penyembuh.
long_description.en: Its song is so beautiful that anyone who hears it forgets everything. The Alkonost lays eggs on the shore and rolls them into the sea; while the eggs are in the water the sea is calm, but their hatching unleashes violent storms. According to folk tales, on the Apple Feast of the Saviour the Sirin weeps in the apple orchard in the morning, and in the afternoon the Alkonost arrives rejoicing and shakes dew from its wings, giving healing power to the fruit of the tree it sits on.

long_description.id: Nama Alkonost berasal dari salah baca teks gereja Slavia: frasa yang berarti "alkuon adalah burung laut" terbaca sebagai satu nama. Kata Yunani yang mendasarinya berarti burung raja-udang, dan sosok ini dikaitkan dengan mitos Yunani tentang Alkione yang diubah para dewa menjadi raja-udang; sumber lain menduga asalnya dari Xrafstar dalam cerita rakyat Persia. Dalam tradisi Kristen, Alkonost dipandang sebagai utusan Tuhan yang meringankan penderitaan atau sebagai lambang jiwa yang naik ke surga, dan bagi Gereja Ortodoks Rusia ia adalah personifikasi kehendak ilahi.
long_description.en: The name Alkonost arose from a misreading of Church Slavic text, where a phrase meaning "the alkuon is a sea bird" was read as one name. The underlying Greek word means kingfisher, and the figure is tied to the Greek myth of Alcyone, turned by the gods into a kingfisher; another source suggests an origin in Xrafstar of Persian folklore. After Christianity reached Russia, the Alkonost was seen as a messenger from God easing hardship or as an image of the soul rising to Heaven, and for the Russian Orthodox Church it personifies the divine will.

long_description.id: Lubok, cetakan rakyat Rusia, menggambarkan Alkonost sebagai setengah burung setengah perempuan dengan bulu besar beraneka warna, bermahkota dan memegang bunga surga.
long_description.en: The Russian lubok, a popular print, shows the Alkonost as half bird, half woman with large many-coloured feathers, crowned and holding flowers of paradise.

claims.quote: The Alkonost often symbolizes positive things like happiness and paradise, while the Sirin tends to symbolize negative forces like natural disasters and misfortune.

statement.id: Alkonost sering melambangkan hal-hal baik seperti kebahagiaan dan surga, sedangkan Sirin melambangkan kekuatan negatif seperti bencana alam dan kemalangan.
statement.en: The Alkonost often symbolises good things like happiness and paradise, while the Sirin symbolises negative forces like natural disasters and misfortune.

claims.quote: Both creatures are associated with foretelling or causing death. The Alkonost, along with many other mythological bird human hybrids, is said to live in Rai, where the dead live.

statement.id: Kedua makhluk dikaitkan dengan meramalkan atau mendatangkan kematian; Alkonost, bersama banyak makhluk campuran burung-manusia lain, dikatakan tinggal di Rai, tempat orang mati.
statement.en: Both creatures are associated with foretelling or causing death; the Alkonost, with many other bird-human hybrids, is said to live in Rai, where the dead live.

claims.quote: The Alkonost sings beautiful songs, and those who hear these songs forget everything they know and want nothing more ever again.

statement.id: Alkonost menyanyikan lagu yang indah, dan yang mendengarnya melupakan semua yang diketahuinya dan tidak menginginkan apa pun lagi.
statement.en: The Alkonost sings beautiful songs; those who hear them forget everything they know and want nothing more ever again.

claims.quote: The Alkonost lays her eggs on a beach and then rolls them into the sea. During the time when the eggs are in the ocean, there are no storms or disasters. However, when the eggs hatch, the hatching causes very violent storms.

statement.id: Alkonost bertelur di pantai lalu menggulirkan telurnya ke laut; selama telur di laut tidak ada badai atau bencana, tetapi saat menetas timbul badai yang sangat dahsyat.
statement.en: The Alkonost lays eggs on a beach and rolls them into the sea; while they are in the ocean there are no storms or disasters, but their hatching causes very violent storms.

claims.quote: The Alkonost became a popular figure when Christianity was introduced in Russia, as the Alkonost was believed to be a messenger from God meant to take away the pain of hardship. Alternately, the Alkonost was used to represent the human soul ascending to Heaven.

statement.id: Alkonost menjadi populer saat agama Kristen masuk ke Rusia karena diyakini sebagai utusan Tuhan untuk menghapus derita kesusahan, atau dipakai sebagai lambang jiwa manusia yang naik ke surga.
statement.en: The Alkonost became popular when Christianity reached Russia, as it was believed to be a messenger from God to take away the pain of hardship, or was used to represent the human soul ascending to Heaven.

claims.quote: According to folk tales, on the morning of the Apple Feast of the Saviour, the Sirin flies into the apple orchard and cries sadly. In the afternoon, the Alkonost flies to this place, beginning to rejoice and laugh. The Alkonost brushes dew from her wings, granting healing powers to all fruits on the tree she is sitting on.

statement.id: Menurut cerita rakyat, pada pagi pesta apel Juru Selamat Sirin terbang ke kebun apel dan menangis; sore harinya Alkonost terbang ke sana, bergembira dan tertawa, lalu mengibaskan embun dari sayapnya sehingga semua buah di pohon tempatnya bertengger mendapat daya penyembuh.
statement.en: According to folk tales, on the morning of the Apple Feast of the Saviour the Sirin flies into the orchard and weeps; in the afternoon the Alkonost flies there rejoicing and laughing, and brushes dew from its wings, granting healing powers to all fruits on its tree.

claims.quote: от греч. ἀλκυών — зимородок) — морская птица, символизирующая Божий промысел и Божие милосердие; мифическая райская птица из книжных византийских и славянских легенд.

statement.id: Nama ini berasal dari kata Yunani ἀλκυών, "raja-udang"; Alkonost adalah burung laut yang melambangkan pemeliharaan dan belas kasih Tuhan, burung surga mitos dari legenda tertulis Bizantium dan Slavia.
statement.en: The name derives from Greek ἀλκυών, "kingfisher"; the Alkonost is a sea bird symbolising God's providence and mercy, a mythical bird of paradise from Byzantine and Slavic literary legends.

claims.quote: Алконост несёт яйца на берегу моря, погружает их в глубину моря и делает его спокойным на шесть дней. Пение этой птицы настолько прекрасно, что услышавший его забывает обо всём на свете.

statement.id: Alkonost bertelur di tepi laut, membenamkan telurnya ke kedalaman laut dan membuat laut tenang selama enam hari; nyanyiannya begitu indah sehingga yang mendengarnya melupakan segala hal di dunia.
statement.en: The Alkonost lays eggs on the seashore, sinks them into the deep and makes the sea calm for six days; its song is so beautiful that whoever hears it forgets everything in the world.

claims.quote: Образ возник из древнегреческого мифа об Алкионе, превращённой богами в зимородка.

claims.quote: Русский лубок изображает Алконоста полуптицей-полуженщиной с большими перьями, имеющими различную окраску. Голову венчает корона, в руках — райские цветы.

statement.id: Karena frasa "alkuon adalah burung laut" terbaca sebagai "alkuonest burung laut", nama "Alkonost" untuk pertama kali muncul dan kemudian mapan dalam sastra Rusia Kuno.

statement.id: Alkonost adalah burung ajaib kebahagiaan dan harapan, berlawanan dengan Sirin, burung duka dan kesedihan; Alkonost bersikap baik kepada manusia, Sirin kurang.
statement.en: The Alkonosts are magical birds of happiness and hope, opposed to the Sirin, birds of grief and sorrow; the Alkonosts are well disposed to people, the Sirin less so.

claims.quote: Für die Russisch-Orthodoxe Kirche ist die Alkonost die Personifikation des göttlichen Willens. Sie lebt im Paradies und verlässt es nur, um in unserer Welt Botschaften zu überbringen.

statement.id: Bagi Gereja Ortodoks Rusia, Alkonost adalah personifikasi kehendak ilahi; ia tinggal di surga dan hanya meninggalkannya untuk menyampaikan pesan ke dunia kita.
statement.en: For the Russian Orthodox Church the Alkonost personifies the divine will; it lives in Paradise and leaves only to bring messages to our world.

short_description.id: Altamaha-ha adalah kriptid dalam cerita rakyat Georgia yang konon menghuni perairan dekat muara Sungai Altamaha.
short_description.en: The Altamaha-ha is a cryptid of Georgia folklore said to live in the waters near the mouth of the Altamaha River.

long_description.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Georgia, Altamaha-ha atau Altie adalah makhluk legendaris yang konon menghuni anak-anak sungai dan bekas sawah dekat muara Sungai Altamaha. Penampakan terutama dilaporkan di sekitar Darien di McIntosh County. Menurut The Brunswick News legenda ini berakar pada tradisi Muscogee, dan satu sumber menyebut penduduk asli sudah percaya ada makhluk mirip ular raksasa di sungai itu sebelum penampakan resmi pertama tahun 1700.
long_description.en: The Altamaha-ha, also called Altie, belongs to the folklore of Georgia: it is said to haunt the streams and old rice fields where the Altamaha River meets the sea. Sightings are reported especially around Darien in McIntosh County. The Brunswick News traces the legend to Muscogee tradition, and one source says Native Americans already believed in a giant serpent-like creature in the river before the first formal sighting in 1700.

long_description.id: Ikan alligator gar diajukan sebagai penjelasan penampakan belakangan ini. Pada 2018 bangkai di pantai Wolf Island sempat diduga Altamaha-ha, tetapi seniman Zardulu kemudian mengaku membuatnya dari hiu awetan dan bubur kertas. Makhluk ini juga muncul sebagai musuh dalam gim South of Midnight.
long_description.en: An alligator gar has been proposed to explain recent sightings. In 2018 remains on a Wolf Island beach were briefly thought to be an Altamaha-ha, but artist Zardulu later said he made them from a stuffed shark and papier-mâché. The creature also appears as a boss in the game South of Midnight.

short_description.id: Anguane adalah nimfa air Alpen Italia utara, perempuan cantik berkaki kambing atau belah yang tinggal di dekat air, menikahi manusia, dan membawa kemalangan bila dihina.
short_description.en: Anguane are Alpine water nymphs of northern Italian folklore, beautiful goat- or cloven-footed women living by water who marry humans and bring misfortune if insulted.

long_description.id: Anguane, dalam bahasa Ladin Ganes, adalah nimfa air dari cerita rakyat Alpen Italia utara; namanya mungkin dari bahasa Latin aqua, "air". Mereka tinggal dekat danau, sungai, mata air, atau gua, mencuci linen, dan hanya terlihat saat fajar dan senja. Mereka bisa tampak sebagai perempuan muda cantik atau perempuan tua berkaki kambing, berpayudara panjang yang disampirkan ke punggung untuk menyusui anak dalam keranjang.
long_description.en: The anguane, Ganes in Ladin, are water nymphs of northern Italian Alpine folklore; the name may come from Latin aqua, 'water'. They live by lakes, brooks, springs or caves, wash linen, and appear only at dawn and dusk. They may look like beautiful young women or old goat-footed hags, with long breasts flung over the shoulder to nurse children carried in baskets.

long_description.id: Mereka merayu pengembara, membantu perempuan mandul hamil, dan kadang menikahi manusia dengan syarat rambut pirangnya tidak disentuh, sambil memberi hadiah yang tak pernah habis. Siapa pun yang menghina mereka akan ditimpa kemalangan seumur hidup.
long_description.en: They seduce travellers, help barren women conceive, and sometimes marry humans on condition their blond hair is not touched, giving gifts that never run out. Whoever insults them suffers lifelong misfortune.

origin.id: Cerita rakyat Italia utara dan Ladin.

famous_for.id: Payudara panjang yang disampirkan ke punggung.
famous_for.en: Long breasts flung over the shoulder.

claims.quote: Anguane are mythical creatures in Northern Italian folklore, which are traditionally depicted as cloven-footed water nymphs with beautiful faces and long breasts.

statement.id: Anguane adalah makhluk mitis cerita rakyat Italia utara yang biasanya digambarkan sebagai nimfa air berkaki belah dengan wajah cantik dan payudara panjang.
statement.en: Anguane are mythical beings of northern Italian folklore, usually shown as cloven-footed water nymphs with beautiful faces and long breasts.

claims.quote: They were said to have carried their children in baskets held on their backs, and to have been able to throw their breasts over their backs to nurse these children.

statement.id: Mereka konon menggendong anak dalam keranjang di punggung dan dapat menyampirkan payudaranya ke belakang untuk menyusui anak itu.
statement.en: They were said to carry their children in baskets on their backs and to fling their breasts over their shoulders to nurse them.

claims.quote: Anguane were believed to resided in or nearby lakes. According to myth, Anguane seduce male wayfarers and help infertile women become pregnant.

statement.id: Anguane dipercaya tinggal di dalam atau dekat danau; menurut mitos mereka merayu lelaki pengembara dan membantu perempuan mandul hamil.
statement.en: Anguane were thought to live in or near lakes; by myth they seduce male travellers and help barren women conceive.

claims.quote: Als Anguana (von lat. aqua = Wasser; auch Aguana, Guana, Gana, Eguana, Agana, Enguana) bezeichnet man eine Dämonin aus der ladinischen bzw. romanischsprachigen Mythologie

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Jerman, anguana (dari bahasa Latin aqua, "air"; juga Aguana, Guana, Gana, Eguana, Agana, Enguana) adalah makhluk halus perempuan dari mitologi Ladin dan Rumansch.
statement.en: According to the German article, the anguana (from Latin aqua, 'water'; also Aguana, Guana, Gana, Eguana, Agana, Enguana) is a female spirit of Ladin and Romansh mythology.

claims.quote: Es heißt, dass sie ein Leben lang Unglück bringen sollen, wenn man sie beleidigt.

statement.id: Konon mereka membawa kemalangan seumur hidup bila dihina.
statement.en: They are said to bring lifelong misfortune if insulted.

claims.quote: Sie können sowohl als schöne, junge, attraktive Frauen, als auch als alte, hässliche Frauen mit Ziegenfüßen in Erscheinung treten.

statement.id: Mereka dapat muncul sebagai perempuan muda yang cantik atau sebagai perempuan tua buruk rupa berkaki kambing.
statement.en: They can appear as beautiful young women or as ugly old women with goat's feet.

claims.quote: Angeblich leben sie an Bächen, Quellen oder in Höhlen und waschen Leinen. Auch sollen sie sich nur zur Morgen- und Abenddämmerung blicken lassen.

statement.id: Mereka konon tinggal di tepi sungai kecil, mata air, atau gua sambil mencuci kain linen, dan hanya terlihat saat fajar dan senja.
statement.en: They supposedly live by brooks, springs or in caves washing linen, and show themselves only at dawn and dusk.

claims.quote: Zuweilen sollen sie auch Ehen mit den Menschen eingehen, ähnlich wie auch die Feen, allerdings darf der Mann dann nicht ihr blondes Haar berühren. Darüber hinaus sollen sie „unendliche Geschenke“ (also Dinge, die nie zu Ende gehen) überreichen.

short_description.id: Azhdahak adalah raja-naga dalam mitologi Armenia, bentuk Armenia dari nama iblis Avesta Azhi Dahaka.
short_description.en: Azhdahak is a dragon-king of Armenian myth whose name is the Armenian version of Azhi Dahaka, a demon of the Avesta.

long_description.id: Azhdahak adalah bentuk Armenia dari nama iblis Avesta Azhi Dahaka, dan dalam mitologi Armenia ia raja-naga, manusia-vishap. Para vishap, golongan naga tempat Azhdahak berada, hidup di gunung tinggi, danau besar, langit, dan awan; ketika naik ke langit atau turun ke danau, raungan mereka menakutkan penduduk. Gerakan azhdahak di bawah tanah dipercaya menyebabkan gempa, dan vishap yang hidup sampai seribu tahun dapat menelan seluruh dunia.
long_description.en: Azhdahak takes his name from Azhi Dahaka, a demon of the Avesta, and in Armenian myth he is a dragon-king, a man-vishap. The vishaps, the class of dragons Azhdahak belongs to, live in high mountains, great lakes, the sky and clouds; when they rise to the sky or come down to lakes, their roar terrifies people. The movement of azhdahaks underground was believed to cause earthquakes, and a vishap that lives to a thousand years can swallow the whole world.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Iran ia dipenjara di Gunung Damavand dan pada akhir zaman akan lepas, lalu akhirnya dikalahkan Fereydun. Dalam Sejarah Armenia, Movses Khorenatsi menyamakan Azhdahak dengan raja Media, Astyages; dalam epos Armenia kuno Vipasank ia raja bangsa Mar (Media) yang dikalahkan raja Armenia Tigran I. Bentuk Armenia Azhdahak dipinjam dari bahasa Parthia.
long_description.en: In Iranian mythology he is imprisoned in Mount Damavand and will break out at the end of time, to be finally defeated by Fereydun. In his History of Armenia, Movses Khorenatsi identified Azhdahak with the Median king Astyages; in the ancient Armenian epic Vipasank he is king of the Mars (Medes), defeated by the Armenian king Tigran I. The Armenian form Azhdahak was borrowed from Parthian.

short_description.id: Balaur adalah naga berkepala banyak atau ular monster dalam cerita rakyat Rumania, kadang bersayap, yang dalam dongeng biasanya jahat dan dikalahkan oleh pahlawan.
short_description.en: The balaur is a many-headed dragon or monstrous serpent of Romanian folklore, sometimes winged, usually evil in folktales and defeated by a hero.

long_description.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Rumania, balaur (jamak: balauri) adalah sejenis naga berkepala banyak atau ular monster, kadang disebut bersayap. Kepalanya biasanya tiga, tetapi beberapa legenda menyebut tujuh bahkan dua belas. Dalam bahasa Rumania, kata balaur juga dapat dipakai untuk makhluk apa pun yang mirip monster.
long_description.en: In Romanian folklore the balaur (plural balauri) is a kind of many-headed dragon or monstrous serpent, sometimes said to have wings. It usually has three heads, though some legends give it seven or even twelve. In Romanian the word balaur can also describe any monster-like creature.

long_description.id: Dalam dongeng, balaur biasanya jahat: ia meminta atau menculik gadis muda atau putri, lalu dikalahkan oleh pahlawan seperti Santo Georgius atau pemuda tampan Făt-Frumos. Ia juga digambarkan sebagai makhluk mirip ular yang menjaga harta dan putri. Ada legenda bahwa air liurnya dapat menghasilkan batu permata, dan siapa pun yang berhasil membunuhnya akan diampuni satu dosanya.
long_description.en: In folktales the balaur is typically evil, demanding or abducting young maidens or a princess, and is defeated by a hero such as Saint George or the fair youth Făt-Frumos. It is also pictured as a serpentine being guarding treasures and princesses. Some legends say its saliva can produce precious stones, and that whoever slays it will be forgiven a sin.

long_description.id: Menurut folklorist Tudor Pamfile, ada tiga jenis balaur dalam tradisi rakyat: penghuni air, darat, dan udara. Jenis air antara lain monster berkepala tujuh yang tinggal di sumur desa dan meminta gadis sebagai korban. Balaur udara dikaitkan dengan cuaca dan disebut juga hala atau ala; bila dua balaur bertarung di udara, timbul kerusakan seperti pohon tercabut. Menurut sebagian sumber, balaur menjadi tunggangan para Solomonari, penyihir pengendali cuaca, yang mengendalikannya dengan tali kekang emas.
long_description.en: According to folklorist Tudor Pamfile there are three types of balaur in folk tradition: water-, land- and air-dwelling. The water type includes a seven-headed monster living in a village well and demanding maidens as sacrifice. The air balaur is linked to weather and also called hala or ala; when two balauri fight in the air, damage such as uprooted trees follows. Some sources make the balaur the mount of the Solomonari, weather-controlling sorcerers, who steer it with a golden rein.

short_description.id: Monster Banyoles adalah naga legendaris danau Banyoles di Katalonia yang dijinakkan Santo Emeterio (Sant Mer) pada abad ke-8.
short_description.en: The Banyoles monster is a legendary dragon of the lake of Banyoles in Catalonia, tamed by St Emeterio (Sant Mer) in the 8th century.

long_description.id: Monster Banyoles atau Drac de Banyoles adalah naga legendaris dari danau Banyoles di Katalonia. Ia bersarang di gua La Draga, dapat terbang, berenang, dan berjalan, napasnya mencemari seluruh Gironès, dan ia memangsa hewan serta manusia. Charlemagne gagal membunuhnya karena pedangnya Joyeuse hancur pada sisiknya.
long_description.en: The Banyoles monster or Drac de Banyoles is a legendary dragon of the lake of Banyoles in Catalonia. It lived in the cave of La Draga, could fly, swim and walk, polluted the whole Gironès with its breath and devoured animals and people. Charlemagne failed to kill it when his sword Joyeuse shattered on its scales.

long_description.id: Pada abad ke-8 biarawan Santo Emeterio (Sant Mer) menjinakkannya dengan doa. Menurut satu versi ia dibawa ke kota dan dibunuh warga; menurut versi lain ia diubah menjadi pemakan tumbuhan yang damai dan masih hidup di dasar danau. Legenda ini mirip kisah Tarasque.
long_description.en: In the 8th century the monk St Emeterio (Sant Mer) tamed it with prayers. In one version it was led into town and killed by the people; in another it was turned into a peaceful herbivore and still lives in the depths of the lake. The legend resembles that of the Tarasque.

long_description.id: Naga ini kini ikon Banyoles dan lambang banyak klub olahraga, dan menjadi subjek lagu anak "El Monstre De Banyoles" tahun 2008.
long_description.en: The dragon is now an icon of Banyoles and an emblem of many sports clubs, and the subject of the 2008 children's song "El Monstre De Banyoles".

short_description.id: Bauk adalah makhluk mitis mirip binatang dalam mitologi Serbia yang bersembunyi di tempat gelap untuk menyergap dan melahap korbannya, tetapi dapat diusir dengan cahaya dan bunyi.
short_description.en: The bauk is an animal-like mythical creature of Serbian mythology that lurks in dark places to seize and devour its victims, but can be driven off by light and noise.

long_description.id: Bauk adalah makhluk mitis mirip binatang dalam mitologi Serbia dan Slavia Selatan, yang dulu dipakai untuk menakut-nakuti anak kecil. Ia dikatakan bersembunyi di tempat gelap, lubang, atau rumah kosong, menunggu untuk menyergap, membawa pergi, dan melahap korbannya, tetapi dapat diusir dengan cahaya dan bunyi. Jalannya canggung, yang disebut bauljanje, dan bunyi tiruannya "bau".
long_description.en: The bauk is a beast-like creature of Serbian and South Slavic myth, once used to frighten small children. It is said to lurk in dark corners, holes or empty houses, waiting to snatch, carry off and eat its prey, yet light and noise scare it away. It walks with a clumsy gait called bauljanje, and the sound it is given is "bau".

long_description.id: Penafsiran sifat-sifat bauk mengarah pada kesimpulan bahwa ia sebenarnya gambaran beruang sungguhan yang di sebagian Serbia sudah punah dan hanya dikenal lewat legenda; kata bauk semula dipakai sebagai sebutan sayang (hipokorisme) untuk beruang. Dalam terjemahan Serbia karya J. R. R. Tolkien, bauk dipakai untuk menerjemahkan goblin.
long_description.en: Reading the bauk's traits suggests it really describes actual bears, by then extinct in parts of Serbia and known only from legend; the word bauk was first a pet name (hypocorism) for the bear. Serbian translations of J. R. R. Tolkien use bauk to render goblin.

short_description.id: Bicorn dan Chichevache adalah sepasang binatang satire abad pertengahan: Bicorn gemuk karena memakan suami yang setia, Chichevache kurus karena istri yang patuh langka.
short_description.en: Bicorn and Chichevache are a pair of medieval satirical beasts: Bicorn is fat from eating devoted husbands, Chichevache thin because obedient wives are scarce.

long_description.id: Bicorn dan Chichevache adalah binatang dongeng dalam satire Eropa Abad Pertengahan dan Renaisans. Bicorn, setengah macan tutul setengah sapi berwajah manusia dan bertanduk dua, gemuk karena memangsa suami yang baik dan setia; Chichevache, "sapi kurus", kelaparan karena hanya memakan istri yang patuh. Dalam cerita rakyat Prancis keduanya disebut Bigorne dan Chicheface, dan Bigorne di sana tampak seperti harimau.
long_description.en: Bicorn and Chichevache are fabulous beasts of medieval and Renaissance European satire. Bicorn, part panther, part cow with a human face and two horns, is fat from devouring kind, devoted husbands; Chichevache, the 'thin cow', starves because it eats only obedient wives. In French folklore they are Bigorne and Chicheface, and the Bigorne there looks like a tiger.

long_description.id: Chaucer menyebut Chichevache dalam Canterbury Tales, dan John Lydgate menulis puisi Bycorne and Chychevache yang menjadikan keduanya suami istri. Di Poitou-Charentes Bigorne juga momok yang memakan anak dekat sumur, dan bicorn muncul dalam Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets.
long_description.en: Chaucer names Chichevache in the Canterbury Tales, and John Lydgate's poem Bycorne and Chychevache makes them husband and wife. In Poitou-Charentes the Bigorne is also a bogey eating children near wells, and the bicorn appears in Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets.

short_description.id: Bies atau bes adalah roh jahat atau iblis dalam mitologi Slavia yang, setelah masuknya agama Kristen, disamakan dengan setan.
short_description.en: Bies or bes is an evil spirit or demon of Slavic mythology which, after the coming of Christianity, was identified with the devil.

long_description.id: Bies (dalam bahasa Rusia bes, dalam bahasa Kroasia bijes) adalah roh jahat atau iblis dalam mitologi Slavia. Setelah agama Kristen diterima, bies disamakan dengan iblis dan kata ini sering dipakai bersinonim dengan chort. Kata ini sepadan dengan istilah Yunani Kuno daimon, dan dalam bahasa Slovenia, Kroasia, dan Serbia kata ini berarti "amarah".
long_description.en: Bies (Russian bes, Croatian bijes) is an evil spirit or demon of Slavic mythology. After Christianity was accepted, the bies was identified with the devil, and the word often became a synonym of chort. It corresponds to the Ancient Greek daimon, and in Slovenian, Croatian and Serbian the word means "rage".

long_description.id: Dalam gambaran mitologis Slavia kuno, para biesy adalah roh jahat, tokoh iblis tingkat rendah, dan perwujudan kekuatan yang memusuhi manusia, dengan berbagai kemampuan adikodrati. Mereka tidak punya rupa tetap; dalam cerita rakyat mereka memadukan ciri manusia dan hewan. Dalam demonologi rakyat, gambaran bes berkembang di bawah pengaruh tradisi gereja dan berbaur dengan kepercayaan tentang chort dan iblis.
long_description.en: In old Slavic mythological imagery the biesy are evil spirits, lesser demonic figures and personifications of forces hostile to humans, possessing all kinds of superhuman abilities. They had no fixed form; in folklore they combined human and animal features. In folk demonology the image of the bes developed under the influence of church tradition and merged with beliefs about the chort and the devil.

long_description.id: Menurut ajaran Kristen, bes dapat merasuki manusia; kerasukan ini dipercaya mendorong orang pada perilaku berlebihan yang merugikan dan berbagai penyakit jiwa. Dalam budaya modern, makhluk bernama bies muncul dalam gim video The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt sebagai pemangsa bertanduk dengan kekuatan hipnotis dan penyembuhan diri.
long_description.en: According to Christian teaching, a bes can possess a person; such possession was believed to drive people to harmful excess and various mental illnesses. In modern culture, creatures called bies appear in the video game The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt as massive horned predators with hypnotic and self-healing powers.

short_description.id: Biscione adalah ular ilahi dengan seorang anak di mulutnya, lambang heraldik keluarga Visconti dan kota Milan yang kini muncul pada logo Alfa Romeo.
short_description.en: The biscione is a divine serpent with a child in its mouth, the heraldic emblem of the Visconti and of Milan, now on the Alfa Romeo logo.

long_description.id: Biscione, "ular rumput besar" atau vipera, adalah gambar heraldik ular ilahi dengan seorang anak di mulutnya, yang ditafsirkan sedang menelan atau memuntahkan anak itu. Ia lambang Milan, semula milik keluarga Visconti lalu Sforza; salah satu gambaran tertuanya adalah fresko akhir abad ke-13 di Kastel Visconti di Angera.
long_description.en: The biscione, 'big grass snake' or vipera, is a heraldic image of a divine serpent with a child in its mouth, read as swallowing or disgorging it. It is the emblem of Milan, first of the Visconti and then the Sforza; one of its oldest depictions is a late 13th-century fresco in the Visconti Castle at Angera.

long_description.id: Asal-usulnya mungkin ular perunggu yang dibawa dari Konstantinopel oleh Uskup Agung Arnolf II, atau menurut tradisi yang dicatat Galvano Fiamma, lambang seorang Saracen yang dikalahkan Ottone Visconti dalam duel. Kini biscione ada pada logo Alfa Romeo dan lambang beberapa kota di luar Italia seperti Dachau dan Sanok.
long_description.en: It may derive from a bronze serpent brought from Constantinople by Archbishop Arnolf II, or, by a tradition recorded by Galvano Fiamma, from a Saracen's emblem won by Ottone Visconti in a duel. Today it appears on the Alfa Romeo logo and in the arms of towns abroad such as Dachau and Sanok.

famous_for.en: The Alfa Romeo logo.

description.id: Logo yang memuat biscione sebagai lambang Milan.
description.en: The logo bearing the biscione as Milan's symbol.

claims.quote: The biscione (English: "big grass snake"), less commonly known also as the vipera, is in heraldry a charge consisting of a divine serpent with a child in its mouth; the serpent may be variously described as being in the act of swallowing the child, or the child may be emerging from its mouth.

statement.id: Biscione ("ular rumput besar"), juga disebut vipera, dalam heraldik adalah gambar ular ilahi dengan seorang anak di mulutnya, yang ditafsirkan sedang menelan anak itu atau anak itu keluar dari mulutnya.
statement.en: The biscione ('big grass snake'), also called vipera, is a heraldic charge of a divine serpent with a child in its mouth, read either as swallowing the child or as the child emerging from its mouth.

claims.quote: It is a historic symbol of the city of Milan, originally on the coat-of-arms of the Visconti and Sforza dynasties.

statement.id: Ia lambang bersejarah kota Milan, semula pada lambang dinasti Visconti dan Sforza.
statement.en: It is a historic symbol of Milan, originally on the arms of the Visconti and Sforza dynasties.

claims.quote: Etymologically, word biscione is a masculine augmentative of Italian feminine biscia "grass snake" (corrupted from bistia, ultimately from Latin bestia "beast").

statement.id: Kata biscione adalah bentuk pembesar dari biscia, "ular rumput", dari bistia dan akhirnya bahasa Latin bestia, "binatang buas".
statement.en: Biscione is the augmentative of Italian biscia, 'grass snake', from bistia and ultimately Latin bestia, 'beast'.

claims.quote: The symbol may have been derived from a bronzed serpent brought to Milan from Constantinople by Arnolf II of Arsago (Archbishop of Milan 998–1018) in the 11th century.

statement.id: Lambang ini mungkin berasal dari ular perunggu yang dibawa ke Milan dari Konstantinopel oleh Arnolf II dari Arsago (Uskup Agung Milan 998–1018) pada abad ke-11.
statement.en: The symbol may derive from a bronze serpent brought to Milan from Constantinople by Arnolf II of Arsago (Archbishop of Milan 998–1018) in the 11th century.

claims.quote: One of the oldest depictions of the Biscione is in the Great Hall of the Visconti Castle of Angera. The hall was painted at the end of the 13th century with frescoes celebrating Archbishop Ottone Visconti's victory against the rival family of the Della Torre.

statement.id: Salah satu gambaran tertua biscione ada di Aula Besar Kastel Visconti di Angera, yang dilukis fresko pada akhir abad ke-13 untuk merayakan kemenangan Uskup Agung Ottone Visconti atas keluarga Della Torre.
statement.en: One of the oldest depictions of the biscione is in the Great Hall of the Visconti Castle at Angera, frescoed in the late 13th century to celebrate Archbishop Ottone Visconti's victory over the Della Torre.

statement.en: The logo of the car maker Alfa Romeo, founded in Milan in 1910 and nicknamed the Casa del Biscione, shows the flag of Milan and the biscione.

statement.en: According to the German article, besides many Italian towns the biscione appears in the arms of Dachau, Pružany, Dłutów and Sanok.

short_description.id: Ikan uskup adalah makhluk laut legendaris abad ke-16 berwujud seperti uskup, yang konon ditangkap, minta dilepaskan kepada para uskup, lalu membuat tanda salib dan lenyap ke laut.
short_description.en: The bishop-fish is a legendary 16th-century sea creature shaped like a bishop that, once caught, begged bishops for release, then made the sign of the cross and vanished into the sea.

long_description.id: Ikan uskup atau uskup laut pertama tercatat pada abad ke-16. Menurut legenda ia dibawa kepada Raja Polandia, lalu diperlihatkan kepada para uskup Katolik, memberi isyarat minta dilepaskan, dan setelah dibebaskan membuat tanda salib lalu lenyap ke laut. Seekor lagi konon ditangkap dekat Jerman pada 1531, menolak makan, dan mati tiga hari kemudian; ia digambar dalam Historiae animalium karya Conrad Gesner.
long_description.en: The bishop-fish or sea bishop was first recorded in the 16th century. By legend it was brought to the King of Poland, shown to Catholic bishops, begged by gesture to be freed, and once released made the sign of the cross and vanished. Another was supposedly caught off Germany in 1531, refused to eat and died in three days; Conrad Gesner pictured it in his Historiae animalium.

long_description.id: Artikel bahasa Jepang menggambarkannya sebagai ikan besar yang berjalan tegak dengan sirip seperti kaki dan lengan bercakar. Identitasnya diduga cumi-cumi besar (Heuvelmans), hiu malaikat, walrus, atau anjing laut, dan gagasannya dibentuk pandangan Kristen bahwa laut pun punya rohaniwan.
long_description.en: The Japanese article describes it as a large fish walking upright with leg-like and clawed arm-like fins. It has been explained as a large squid (Heuvelmans), angelshark, walrus or seal, and the idea was shaped by the Christian view that the sea too has clergy.

famous_for.en: Making the sign of the cross before vanishing.

claims.quote: The sea bishop or bishop-fish is a legendary creature first recorded in the 16th century. According to legend, it was taken to the King of Poland, who wished to keep it. It was also shown to a group of Catholic bishops, to whom the bishop-fish gestured, appealing to be released. They granted its wish, at which point it made the sign of the cross and disappeared into the sea.

statement.id: Uskup laut atau ikan uskup adalah makhluk legendaris yang pertama tercatat pada abad ke-16; menurut legenda ia dibawa kepada Raja Polandia yang ingin memeliharanya, lalu diperlihatkan kepada para uskup Katolik, memberi isyarat minta dilepaskan, dan setelah dibebaskan membuat tanda salib lalu lenyap ke laut.
statement.en: The sea bishop or bishop-fish is a legendary creature first recorded in the 16th century; by legend it was brought to the King of Poland, who wished to keep it, shown to Catholic bishops, gestured to be freed, and once released made the sign of the cross and vanished into the sea.

claims.quote: Another was supposedly captured in the ocean near Germany in 1531. It refused to eat and died after three days. It was described and pictured in the fourth volume of Conrad Gesner's famous Historiae animalium, published in 1551–1558 and 1587.

statement.id: Seekor lagi konon ditangkap di laut dekat Jerman pada 1531, menolak makan, dan mati setelah tiga hari; ia dideskripsikan dan digambar dalam jilid keempat Historiae animalium karya Conrad Gesner (1551–1558 dan 1587).
statement.en: Another was supposedly caught in the sea off Germany in 1531, refused to eat and died after three days; it was described and pictured in volume four of Conrad Gesner's Historiae animalium (1551–1558 and 1587).

claims.quote: Cryptozoologist Bernard Heuvelmans believed the report was based on the discovery of a large mutilated Grimaldi scaled squid.

statement.id: Kriptozoolog Bernard Heuvelmans menduga laporan itu berasal dari penemuan cumi-cumi bersisik Grimaldi yang besar dan rusak.
statement.en: The cryptozoologist Bernard Heuvelmans believed the report was based on a large mutilated Grimaldi scaled squid.

claims.quote: Ikan uskup lainnya ditangkap di samudera dekat Jerman pada 1531. Ia menolak untuk makan dan mati tiga hari kemudian.

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Indonesia juga menyebut ikan uskup yang ditangkap dekat Jerman pada 1531 menolak makan dan mati tiga hari kemudian.
statement.en: The Indonesian article also says the bishop-fish caught near Germany in 1531 refused food and died three days later.

statement.en: According to the Japanese article, it looks like a huge fish whose tail fin forms legs and pectoral fins clawed arms, with a conical head, walking upright like a man.

statement.en: Various identities have been proposed, such as the angelshark, walrus or hooded seal.

statement.en: The Christian view that the sea, like the land, has its own clergy shaped the idea of the bishop-fish.

statement.en: The Japanese article equates the bishop-fish with the Sea monk ('monk of the sea'), a legendary sea creature of medieval European folklore.

short_description.id: Naga Bisterne adalah legenda dari New Forest, Inggris, tentang naga yang bersarang di Burley Beacon dan dibunuh seorang ksatria bernama Berkeley.
short_description.en: The Bisterne Dragon is a New Forest legend from England about a dragon that lairs at Burley Beacon and is slain by a knight named Berkeley.

long_description.id: Naga Bisterne adalah legenda dari New Forest di Inggris, terutama berlatar di Bisterne tetapi juga melibatkan Burley dan Lyndhurst. Menurut tradisi setempat, seekor naga bersarang di Burley Beacon, sekitar 3 mil di timur Bisterne, dan setiap pagi "terbang" ke Bisterne untuk diberi susu. Seorang ksatria pemberani, biasanya bernama Berkeley, membangun persembunyian dan menunggu bersama dua anjing; anjing-anjing itu menyerang naga, dan sang ksatria menyergapnya, sementara kedua anjing mati dalam pertarungan.
long_description.en: The Bisterne Dragon is a legend of England's New Forest, set mainly in Bisterne but also involving Burley and Lyndhurst. Local tradition says a dragon made its den on Burley Beacon, some 3 miles east of Bisterne, and 'flew' to Bisterne each morning to be given milk. A brave knight, usually called Berkeley, built a hide and waited with two dogs; the dogs set on the dragon and the knight caught it off guard, though both dogs died in the fight.

long_description.id: Versi lain menyebut ksatria itu menutupi baju zirahnya dengan kaca, dan naga itu mati di luar Lyndhurst lalu tubuhnya menjadi bukit Boltons Bench. Versi tertulis tercatat di pinggir silsilah sebelum 1618 yang disimpan di Berkeley Castle, menyebut pembunuhnya Sir Maurice Berkeley, tuan tanah Bisterne pada abad ke-15; keturunannya memakai lambang naga di depan suar menyala. Lokasi pertarungan masih disebut "Dragon Fields". Artikel ja menyebut naga itu juga menuntut daging ternak dan manusia.
long_description.en: Other tellings say the knight covered his armour with glass, and that the dragon died outside Lyndhurst, its body becoming the hill called Boltons Bench. The written version, in the margin of a pedigree roll made before 1618 and kept at Berkeley Castle, names the slayer as Sir Maurice Berkeley, lord of Bisterne manor in the 15th century, whose descendants bore a crest of a dragon before a burning beacon. The supposed battle site is still known as 'Dragon Fields'. The ja article adds that the dragon came to demand the flesh of livestock and people as well.

famous_for.en: Slain by Sir Maurice Berkeley.

did_you_know.en: Legend says the Bisterne Dragon's body turned into the hill Boltons Bench at Lyndhurst.

short_description.id: Blue Ben adalah naga legenda dari Kilve di Somerset barat, Inggris, yang tinggal di gua serpih di pesisir.
short_description.en: Blue Ben is a legendary dragon from Kilve in west Somerset, England, living in shale caves on the coast.

long_description.id: Blue Ben adalah naga legenda dari Kilve di Somerset barat, Inggris. Kisahnya punya beberapa versi; biasanya ia tinggal di gua serpih di pesisir Somerset dan rutin berendam di laut untuk mendinginkan diri setelah menyemburkan api. Agar tidak terjebak di dataran lumpur antara air dan sarangnya, ia membangun jalan batu kapur sebagai jalur aman. Iblis, yang lama mengamatinya, menangkapnya untuk dijadikan tunggangan dan memacunya tanpa ampun melewati api neraka hingga naga itu lolos.
long_description.en: Blue Ben is a legendary dragon of Kilve in western Somerset, England. The tale has several versions; usually he lives in shale caves on the Somerset coast and bathes in the sea to cool off after breathing fire. To avoid getting trapped in the mud flats between sea and lair he built a limestone causeway as a safe path. The Devil, having watched him a while, seized him as a mount and drove him cruelly through hellfire until the dragon broke free.

long_description.id: Dalam perjalanan pulang yang tergesa-gesa, Blue Ben melintasi dataran lumpur, terjebak, dan ditelan lumpur. Pada awal abad ke-19, penambangan formasi serpih Blue Lias di luar Kilve menemukan tengkorak fosil Ichthyosaur yang dikatakan sisa Blue Ben; tengkorak itu dipamerkan di Wells and Mendip Museum di Wells atau Museum of Somerset di Taunton.
long_description.en: Rushing home, Blue Ben cut across the mud flats, got stuck, and was swallowed by the mud. In the early 19th century quarrying of the Blue Lias shale outside Kilve exposed a fossil Ichthyosaur skull said to be Blue Ben's remains; it is displayed at the Wells and Mendip Museum in Wells or the Museum of Somerset in Taunton.

famous_for.en: Swallowed by mud.

did_you_know.en: A fossil Ichthyosaur skull from Kilve is sometimes pointed out as Blue Ben's.

short_description.id: Bluecap adalah peri atau hantu dalam cerita rakyat Inggris yang menghuni tambang dan tampak sebagai nyala api biru kecil, menuntun penambang ke deposit kaya.
short_description.en: The bluecap is a fairy or ghost of English folklore that dwells in mines and appears as a small blue flame, leading miners to rich deposits.

long_description.id: Bluecap adalah peri atau hantu mitos dalam cerita rakyat Inggris (English folklore) yang menghuni tambang dan tampak sebagai nyala api biru kecil. Jika para penambang memperlakukannya dengan hormat, bluecap menuntun mereka ke deposit mineral yang kaya. Seperti knocker atau kobold, bluecap juga dapat memperingatkan penambang akan runtuhan. Mereka terutama dikaitkan dengan perbatasan Inggris-Skotlandia (Anglo-Scottish borders).
long_description.en: The bluecap is a mythical fairy or ghost of English folklore that lives in mines and shows itself as a small blue flame. If miners treat them with respect, bluecaps guide them to rich mineral deposits. Like knockers or kobolds, they can also warn miners of cave-ins. They are mostly linked with the Anglo-Scottish borders.

long_description.id: Bluecap dianggap pekerja keras yang diharapkan dibayar upah setara buruh biasa, sama dengan seorang putter (penambang pendorong gerobak); upah itu ditinggalkan di sudut tambang yang sepi, dan mereka tak mau menerima lebih atau kurang dari haknya. Penambang kadang bercerita melihat bluecap berkelip hinggap di atas tong batu bara penuh dan memindahkannya seolah didorong otot terkuat. Makhluk sejenis yang kurang membantu bernama Cutty Soames, yang memotong tali pengikat pendorong gerobak. Menurut artikel zh, 藍帽子 adalah peri kecil atau hantu rekaan dalam cerita rakyat Inggris yang tinggal di tambang.
long_description.en: Bluecaps were seen as hard workers expecting a working man's pay, equal to an ordinary putter (who pushed the mine wagons); the money was left in a lonely corner of the mine, and they would take neither more nor less than their due. Miners sometimes told of a flickering bluecap settling on a full tub of coal and moving it as if driven by the strongest muscles. A less helpful being of the same kind was Cutty Soames, who cut the rope-traces yoking the assistant putter to the tub. According to the zh article the 藍帽子 is a small fairy or ghost of English folklore living in mines.

famous_for.en: Wants a fair wage.

did_you_know.id: Bluecap konon menuntut upah setara buruh tambang biasa dan tidak mau menerima lebih maupun kurang dari haknya.
did_you_know.en: Bluecaps were said to expect an ordinary miner's wage and would accept neither more nor less than they were owed.

note.en: Also warns miners.

short_description.id: Bran dan Sceólang ("gagak" dan "penyintas") adalah anjing-anjing Fionn mac Cumhaill dalam Siklus Fenian mitologi Irlandia.
short_description.en: In the Fenian Cycle of Irish myth, Bran and Sceólang, whose names mean 'raven' and 'survivor', are the dogs of Fionn mac Cumhaill.

long_description.id: Bran dan Sceólang, yang berarti "gagak" dan "penyintas", adalah anjing Fionn mac Cumhaill dalam Siklus Fenian mitologi Irlandia. Mereka digambarkan sebagian besar putih dengan pinggul ungu, ekor merah tua, kaki biru, dan setinggi bahu Fionn; sumber lain menyebut Bran bertelinga merah, berpunggung hijau dan berkaki kuning. Bran biasanya jantan dan Sceólang betina.
long_description.en: Bran and Sceólang, 'raven' and 'survivor', are Fionn mac Cumhaill's hounds in the Fenian Cycle of Irish mythology. They are described as mostly white, with purple haunches, a crimson tail and blue feet, standing as high as Fionn's shoulder; other sources give Bran red ears, a green back and yellow feet. Bran is usually male and Sceólang usually female.

long_description.id: Ibu mereka, Uirne, diubah menjadi anjing saat hamil, sehingga anak kembarnya lahir sebagai anjing; Uirne kembali menjadi manusia setelah melahirkan, tetapi Bran dan Sceólang tetap anjing. Karena Uirne saudari ibu Fionn, Muirne, kedua anjing itu sepupu tuannya. Menurut artikel ga, merekalah yang menemukan Oisín, putra Fionn, telanjang di hutan; Sceólang mati saat memburu rusa, dan Bran mati tenggelam setelah dipukul Fionn.
long_description.en: Their mother Uirne was turned into a dog while pregnant, so her twins were born as hounds; Uirne regained human form after the birth, but Bran and Sceólang stayed dogs. Since Uirne was sister to Fionn's mother Muirne, the hounds were their master's cousins. The ga article says they found Fionn's son Oisín naked in the forest; Sceólang died in a deer hunt, and Bran drowned himself after Fionn struck him.

famous_for.en: Fionn's cousins.

did_you_know.en: Bran and Sceólang were Fionn mac Cumhaill's own cousins, since their mother was turned into a dog while pregnant.

note.en: Their master and cousin.

short_description.id: British big cats adalah sebutan untuk laporan penampakan kucing besar liar non-asli di Britania Raya, sering disebut "panther", "puma", atau "kucing hitam".
short_description.en: The term covers claimed sightings, across the United Kingdom, of big wild cats not native to Britain, often called 'panthers', 'pumas' or 'black cats'.

long_description.id: Dalam cerita rakyat dan legenda urban Britania (British folklore), British big cats merujuk pada laporan penampakan kucing besar liar non-asli di Britania Raya (United Kingdom), yang banyak digambarkan sebagai "panther", "puma", atau "black cats". Ada beberapa kasus langka hewan yang ditemukan, sering spesies berukuran sedang seperti lynx Eurasia, dan pada 1980 seekor puma tertangkap hidup di Skotlandia (Scotland). Hewan-hewan ini umumnya diduga peliharaan eksotis ilegal yang kabur atau dilepas, mungkin setelah Dangerous Wild Animals Act 1976.
long_description.en: In British folklore and urban legend, 'British big cats' means reported sightings of wild, non-native big cats in the United Kingdom, often described as 'panthers', 'pumas' or 'black cats'. A few rare animals have actually been recovered, mostly mid-sized species such as the Eurasian lynx, and in 1980 a puma was caught alive in Scotland. These are usually thought to be illegally kept exotic pets that escaped or were set loose, perhaps after the Dangerous Wild Animals Act 1976.

long_description.id: Namun keberadaan populasi "kucing besar sejati", apalagi yang berkembang biak, ditolak para ahli dan pemerintah Britania karena tidak ada bukti meyakinkan; penampakan dari jauh kebanyakan dianggap kucing rumahan yang salah dikira hewan besar. Seorang folklorist menyebutnya "artefak media". Dalam tradisi lebih tua, puisi Wales abad pertengahan Pa Gwr dalam Black Book of Carmarthen menyebut Cath Palug, "kucing Palug", yang berkeliaran di Anglesey sampai dibunuh Cei. Menurut artikel es, ada juga teori bahwa hewan-hewan itu fauna sisa Zaman Es.
long_description.en: Yet the idea of a population of 'true big cats', still less a breeding one, has been rejected by experts and the British government for lack of convincing proof; distant sightings are mostly put down to house cats mistaken for something larger. One folklorist called the sightings a 'media artifact'. Older tradition has the medieval Welsh poem Pa Gwr in the Black Book of Carmarthen naming Cath Palug, 'Palug's cat', which roamed Anglesey until Cei killed it. According to the es article some theories even hold them to be survivors from the Ice Age.

famous_for.en: Puma caught in 1980.

did_you_know.en: In 1980 a puma was caught alive in Scotland, thought to be a released pet.

short_description.id: Naga Brosno atau Brosnya adalah monster danau dalam cerita rakyat Rusia yang konon menghuni Danau Brosno dekat Andreapol, Rusia barat.
short_description.en: The Brosno dragon or Brosnya is a lake monster of Russian folklore said to inhabit Lake Brosno near Andreapol in western Russia.

long_description.id: Naga Brosno, juga dikenal sebagai Brosnya, adalah monster danau yang menurut cerita rakyat Rusia menghuni Danau Brosno dekat Andreapol di Rusia barat. Ia digambarkan mirip naga dan menjadi pokok sejumlah legenda daerah, sebagian disebut berasal dari abad ke-13.
long_description.en: The Brosno dragon, also called Brosnya, is a lake monster that Russian folk tradition places in Lake Brosno near Andreapol in western Russia. It is described as dragon-like and features in several local legends, some reportedly reaching back to the 13th century.

long_description.id: Pada abad ke-18 dan ke-19 beredar kabar bahwa makhluk raksasa itu muncul ke permukaan danau pada senja hari tetapi segera menyelam bila orang mendekat. Konon pada Perang Dunia II ia menelan sebuah pesawat Jerman. Banyak orang meragukan keberadaannya dan menduga makhluk itu berang-berang atau ikan tombak raksasa. Penduduk setempat masih mengaku melihat kadal besar atau mendengar "ia bernapas di bawah air"; kedalaman danau, letaknya yang terpencil, dan gelembung gas dari pembusukan di dasar danau mungkin menjelaskan kisah-kisah itu.
long_description.en: In the 18th and 19th centuries rumour held that the giant creature surfaced on the lake in the evening but dived at once when people came near. It is said to have swallowed a German aeroplane in World War II. Many are sceptical and suggest it may be a beaver or a giant pike. Locals still report seeing a big lizard or hearing "it breathe under water"; the lake's great depth, its remoteness and gas bubbles from decay at the bottom may explain the tales.

short_description.id: Bugbear adalah makhluk legenda atau sejenis hobgoblin, mirip boogeyman, yang dulu dipakai untuk menakut-nakuti anak yang tidak patuh.
short_description.en: The bugbear is a legendary creature or kind of hobgoblin, like the boogeyman, once used to scare disobedient children.

long_description.id: Bugbear adalah makhluk legenda atau sejenis hobgoblin yang sebanding dengan boogeyman (bugaboo, babau, cucuy) dan makhluk folklor lain yang dulu dipakai di sejumlah budaya untuk menakuti anak nakal. Namanya berasal dari kata Inggris Pertengahan "bugge" (sesuatu yang menakutkan), atau mungkin kata Welsh Kuno bwg (roh jahat) atau Skots Kuno bogill (goblin). Di Inggris abad pertengahan, bugbear digambarkan sebagai beruang menyeramkan yang mengintai di hutan untuk menakuti anak-anak.
long_description.en: A bugbear is a legendary creature or sort of hobgoblin akin to the boogeyman (bugaboo, babau, cucuy) and other folk beings once used in various cultures to frighten naughty children. The name comes from Middle English 'bugge', a frightening thing, or perhaps from Old Welsh bwg, 'evil spirit', or Old Scots bogill, 'goblin'. In medieval England the bugbear was imagined as a sinister bear lurking in the woods to frighten children.

long_description.id: Gambaran ini muncul dalam The Buggbears, saduran dari La Spiritata karya Antonio Francesco Grazzini (1561). Artikel ja menyebutnya peri berwujud manusia berbulu lebat, sejenis goblin, yang memakan anak nakal; para ibu menakuti anak-anak bahwa mereka akan dimakan bugbear. Dalam fantasi modern dan permainan peran, bugbear biasanya lawan kecil berupa goblinoid besar berbulu.
long_description.en: This image appears in The Buggbears, adapted from Antonio Francesco Grazzini's La Spiritata (1561). The ja article describes it as a goblin-like fairy in the form of a shaggy person that eats bad children, with mothers warning that the bugbear will eat them. In modern fantasy and role-playing games bugbears are usually minor foes, large hairy goblinoids.

did_you_know.en: In medieval England the bugbear was pictured as a creepy bear stalking children in the woods.

note.en: Comparable child-scaring figure.

short_description.id: Bukavac adalah makhluk iblis dalam mitologi Slavia dari Syrmia, monster berkaki enam yang keluar dari danau pada malam hari untuk mencekik manusia dan hewan.
short_description.en: Bukavac is a demonic creature of Slavic mythology from Syrmia, a six-legged monster that leaves lakes at night to strangle people and animals.

long_description.id: Bukavac adalah makhluk mitis bersifat iblis dalam mitologi Slavia; kepercayaan kepadanya ada di Syrmia. Ia kadang dibayangkan sebagai monster berkaki enam bertanduk bengkok dengan mata biru terang.
long_description.en: Slavic myth knows the bukavac as a demonic being, and people in Syrmia believed in it. Some pictured it with six legs, twisted horns and shining blue eyes.

long_description.id: Ia tinggal di danau dan kolam, keluar dari air pada malam hari sambil membuat suara gaduh, yang menjadi asal namanya dari kata buka, "kebisingan". Ia melompat ke atas manusia dan hewan lalu mencekik mereka. Dalam bahasa Serbia-Kroasia ia juga disebut "banteng air" (vodeni bik).
long_description.en: It lives in lakes and pools and leaves the water at night making a loud noise, which gives it its name from buka, "noise". It jumps on people and animals and strangles them. It is also called the "water bull" (vodeni bik).

statement.id: Bukavac adalah makhluk mitis bersifat iblis dalam mitologi Slavia; kepercayaan kepadanya ada di Syrmia.
statement.en: Bukavac is a demonic mythical creature of Slavic mythology; belief in it existed in Syrmia.

claims.quote: Bukavac was sometimes imagined as a six-legged monster with gnarled horns and bright blue eyes.  It lives in lakes and pools, coming out of the water during the night to make a loud noise (hence the name: buka – noise). It would jump onto people and animals and strangle them.

statement.id: Bukavac kadang dibayangkan sebagai monster berkaki enam bertanduk bengkok dan bermata biru terang; ia tinggal di danau dan kolam, keluar pada malam hari dengan suara gaduh (dari buka, kebisingan), melompat ke manusia dan hewan lalu mencekiknya.
statement.en: Bukavac was sometimes imagined as a six-legged monster with gnarled horns and bright blue eyes; it lives in lakes and pools, comes out at night making a loud noise (buka, noise), and jumps on people and animals to strangle them.

claims.quote: Бу́кавац или Водени бик, воденбика (сербохорв. Букавац, Bukavac «шумящий») — демоническое существо мифологии, похожее на оборотня (вампира). Верования в него зафиксированы в Среме (Сербия, Хорватия).

statement.id: Bukavac atau Vodeni bik ("banteng air"; Bukavac berarti "yang bergemuruh") adalah makhluk iblis mirip manusia serigala atau vampir; kepercayaan kepadanya tercatat di Syrmia (Serbia, Kroasia).
statement.en: Bukavac or Vodeni bik ("water bull"; Bukavac meaning "the noisy one") is a demonic being resembling a werewolf or vampire; belief in it is recorded in Syrmia (Serbia, Croatia).

claims.quote: It would jump onto people and animals and strangle them.

statement.id: Ia melompat ke atas manusia dan hewan lalu mencekik mereka.
statement.en: It would jump on people and animals and strangle them.

claims.quote: Букавац иногда описывается, как шестиногий монстр с оленьими рогами.

statement.id: Bukavac kadang digambarkan sebagai monster berkaki enam bertanduk rusa.
statement.en: Bukavac is sometimes described as a six-legged monster with deer antlers.

claims.quote: Букавац, Буковац, Букало — иносказательно: человек производящий много шума.

statement.id: Secara kiasan, bukavac atau bukalo berarti orang yang sangat berisik.
statement.en: Figuratively, bukavac or bukalo means a person who makes a lot of noise.
