short_description.id: Iara adalah sosok perempuan air dalam mitologi Brasil yang berakar pada tradisi Tupi dan Guaraní, yang menyanyi di sungai dan memikat lelaki ke dasar air.
short_description.en: Iara is a water woman of Brazilian mythology rooted in Tupi and Guaraní tradition who sings in the rivers and lures men to the depths.

long_description.id: Iara adalah tokoh mitologi Brasil yang berakar pada mitologi Tupi dan Guaraní; namanya dari bahasa Nheengatu iiyara, "nyonya air". Ia sejenis siren yang tinggal di sungai atau danau dan menyanyikan lagu yang tak tertahankan pada malam hari, terutama di bawah sinar bulan. Suaranya memikat para lelaki, yang lalu mengikutinya ke kerajaannya di dasar air.
long_description.en: Iara is a figure of Brazilian mythology rooted in Tupi and Guaraní mythology; her name comes from Nheengatu iiyara, "lady of the water". She is a kind of siren who lives in rivers or lakes and sings irresistible songs at night, especially by moonlight. Her voice enchants men, who follow her to her realm at the bottom of the water.

long_description.id: Iara mungkin berkembang dari kisah Ipupiara, manusia ikan pemakan daging, lalu bercampur dengan mitos siren dan putri duyung Eropa. Sebagian penulis meyakini Iara versi asli berkulit gelap dan berambut hitam seperti penduduk asli, tetapi puisi Romantik abad ke-19 memberinya rambut pirang atau hijau dan mata biru atau hijau.
long_description.en: Iara may have grown from the lore of Ipupiara, a carnivorous fish-man, later blended with the European siren and mermaid. Some writers believe the original Iara was dark-skinned and black-haired like the indigenous people, but 19th-century Romantic poetry gave her blonde or green hair and blue or green eyes.

short_description.id: Ichneumon adalah hewan dalam sastra abad pertengahan, musuh naga yang melumuri diri dengan lumpur lalu menyerang naga, buaya, dan ular aspis.
short_description.en: The ichneumon is an animal of medieval literature, the dragon's enemy, which coats itself in mud and then attacks dragons, crocodiles and asps.

long_description.id: Ichneumon, dari bahasa Yunani "pelacak", adalah nama luwak Mesir yang dalam sastra abad pertengahan menjadi musuh naga. Ia melumuri diri dengan lumpur, menutup hidung dengan ekornya, lalu menyerang dan membunuh naga; ia juga melawan buaya dan ular aspis dengan cara sama. Bentuknya seperti musang ferret yang ramping, cepat, dan pandai melompat.
long_description.en: The ichneumon, Greek for 'tracker', was a name for the Egyptian mongoose that medieval literature turned into the dragon's enemy. It coats itself in mud, plugs its nose with its tail, and attacks and kills dragons; it fights crocodiles and asps the same way. It looks like a slim ferret, quick and a good jumper.

long_description.id: Plinius Tua menulis bahwa ia berlapis lumpur kering sebelum bertempur, dan Strabo menyebutnya masuk ke mulut buaya yang berjemur lalu keluar setelah memakan isi perutnya; penduduk Herakleopolis memujanya. Lewat penulis kuno ini, sastra Eropa membuatnya melawan basilisk dan cacatrix.
long_description.en: Pliny the Elder wrote that it armours itself in dried mud before battle, and Strabo that it enters a basking crocodile's mouth and comes out after eating its insides; the people of Heracleopolis worshipped it. Through these ancient writers, European literature set it against the basilisk and the cacatrix.

origin.id: Plinius Tua, Strabo, sastra abad pertengahan.
origin.en: Pliny the Elder, Strabo, medieval literature.

famous_for.en: Its armour of mud.

note.en: A dragon it fights.

claims.quote: In medieval literature, the ichneumon or echinemon was the enemy of the dragon. When it sees a dragon, the ichneumon covers itself with mud, and closing its nostrils with its tail, attacks and kills the dragon.

statement.id: Dalam sastra abad pertengahan, ichneumon atau echinemon adalah musuh naga: ketika melihat naga, ia melumuri diri dengan lumpur, menutup lubang hidungnya dengan ekor, lalu menyerang dan membunuh naga itu.
statement.en: In medieval literature the ichneumon or echinemon was the dragon's enemy: on seeing a dragon it coats itself in mud, closes its nostrils with its tail, and attacks and kills the dragon.

claims.quote: The ichneumon was also considered by some to be the enemy of the crocodile and the asp, and attacks them in the same way. The name was used for the pharaoh's rat, mongoose, or Egyptian mongoose (Herpestes ichneumon), which attacks snakes; it can also mean otter.

statement.id: Sebagian penulis juga menganggapnya musuh buaya dan ular aspis yang diserang dengan cara sama; nama ini dipakai untuk luwak Mesir (Herpestes ichneumon) yang menyerang ular, dan juga dapat berarti berang-berang.
statement.en: Some also thought it the enemy of the crocodile and the asp, attacking them the same way; the name was used for the Egyptian mongoose (Herpestes ichneumon), which attacks snakes, and can also mean otter.

claims.quote: Ichneumon (ἰχνεύμων) means "tracker" in Greek.

statement.id: Ichneumon (ἰχνεύμων) berarti "pelacak" dalam bahasa Yunani.
statement.en: Ichneumon (ἰχνεύμων) means 'tracker' in Greek.

claims.quote: It plunges itself repeatedly into the mud, and then dries itself in the sun: as soon as, by these means, it has armed itself with a sufficient number of coatings, it proceeds to the combat.

statement.id: Menurut Plinius Tua, ia berulang kali mencelupkan diri ke lumpur lalu mengeringkannya di bawah matahari, dan setelah berlapis cukup tebal ia maju bertempur.
statement.en: According to Pliny the Elder it plunges repeatedly into mud and dries in the sun, and once armed with enough coatings it goes into battle.

claims.quote: They lie in wait for the crocodiles, when the latter are basking in the sun with their mouths open; they then drop into their jaws, and eating through their intestines and belly, issue out of the dead body.

statement.id: Menurut Strabo, ichneumon menunggu buaya yang berjemur dengan mulut terbuka, masuk ke rahangnya, lalu memakan usus dan perutnya hingga keluar dari bangkainya.
statement.en: According to Strabo, ichneumons wait for crocodiles basking with open mouths, drop into their jaws, and eat through the guts and belly to come out of the dead body.

claims.quote: but the Heracleotæ worship the ichneumon, which is most destructive both to crocodiles and asps.

statement.id: Strabo mencatat penduduk Herakleopolis memuja ichneumon, pembasmi buaya dan ular aspis.
statement.en: Strabo records that the people of Heracleopolis worship the ichneumon, the great destroyer of crocodiles and asps.

claims.quote: The ichneumon is shaped similarly to a ferret, although much slimmer in its shape, and the head is elongated. Also, it is an animal that can move swiftly and is able to jump a couple of yards with a single leap.

statement.id: Bentuknya mirip musang ferret tetapi jauh lebih ramping dengan kepala memanjang, bergerak cepat dan dapat melompat beberapa meter sekali loncat.
statement.en: It is shaped like a ferret but much slimmer, with an elongated head, moves swiftly and can leap a couple of yards in one bound.

claims.quote: Par l’intermédiaire des chroniqueurs antiques, notamment Pline l’Ancien, il sera ponctuellement associé à d’autres animaux dans la littérature médiévale européenne où il affrontera des dragons comme le basilic ou la cacatrix.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Prancis, lewat penulis kuno seperti Plinius Tua, dalam sastra Eropa abad pertengahan ia dikaitkan dengan hewan lain dan melawan naga seperti basilisk atau cacatrix.
statement.en: According to the French article, through ancient writers such as Pliny the Elder it was linked in medieval European literature with other animals and fought dragons such as the basilisk or the cacatrix.

claims.quote: L’animal était utilisé par les Égyptiens et les indiens dans les périodes anciennes pour se débarrasser des serpents venimeux, comme le cobra, ou encore d’autres reptiles comme les crocodiles.

statement.id: Hewan ini dipakai orang Mesir dan India pada masa kuno untuk menyingkirkan ular berbisa seperti kobra dan reptil lain seperti buaya.
statement.en: The animal was used by Egyptians and Indians in ancient times to get rid of venomous snakes such as the cobra and other reptiles such as crocodiles.

claims.quote: En la literatura medieval, l'ichneumon o echinemon era l'enemic del drac.

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Katalan juga menyebut ichneumon atau echinemon musuh naga dalam sastra abad pertengahan.
statement.en: The Catalan article likewise calls the ichneumon or echinemon the enemy of the dragon in medieval literature.

short_description.id: Iku-Turso adalah makhluk mitologi Finlandia yang merujuk pada satu atau beberapa raksasa; dalam Kalevala ia monster laut yang jahat.
short_description.en: Iku-Turso refers to one or more giants of Finnish mythology; in the Kalevala it is a malevolent sea monster.

long_description.id: Iku-Turso, juga dikenal sebagai Iku-Tursas, Meritursas, Tursas, atau Turisas, merujuk pada satu atau beberapa raksasa dalam mitologi Finlandia, dan dalam Kalevala ia tampil sebagai monster laut yang jahat. Nama Turisas kemungkinan kata pinjaman awal dari bahasa Proto-Jermanik yang berarti "raksasa". Para ahli belum sepakat apakah berbagai penyebutan Tursas dalam lagu-lagu runik merujuk pada satu makhluk atau beberapa.
long_description.en: Iku-Turso, also called Iku-Tursas, Meritursas, Tursas or Turisas, refers to one or several giants of Finnish mythology, and in the Kalevala appears as a malevolent sea monster. The name Turisas is probably an early loan from Proto-Germanic meaning "giant". Scholars do not agree whether the various mentions of Tursas in runic songs mean one being or several.

long_description.id: Wujudnya tidak pasti, tetapi ia dikaitkan dengan sejumlah julukan: partalainen ("yang tinggal di tepi" atau "yang berjanggut"), Tuonen härkä ("lembu Tuoni"), tuhatpää ("berkepala seribu"), dan tuhatsarvi ("bertanduk seribu"). Satu lagu menyebut Meri-Tursas ("Tursas Laut") menghamili Loviatar, Gadis dari Utara, melalui ombak ketika ia mencari kelegaan di air, sehingga Loviatar melahirkan penyakit-penyakit dunia.
long_description.en: Its looks are uncertain, but epithets attached to it include partalainen (a dweller on the brink, or else a bearded one), Tuonen härkä (Tuoni's ox), tuhatpää (having a thousand heads) and tuhatsarvi (having a thousand horns). One song tells how Meri-Tursas, "Sea Tursas", impregnated Loviatar, the Maiden of North, through the waves as she sought relief in the water, so that she gave birth to the diseases of the world.

long_description.id: Dalam daftar dewa Tavastia yang disusun Mikael Agricola pada 1551, Turisas disebut dewa perang yang memberi kemenangan. Ada usulan bahwa dewa itu sama dengan Tyr, dewa perang Skandinavia, tetapi teori ini kini tidak banyak didukung. Menurut Anna-Leena Siikala, Turisas dan Tursas mungkin semula dua makhluk berbeda yang kemudian tercampur dalam lagu-lagu runik.
long_description.en: In the list of Tavastian gods compiled by Mikael Agricola in 1551, Turisas is named as the god of war who brought victory. It has been suggested that this god is the same as the Scandinavian war god Tyr, but the theory is not widely supported today. According to Anna-Leena Siikala, Turisas and Tursas were probably originally two different beings who became mixed in runic songs.

short_description.id: Incubus adalah iblis lelaki dalam cerita rakyat yang muncul dalam mimpi perempuan untuk merayunya, menguras kesehatannya, dan konon menjadi ayah Merlin.
short_description.en: The incubus is a male demon of folklore who appears in women's dreams to seduce them, drains their health and is said to have fathered Merlin.

long_description.id: Incubus, dari bahasa Latin incubō, "yang menindih orang tidur", adalah iblis lelaki yang muncul dalam mimpi perempuan untuk merayunya; hubungan berulang dengannya dapat melahirkan kambion tetapi merusak kesehatan bahkan membunuh. Ia konon dapat menyusup sebagai kelelawar, dan penyihir Merlin dikatakan anaknya. Kepercayaan ini didorong mimpi basah dan kelumpuhan tidur; kini ia sering digambarkan sebagai lelaki tampan.
long_description.en: The incubus, from Latin incubō, 'what lies on one while asleep', is a male demon who appears in women's dreams to seduce them; repeated unions can produce a cambion but ruin health or kill. He is said to slip in as a bat, and the magician Merlin was called his son. The belief was driven by wet dreams and sleep paralysis; today he is often drawn as a handsome man.

long_description.id: Jejaknya sudah ada di Mesopotamia: Daftar Raja Sumeria sekitar 2400 SM menyebut Lilu, perayu perempuan dalam tidur, sebagai ayah Gilgamesh, dan Idlu lili mendatangi perempuan pada malam hari. Agustinus mencatat bahwa roh hutan Silvanus dan Faunus disebut incubi.
long_description.en: Its roots reach Mesopotamia: the Sumerian King List of c. 2400 BC names Lilu, seducer of sleeping women, as Gilgamesh's father, and Idlu lili visits women by night. Augustine records that the forest spirits Silvanus and Faunus were called incubi.

literal_meaning.en: what lies on one while asleep

famous_for.en: Merlin's father.

note.en: His female counterpart.
A similar Mesopotamian demon.

claims.quote: An incubus ... incubi) is a male demon who is described in various folklore as appearing in the dreams of female humans in order to seduce them.

statement.id: Incubus (jamak: incubi) adalah iblis lelaki yang dalam berbagai cerita rakyat muncul dalam mimpi perempuan untuk merayu mereka.
statement.en: An incubus (plural incubi) is a male demon said in various folklore to appear in women's dreams to seduce them.

claims.quote: Pembentukan dan kelestarian hubungan semacam itu memungkinkan lahirnya anak hibrida yang dikenal sebagai kambion

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Indonesia, hubungan yang berulang dengan incubus dapat melahirkan anak hibrida yang disebut kambion.
statement.en: According to the Indonesian article, a lasting relationship with an incubus can produce a hybrid child called a cambion.

claims.quote: In modern representations, an incubus is often depicted as a handsome man seducer or charming, rather than as demonic or frightening, to attract people instead of repulsing them. The female counterpart of the incubus is the succubus.

statement.id: Dalam gambaran modern, incubus sering tampil sebagai lelaki tampan penggoda, bukan iblis menakutkan; padanan perempuannya adalah succubus.
statement.en: In modern depictions the incubus is often a handsome seducer rather than a frightening demon; his female counterpart is the succubus.

claims.quote: Historically, folkloric belief in incubi was motivated by distressing nighttime phenomena, chiefly wet dreams and sleep paralysis.

statement.id: Kepercayaan pada incubi didorong gejala malam yang meresahkan, terutama mimpi basah dan kelumpuhan tidur.
statement.en: Belief in incubi was driven by distressing night phenomena, chiefly wet dreams and sleep paralysis.

claims.quote: Legendary magician Merlin was said to have been fathered by an incubus. Walter Stephens writes in his book Demon Lovers that some traditions hold that repeated sexual activity with an incubus or succubus may result in the deterioration of health, an impaired mental state, or even death.

statement.id: Penyihir legendaris Merlin konon anak incubus, dan Walter Stephens dalam Demon Lovers menulis bahwa menurut sebagian tradisi hubungan berulang dengan incubus atau succubus dapat merusak kesehatan, jiwa, bahkan menyebabkan kematian.
statement.en: The legendary magician Merlin was said to be an incubus's son, and Walter Stephens writes in Demon Lovers that some traditions hold repeated relations with an incubus or succubus may ruin health and mind or even kill.

claims.quote: The Late Latin word incubus ("a nightmare induced by a demon") is derived from Latin incubō ("nightmare, what lies down on one whilst one sleeps") and further from incubāre ("to lie upon, to hatch").

statement.id: Kata Latin Akhir incubus, "mimpi buruk yang ditimbulkan iblis", berasal dari incubō, "yang menindih orang tidur", dan incubāre, "berbaring di atas".
statement.en: The Late Latin incubus, 'a demon-induced nightmare', comes from incubō, 'what lies on one while asleep', and incubāre, 'to lie upon'.

claims.quote: One of the earliest evident mentions of a demon sharing qualities with an incubus comes from Mesopotamia on the Sumerian King List, circa 2400 BC, where the hero Gilgamesh's father is listed as Lilu. Lilu is described as "disturbing" and "seducing" women in their sleep

statement.id: Salah satu sebutan tertua iblis mirip incubus ada dalam Daftar Raja Sumeria dari Mesopotamia sekitar 2400 SM, yang mencantumkan Lilu, iblis yang mengganggu dan merayu perempuan dalam tidur, sebagai ayah pahlawan Gilgamesh.
statement.en: One of the earliest mentions of an incubus-like demon is on the Sumerian King List from Mesopotamia, c. 2400 BC, naming Lilu, who 'disturbs' and 'seduces' sleeping women, as the father of the hero Gilgamesh.

claims.quote: Two other corresponding demons also appear in Mesopotamian accounts: Ardat lili, who visits men by night, and Idlu lili, a male counterpart to Ardat lili who visits women by night and begets from them.

statement.id: Catatan Mesopotamia juga menyebut Ardat lili yang mendatangi lelaki pada malam hari dan Idlu lili, padanan lelakinya, yang mendatangi perempuan dan membuat mereka hamil.
statement.en: Mesopotamian accounts also name Ardat lili, who visits men by night, and Idlu lili, her male counterpart, who visits women by night and begets on them.

claims.quote: 古くはアウグスティヌス『神の国』第15巻23章に、森の精霊シルウァーヌスやファウヌスはインキュバスと呼ばれ、しばしば女性を襲って欲望を満たす、という当時の俗信についての記述がある。

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Jepang, Agustinus dalam De Civitate Dei buku 15 bab 23 mencatat kepercayaan masa itu bahwa roh hutan Silvanus dan Faunus disebut incubi dan sering menyerang perempuan.
statement.en: According to the Japanese article, Augustine in The City of God (book 15, chapter 23) records the belief of his time that the forest spirits Silvanus and Faunus were called incubi and often assailed women.

claims.quote: どちらも、自分と性交したくてたまらなくさせるために、襲われる人の理想の異性像で、服を着ず下半身は裸で現れる。そのため、その誘惑を拒否することは非常に困難だった。人の形態をとるだけでなく、標的となった人間の寝室には蝙蝠に化けて侵入するともされている。

statement.id: Incubus dan succubus muncul sebagai sosok lawan jenis idaman korbannya sehingga godaannya sangat sulit ditolak, dan selain berwujud manusia mereka konon menyusup ke kamar korban dalam wujud kelelawar.
statement.en: Incubi and succubi appear as their victim's ideal partner, so their temptation is very hard to refuse, and besides human form they are said to slip into the victim's bedroom as bats.

short_description.id: Karnabo adalah makhluk cerita rakyat Ardennes yang berhidung belalai dan bermata basilisk, yang napasnya melumpuhkan dan tinggal di tambang sabak.
short_description.en: The Karnabo is a creature of Ardennes folklore with a trunk for a nose and basilisk eyes, whose breath paralyses and who lives in a slate quarry.

long_description.id: Karnabo adalah makhluk cerita rakyat Ardennes, keturunan iblis atau ghoul dan seorang pengembara Bohemia yang mewariskan kekuatannya, termasuk membuat mantra dan menyembuhkan kurap kuku pada Jumat Agung. Ia mirip manusia tetapi berhidung belalai gajah, bermata kuning basilisk, dan berkulit gelap kasar; napas dan siulannya melumpuhkan manusia dan membunuh hewan.
long_description.en: The Karnabo is a creature of Ardennes folklore, offspring of a demon or ghoul and a Bohemian traveller who passed on his powers, including spell-making and curing whitlow on Good Friday. It looks like a man but has an elephant's trunk, yellow basilisk eyes and dark rough skin; its breath and whistle paralyse people and kill animals.

long_description.id: Ia lama tinggal di tambang sabak terbengkalai dekat Regniowez dan konon menculik seorang gadis; saat badai rintihan gadis itu dan lengkingan Karnabo masih terdengar.
long_description.en: It long lived in an abandoned slate quarry near Regniowez and is said to have abducted a girl; during storms her moans and the Karnabo's trumpeting can still be heard.

famous_for.en: Paralysing breath.

note.en: It has a basilisk's eyes.

claims.quote: The Karnabo is a creature of Ardennes folklore.  It is reputedly the offspring of a supernatural entity (either a demon or a ghoul) and a Bohemian traveller (sometimes said to be a sorcerer).

statement.id: Karnabo adalah makhluk cerita rakyat Ardennes, konon keturunan makhluk gaib (iblis atau ghoul) dan seorang pengembara Bohemia (kadang disebut penyihir).
statement.en: The Karnabo is a creature of Ardennes folklore, said to be the offspring of a supernatural being (a demon or ghoul) and a Bohemian traveller (sometimes called a sorcerer).

claims.quote: The Karnabo resembles a man but with an elephant's trunk for a nose and the eyes of a basilisk.  The breath of the creature is said to be able to paralyse men and kill animals.

statement.id: Karnabo mirip manusia tetapi berhidung belalai gajah dan bermata basilisk; napasnya konon dapat melumpuhkan manusia dan membunuh hewan.
statement.en: The Karnabo looks like a man but with an elephant's trunk for a nose and a basilisk's eyes; its breath can paralyse people and kill animals.

claims.quote: It is said to have abducted a young girl and folklore states that her moans and trumpet of the creature can be heard during thunderstorms.

statement.id: Ia konon menculik seorang gadis, dan saat badai petir rintihan gadis itu dan lengkingan makhluk itu masih terdengar.
statement.en: It is said to have abducted a young girl, and her moans and the creature's trumpeting can be heard during thunderstorms.

claims.quote: Before leaving the area for good he passed some of his powers onto the Karnabo, including the making of spells and the ability to cure whitlow on Good Friday.

statement.id: Sebelum pergi, sang Bohemia mewariskan sebagian kekuatannya kepada Karnabo, termasuk membuat mantra dan menyembuhkan kurap kuku pada Jumat Agung.
statement.en: Before leaving for good, the Bohemian passed some powers to the Karnabo, including spell-making and curing whitlow on Good Friday.

claims.quote: By one account it resided for a long time in an abandoned slate quarry near Regniowez.

statement.id: Menurut satu kisah ia lama tinggal di tambang batu sabak terbengkalai dekat Regniowez.
statement.en: By one account it lived for a long time in an abandoned slate quarry near Regniowez.

claims.quote: Il a une tête presque humaine, mais possède une trompe de laquelle sort son sifflement strident, des yeux jaune de basilic et une peau sombre et rugueuse comme les parois de l'ardoisière ou il vit.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Prancis, kepalanya hampir manusia, tetapi berbelalai yang mengeluarkan siulan melengking, bermata kuning basilisk, dan berkulit gelap kasar seperti dinding tambang sabak tempatnya tinggal.
statement.en: According to the French article, its head is almost human, but it has a trunk that gives out a shrill whistle, yellow basilisk eyes and dark, rough skin like the walls of its slate quarry.

short_description.id: Knucker adalah naga air dalam folklor Sussex, Inggris, yang hidup di kolam dalam bernama knuckerhole.
short_description.en: The knucker is a water dragon of Sussex folklore in England, dwelling in deep pools called knuckerholes.

long_description.id: Knucker adalah kata dialek untuk sejenis naga air yang hidup di knuckerhole di Sussex, Inggris. Kata ini berasal dari bahasa Inggris Kuno nicor, "monster air", yang dipakai dalam puisi Beowulf. Knucker dikatakan bersayap dan kadang digambarkan sebagai ular laut. Knuckerhole adalah kolam bundar yang sangat dalam, dianggap tak berdasar; knucker dipercaya ada di Binsted, Lyminster, Lancing, Shoreham dan Worthing. Artikel de menjelaskan kolam itu sebagai mata air di tanah kapur yang suhunya tetap, berkabut tipis saat udara beku.
long_description.en: Knucker is a dialect name for a kind of water dragon living in knuckerholes in Sussex, England. It derives from Old English nicor, 'water monster', a word found in the poem Beowulf. The knucker is said to be winged and is sometimes pictured as a sea serpent. A knuckerhole is a deep round pool thought to have no bottom; knuckers were believed to live at Binsted, Lyminster, Lancing, Shoreham and Worthing. The de article explains these pools as chalk springs of constant temperature that give off thin mist in frosty air.

long_description.id: Knucker paling terkenal tinggal di Lyminster dan memangsa ternak serta penduduk. Dalam satu versi, seorang ksatria pengembara membunuhnya setelah Raja Sussex menjanjikan putrinya; batu nisan ksatria itu, Slayer's Slab, ada di gereja Lyminster. Versi lain menyebut pemuda petani Jim Pulk (atau Jim Puttock) yang, demi hadiah dari Wali Kota Arundel, membunuh naga itu dengan pai beracun raksasa lalu memenggal kepalanya.
long_description.en: The most famous knucker lived at Lyminster and devoured livestock and villagers. In one version a knight-errant killed it after the King of Sussex promised his daughter to its slayer, and the knight's gravestone, the Slayer's Slab, lies in Lyminster church. Another version credits a farm lad, Jim Pulk or Jim Puttock, who for a reward from the Mayor of Arundel fed the dragon a huge poisoned pie and then cut off its head.

famous_for.en: Killed with a poisoned pie.

did_you_know.id: Menurut satu legenda, knucker Lyminster dibunuh dengan pai beracun raksasa yang dibawa dengan kereta kuda.
did_you_know.en: In one legend the Lyminster knucker was killed with a giant poisoned pie brought on a horse and cart.

description.en: Home of the most famous knucker.

description.id: Daerah legenda knucker.
description.en: Region of the knucker legend.

claims.quote: Knucker is a dialect word for a sort of water dragon, living in knuckerholes in Sussex, England. The word comes from the Old English nicor which means "water monster" and is used in the poem Beowulf. It may also be related to the word "nixie"

statement.id: Naga air dialek Sussex, Inggris (England), di knuckerhole; dari kata Inggris Kuno (Old English) nicor, monster air, dalam Beowulf.
statement.en: A water dragon of Sussex dialect, England, in knuckerholes; from Old English nicor, water monster, used in Beowulf.

claims.quote: The knucker is said to have wings, and is sometimes described as a sea serpent.

statement.id: Knucker bersayap, kadang digambarkan sebagai ular laut.
statement.en: The knucker has wings and is sometimes described as a sea serpent.

claims.quote: One version has the dragon slain by a knight-errant after the king of Sussex offered his daughter's hand in marriage to whoever rid them of the beast. Legend says that after marrying the princess, the knight settled in Lyminster and his gravestone, the Slayer's Slab, can be seen in Lyminster church.

statement.id: Ksatria pengembara membunuhnya atas janji Raja Sussex; Slayer's Slab di gereja Lyminster; knucker memangsa ternak dan penduduk.
statement.en: A knight-errant slew it at the King of Sussex's offer; the Slayer's Slab in Lyminster church; it ate livestock and villagers.

claims.quote: An alternative legend has the dragon outwitted by a local farmer's boy, called Jim Pulk or Jim Puttock, said in some versions to be from Wick, after the Mayor of Arundel offered a reward. He killed the dragon by cooking it a giant poisoned pie

statement.id: Jim Pulk atau Jim Puttock, hadiah Wali Kota (Mayor) Arundel, membunuh naga dengan pai beracun raksasa dan memenggal kepalanya; dibawa dengan kereta kuda.
statement.en: Jim Pulk or Jim Puttock, for the Mayor of Arundel's reward, killed the dragon with a giant poisoned pie and beheaded it; brought on a horse and cart.

claims.quote: It was believed that knuckers could be found at knuckerholes in various places in Sussex, including Binsted, Lyminster, Lancing, Shoreham and Worthing. A knucker hole is a very deep round pool, which is considered to be infinitely deep.

statement.id: Knuckerhole di Binsted, Lyminster, Lancing, Shoreham, Worthing; kolam bundar dalam tak berdasar.
statement.en: Knuckerholes at Binsted, Lyminster, Lancing, Shoreham, Worthing; deep round bottomless pools.

claims.quote: Der Knucker ist ein schlangenartiger Wasserdrache aus Sagen in der südenglischen Grafschaft Sussex.

statement.en: de article: a serpentine water dragon of Sussex; constant-temperature chalk spring pools that mist in frost.

claims.quote: Bei frostigen Lufttemperaturen bildet sich dünner Nebel über dem Wasser, was zur Legendenbildung um die Knucker beigetragen hat.

short_description.id: Konrul adalah burung raksasa berumur panjang dalam mitologi Turkik yang lahir kembali seperti phoenix dan menolong pahlawan dengan bulunya.
short_description.en: Konrul is a giant, long-lived bird of Turkic mythology that is reborn like the phoenix and helps heroes with its feathers.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Turkik, Konrul adalah burung berumur panjang yang terus-menerus lahir kembali, seperti phoenix. Ia digambarkan cukup besar untuk membawa gajah, berwujud merak berkepala anjing dan bercakar singa, kadang berwajah manusia. Ia bermusuhan dengan ular, hidup di tempat yang banyak air, dan memiliki kembaran bernama Toghrul.
long_description.en: In Turkic mythology Konrul is a long-lived bird that is reborn again and again, like the phoenix. It is pictured as big enough to carry off an elephant, a peacock with a dog's head and lion's claws, sometimes with a human face. It is hostile to snakes, lives where water is plentiful and has a twin named Toghrul.

long_description.id: Dalam satu kisah, seorang pahlawan membunuh ular yang hendak memangsa anak-anak Konrul. Sebagai hadiah ia menerima tiga bulu untuk dibakar bila butuh pertolongan, dan Konrul kemudian membawanya ke negeri jauh. Dalam kisah lain Konrul membawa pahlawan keluar dari dunia bawah.
long_description.en: In one tale a hero kills a serpent about to eat Konrul's young. As a reward he receives three feathers to burn when he needs help, and Konrul later carries him to a distant land. In another tale Konrul carries the hero out of the underworld.

short_description.id: Kratt adalah makhluk ajaib pembawa harta dalam mitologi Estonia, dibuat dari jerami atau perkakas tua dan dihidupkan dengan tiga tetes darah yang diberikan kepada Iblis.
short_description.en: The kratt is a magical treasure-bearing creature of Estonian mythology, made of hay or old tools and brought to life with three drops of blood given to the Devil.

long_description.id: Kratt, juga disebut pisuhänd, puuk, tulihänd, atau vedaja, adalah makhluk ajaib pembawa harta dalam mitologi Estonia. Pemiliknya membuatnya dari jerami atau perkakas rumah tangga lama, lalu memberi Iblis tiga tetes darah agar kratt hidup. Dalam cerita rakyat ia terbang sebagai pancaran api atau percikan sambil mengangkut berbagai harta seperti gandum, pakaian, dan uang.
long_description.en: The kratt, also known as pisuhänd, puuk, tulihänd or vedaja, is a treasure-carrying magical being in Estonian myth. Its owner shaped it from hay or worn-out household tools and then gave the Devil three drops of blood to make it live. In folk belief it flies about as a streak of fire or sparks, hauling goods such as grain, clothing and money.

long_description.id: Kratt melakukan apa pun yang diperintahkan tuannya, terutama mencuri barang untuknya. Ia harus terus diberi pekerjaan; bila menganggur ia menjadi berbahaya bagi pemiliknya. Untuk menyingkirkannya, sang tuan memberinya tugas mustahil seperti membuat tangga dari roti, hingga kratt yang terbuat dari jerami itu terbakar habis. Dalam astronomi rakyat, bola api meteor dianggap kratt yang marah karena diberi tugas mustahil.
long_description.en: The kratt does whatever its master commands, mostly stealing goods for him. It must be kept busy at all times; left idle, it turns on its owner. To be rid of it, the master sets it an impossible task such as building a ladder of bread, until the hay creature catches fire and burns away. In folk astronomy a fireball meteor was taken for a kratt enraged by an impossible job.

short_description.id: Kulshedra atau kuçedra adalah iblis air, badai, api, dan dunia bawah dalam mitologi Albania, biasanya naga ular betina raksasa berkepala banyak.
short_description.en: Albanian lore pictures the kulshedra (kuçedra) as a giant she-dragon of many serpent heads, a demon of water, storms, fire and the depths of the earth.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi dan cerita rakyat Albania, kulshedra atau kuçedra adalah iblis air, badai, api, dan dunia bawah, biasanya digambarkan sebagai naga ular betina raksasa berkepala banyak. Ia arketipe kegelapan dan kejahatan, lawan sekaligus pelengkap drangue. Ia dipercaya menyemburkan api serta menimbulkan kekeringan, badai, banjir, dan gempa bumi.
long_description.en: Albanian myth and folklore describe the kulshedra or kuçedra as a demon of water, storm, fire and the underworld, usually a vast many-headed she-dragon in serpent form. She embodies darkness and evil, the counterpart and foe of the drangue. She is thought to breathe fire and bring drought, storms, floods and earthquakes.

long_description.id: Ia biasanya dilawan dan dikalahkan drangue, dan badai petir besar dianggap akibat pertempuran mereka. Tahap awalnya adalah bolla, ular iblis yang matanya tertutup sepanjang tahun kecuali pada Hari Santo Georgius; bila bolla hidup bertahun-tahun tanpa terlihat manusia, ia berubah menjadi kulshedra. Kulshedra juga bisa menyamar sebagai perempuan.
long_description.en: She is usually fought and beaten by the drangue, and heavy thunderstorms are thought to come from their battles. Her early stage is the bolla, a demonic serpent whose eyes stay shut all year except on Saint George's Day; if the bolla lives the set number of years unseen by humans, it becomes a kulshedra. A kulshedra can also go about disguised as a woman.

long_description.id: Ia digambarkan sebagai naga betina berwujud ular berkepala banyak, dengan payudara menjuntai sampai ke tanah, tubuh berbulu merah, ekor panjang, dan tujuh sampai dua belas kepala. Namanya berasal dari bahasa Latin chersydrus, dari bahasa Yunani, yang kira-kira berarti "ular amfibi". Dalam dongeng ia menguasai mata air dan memakan orang yang mendekatinya. Desa tempat kulshedra tinggal dikatakan makmur karena napasnya menyerap bahan makanan dari mana-mana.
long_description.en: She is pictured as a many-headed serpentine she-dragon with drooping breasts that touch the ground, red woolly hair, a long tail and seven to twelve heads. Her name comes from Latin chersydrus, from Greek, roughly "amphibious snake". In folk tales she seizes water springs and eats anyone who comes near them. The village where a kulshedra lives is said to prosper, as her breath draws in foodstuffs from everywhere.

short_description.id: La Guita Xica adalah naga setengah bagal dari legenda Katalonia yang awalnya dianggap iblis, kini naga pelindung yang menyemburkan kembang api dalam pesta Patum de Berga.
short_description.en: La Guita Xica is a half-mule dragon of Catalan legend, once thought a demon and now a protective dragon spitting fireworks at the Patum de Berga.

long_description.id: La Guita Xica adalah naga legenda Katalonia sejak 1890, dengan banyak nama seperti Mulaguita, La Mulassa, dan Guita Boja. Nama Mulassa berasal dari mulassas, "bagal raksasa", hibrida bagal-naga; artikel bahasa Rusia dan Jepang menyebut namanya berarti bagal yang menendang. Ia bertubuh hijau seperti kuda, berleher sangat panjang, dan bertaring.
long_description.en: La Guita Xica is a dragon of Catalan legend from 1890, with many names such as Mulaguita, La Mulassa and Guita Boja. Mulassa comes from mulassas, 'monstrous mules', mule-dragon hybrids; the Russian and Japanese articles say its name means a kicking mule. It has a green horse-like body, a very long neck and fangs.

long_description.id: Awalnya ia dianggap iblis atau kekuatan mengancam, tetapi kini menjadi naga pelindung rakyat Katalonia dan pesta Patum de Berga. Dalam pesta itu figur naga besar dibuat di alun-alun dan menyemburkan kembang api, dan konon melindungi peserta dari roh jahat.
long_description.en: It was first a demon or threatening force but is now a protective dragon of the Catalan people and of the Patum de Berga. At the festival large dragon figures are built in the squares and spit fireworks, and are said to guard participants from evil spirits.

short_description.id: Monster Danau Van adalah monster danau dalam cerita rakyat Armenia dan Turki yang konon hidup di Danau Van, Turki timur.
short_description.en: The Lake Van Monster is a lake monster of Armenian and Turkish folklore said to live in Lake Van in eastern Turkey.

long_description.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Armenia dan Turki, Monster Danau Van adalah monster danau yang konon tinggal di Danau Van, Turki timur. Penulis kronik Armenia Movses Khorenatsi dan Anania Shirakatsi menulis tentang vishap (naga air dalam mitologi Armenia) yang tinggal di danau itu. Menurut mitos, dewa Vahagn, sang vishapakagh ("penuai vishap"), terjun ke Danau Van untuk menyeret keluar vishap yang sudah cukup besar untuk melahap dunia.
long_description.en: Armenian and Turkish folk tradition place the Lake Van Monster in Lake Van, in the east of Turkey. The Armenian chroniclers Movses Khorenatsi and Anania Shirakatsi wrote of vishaps, the water dragons of Armenian myth, living in the lake. In myth the god Vahagn, the vishapakagh ("reaper of vishaps"), would dive into Lake Van to haul out any vishap grown big enough to swallow the world.

long_description.id: James Russell mencatat bahwa hingga zaman modern orang Armenia di lembah Van menyebut badai mendadak di danau itu vishap kami, "angin naga". Surat kabar Utsmaniyah Saadet pada 29 April 1889 memberitakan makhluk yang konon menyeret seorang lelaki ke danau; pemerintah Utsmaniyah lalu mengirim tim survei ilmiah, yang tidak berhasil melihat makhluk itu. Russell menganggap kisah Vahagn sebagai adopsi Armenia atas mitos Urartu tentang dewa Teisheba yang melawan monster air.
long_description.en: James Russell notes that into modern times the Armenians of the Van basin called the sudden storms on the lake vishap kami, "dragon wind". The Ottoman newspaper Saadet reported on 29 April 1889 that a creature had dragged a man into the lake; the Ottoman government sent a scientific survey, which failed to spot it. Russell sees the Vahagn story as an Armenian borrowing of Urartian myths of the god Teisheba fighting a water monster.

claims.quote: The Armenian chroniclers Movses Khorenatsi and Anania Shirakatsi wrote about vishaps (water dragons in Armenian mythology) living in Lake Van. According to the myth, the god Vahagn, the vishapakagh ("reaper of vishaps"), would plunge into Lake Van to drag out any vishap that had grown large enough to devour the world.

statement.id: Penulis kronik Armenia Movses Khorenatsi dan Anania Shirakatsi menulis tentang vishap (naga air mitologi Armenia) di Danau Van; menurut mitos dewa Vahagn, sang vishapakagh ("penuai vishap"), terjun ke danau untuk menyeret keluar vishap yang cukup besar untuk melahap dunia.
statement.en: The Armenian chroniclers Movses Khorenatsi and Anania Shirakatsi wrote of vishaps (Armenian water dragons) in Lake Van; in myth the god Vahagn, the vishapakagh ("reaper of vishaps"), plunged into the lake to drag out any vishap large enough to devour the world.

claims.quote: Russell writes that into the modern period, the Armenians of the Van basin would refer to the sudden storms that arise on the lake as vishap kami

statement.id: James Russell menulis bahwa hingga zaman modern orang Armenia di lembah Van menyebut badai mendadak di danau itu vishap kami ("angin naga").
statement.en: James Russell writes that into modern times Armenians of the Van basin called the lake's sudden storms vishap kami ("dragon wind").

claims.quote: A story in the Ottoman newspaper Saadet from 29 April 1889 claimed that a creature had purportedly dragged a man into Lake Van. Following reports of the incident, the Ottoman government sent an official scientific survey group to the lake. The group ultimately failed to spot the alleged animal.

statement.id: Surat kabar Utsmaniyah Saadet tanggal 29 April 1889 memberitakan makhluk yang konon menyeret seorang lelaki ke Danau Van; pemerintah Utsmaniyah mengirim tim survei ilmiah resmi yang tidak berhasil melihat binatang itu.
statement.en: The Ottoman newspaper Saadet of 29 April 1889 reported a creature had dragged a man into Lake Van; the Ottoman government sent an official scientific survey, which failed to spot it.

claims.quote: El monstruo del Lago Van (Turco: Van Gölü Canavarı) es un monstruo de lago que presuntamente habita en el Lago de Van en Turquía oriental.

statement.id: Monster Danau Van (Turki: Van Gölü Canavarı) adalah monster danau yang konon menghuni Danau Van di Turki timur.
statement.en: The Lake Van Monster (Turkish Van Gölü Canavarı) is a lake monster said to inhabit Lake Van in eastern Turkey.

claims.quote: El académico James Russell considera que esta leyenda es una adopción Armenia de los mitos Urartianos respecto al combate del dios Teisheba con el monstruo acuático

statement.id: James Russell menganggap legenda ini adopsi Armenia atas mitos Urartu tentang pertarungan dewa Teisheba dengan monster air.
statement.en: James Russell considers this legend an Armenian adoption of Urartian myths about the god Teisheba fighting a water monster.

short_description.id: Lamia atau lamina adalah roh perempuan cantik berkaki bebek atau ayam dari mitologi Basque yang tinggal di sungai, menyisir rambut dengan sisir emas, dan membangun jembatan pada malam hari.
short_description.en: The lamia or lamina is a beautiful Basque spirit-woman with duck or hen feet who lives in rivers, combs her hair with a golden comb and builds bridges by night.

long_description.id: Dikenal sebagai lamia atau lamina (jamak lamiak atau laminak), makhluk Basque ini mirip siren atau nereid dari mitologi Basque, roh alam berwujud manusia yang tinggal di sungai, mata air, dan gua dan terutama aktif malam hari. Biasanya ia perempuan cantik dengan kaki berselaput, kaki ayam, kuku kambing, atau ekor ikan yang menyisir rambut dengan sisir emas; di pesisir dikenal itsaslamiak berekor ikan, dan kadang ada lamiak laki-laki atau kurcaci yang membangun dolmen.
long_description.en: Known as lamia or lamina (plural lamiak or laminak), this Basque being resembles a siren or nereid; she is a humanlike nature spirit living in rivers, springs and caves and active mainly at night. Usually she is a beautiful woman with webbed feet, hen's feet, goat hooves or a fish tail who combs her hair with a golden comb; the coast knows fish-tailed itsaslamiak, and there are sometimes male or dwarf lamiak who build dolmens.

long_description.id: Lamiak murah hati kepada yang memberi mereka makanan dan membantu membajak ladang. Mereka membangun jembatan pada malam hari dan harus pergi bila belum selesai saat ayam berkokok; banyak lamiak menghilang ketika kapel dibangun di hutan. Mereka juga dipercaya berada di balik pelangi, dan banyak nama tempat seperti Lamikiz dan Lamusin berasal dari mereka.
long_description.en: Lamiak are generous to those who leave them food and help plough their fields. They build bridges by night and must leave if unfinished at cockcrow; many vanished when chapels were built in the forest. They are also believed to dwell beyond rainbows, and many place names such as Lamikiz and Lamusin come from them.

who.en: A river spirit with animal feet.

famous_for.en: Her golden comb.

description.id: Lamiak harus pergi bila jembatannya belum selesai saat ayam berkokok.
description.en: Lamiak must leave if their bridge is unfinished at cockcrow.

description.id: Kebanyakan lamiak menghilang ketika kapel dibangun di hutan.
description.en: Most lamiak vanished when chapels were built in the forest.

claims.quote: The lamia (or lamina) (plural: lamiak or laminak) is a siren or nereid-like creature in Basque mythology. Lamiak are typically portrayed as living in and around rivers.

statement.id: Lamia atau lamina (jamak lamiak atau laminak) adalah makhluk mirip siren atau nereid dalam mitologi Basque yang biasanya tinggal di dalam dan di sekitar sungai.
statement.en: The lamia or lamina (plural lamiak or laminak) is a siren- or nereid-like creature of Basque mythology, usually living in and around rivers.

claims.quote: Mythology in coastal areas includes itsaslamiak, a variety of lamiak who live in the sea and have fish-like tails, similar to a mermaid.

statement.id: Di daerah pesisir dikenal itsaslamiak, lamia yang tinggal di laut dan berekor ikan seperti putri duyung.
statement.en: Coastal areas know the itsaslamiak, sea-dwelling lamiak with fish tails like mermaids.

claims.quote: Basque mythology depicts lamiak as generous, aiding those who give them presents by helping them at work. For example, if a farmer were to leave food for them at the river shore, they would eat it at night and in exchange finish ploughing his field.

statement.id: Lamiak digambarkan murah hati dan membantu pekerjaan orang yang memberi mereka hadiah; misalnya, bila petani meninggalkan makanan di tepi sungai, mereka memakannya malam hari lalu menyelesaikan bajakan ladangnya.
statement.en: Lamiak are generous and help with the work of those who give them gifts; if a farmer leaves food on the riverbank, they eat it at night and finish ploughing his field.

claims.quote: In other myths, lamiak must leave if the bridge that they were building at night remains unfinished at cockcrow. People believed that lamia ... had left a river if a stone in the bridge was missing.

statement.id: Dalam mitos lain, lamiak harus pergi bila jembatan yang mereka bangun malam hari belum selesai saat ayam berkokok, dan batu yang hilang di jembatan dianggap tanda lamiak telah meninggalkan sungai itu.
statement.en: In other myths lamiak must leave if the bridge they build by night is unfinished at cockcrow, and a missing stone in a bridge showed that the lamiak had left that river.

claims.quote: Other beliefs claim that most lamiak disappeared when men built small churches in the forest.

statement.id: Menurut kepercayaan lain, kebanyakan lamiak menghilang ketika orang membangun kapel-kapel kecil di hutan.
statement.en: Other beliefs hold that most lamiak vanished when people built small chapels in the forest.

claims.quote: Lamiak are also believed to be found on the other side of rainbows, where they are combing their hair. It is said that when the sunlight strikes their hair, the rainbow opens.

statement.id: Lamiak juga dipercaya berada di balik pelangi sambil menyisir rambut, dan pelangi terbuka ketika sinar matahari mengenai rambut mereka.
statement.en: Lamiak are also believed to sit beyond rainbows combing their hair, and the rainbow opens when sunlight strikes it.

claims.quote: Mythology also occasionally describes male lamiak. In those stories, they are described as strong and are attributed with the creation of dolmens at night.

statement.id: Kadang ada pula lamiak laki-laki yang kuat dan dianggap membangun dolmen pada malam hari.
statement.en: Sometimes there are male lamiak, strong and credited with building dolmens by night.

claims.quote: Many toponyms relate to lamiak, including Lamikiz (Markina), Laminaputzu (in Zeanuri), Lamitegi (in Bedaio), Lamirain (in Arano), Lamusin (in Sare), Lamiñosin (in Ataun).

statement.id: Banyak nama tempat berkaitan dengan lamiak, seperti Lamikiz (Markina), Laminaputzu (Zeanuri), Lamusin (Sare), dan Lamiñosin (Ataun).
statement.en: Many place names relate to lamiak, such as Lamikiz (Markina), Laminaputzu (Zeanuri), Lamusin (Sare) and Lamiñosin (Ataun).

claims.quote: est le terme basque désignant un être fantastique de la mythologie basque, un esprit de la nature ou un Irelu ou génie d'apparence humaine.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Prancis, lamina adalah istilah Basque untuk makhluk fantastis, roh alam atau genius berwujud manusia.
statement.en: According to the French article, lamina is the Basque term for a fantastic being, a nature spirit or humanlike genie.

claims.quote: Le plus souvent, les laminak sont dépeints soit comme des lutins mâles, des nains (ipotxak ou nanoak), soit comme des femmes de taille normale dont le bas du corps est pourvu de caractéristiques animales (pieds palmés, pattes de poules, sabots de chèvre ou queue de poisson).

statement.id: Laminak paling sering digambarkan sebagai kurcaci laki-laki atau perempuan bertubuh biasa yang bagian bawahnya berciri hewan: kaki berselaput, kaki ayam, kuku kambing, atau ekor ikan.
statement.en: Laminak are most often shown either as male goblins or dwarfs or as normal-sized women whose lower body has animal features: webbed feet, hen's feet, goat hooves or a fish tail.

claims.quote: Créatures essentiellement nocturnes, les laminak vivent sous terre, dans des grottes ou auprès des sources et des ruisseaux.

statement.id: Laminak terutama makhluk malam yang tinggal di bawah tanah, di gua, atau dekat mata air dan sungai kecil.
statement.en: Laminak are mainly nocturnal and live underground, in caves or by springs and streams.

claims.quote: Los seres humanos las ven peinándose el cabello con un peine de oro o, con menos frecuencia, tendiendo y secando su hermoso paño.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Spanyol, manusia melihat mereka menyisir rambut dengan sisir emas atau, lebih jarang, menjemur kain mereka yang indah.
statement.en: According to the Spanish article, people see them combing their hair with a golden comb or, less often, spreading out their beautiful cloth to dry.

claims.quote: En muchas narraciones se la describe como una mujer hermosa que presenta algún rasgo no humano, como patas de gallina, de cabra, de pato o cola de pez, según la zona y la tradición oral concreta.

statement.id: Dalam banyak cerita ia digambarkan sebagai perempuan cantik dengan satu ciri bukan manusia, seperti kaki ayam, kambing, atau bebek, atau ekor ikan, tergantung daerahnya.
statement.en: In many tales she is a beautiful woman with some non-human feature, such as hen's, goat's or duck's feet or a fish tail, depending on the area.

claims.quote: In some places, bridges were believed to have been built at night by lamiak

statement.id: Di beberapa tempat, jembatan dipercaya dibangun oleh lamiak pada malam hari.
statement.en: In some places bridges were believed to have been built by lamiak at night.

short_description.id: Lariosauro adalah monster Danau Como, Italia, yang lahir dari laporan surat kabar rekaan tahun 1946 dan penampakan-penampakan berikutnya.
short_description.en: Lariosauro is the Lake Como monster of Italy, born of a hoaxed newspaper report in 1946 and later sightings.

long_description.id: Lariosauro adalah monster yang konon tinggal di Danau Como. Pada November 1946 Corriere comasco memberitakan dua pemburu melihat monster berkepala jambul sepanjang 2–3 meter bersisik cokelat kemerahan, tetapi berita itu rekaan pers; La Provincia kemudian menyebutnya mungkin ikan sturgeon. Julukannya diambil dari Lariosaurus balsami, reptil prasejarah yang fosilnya ditemukan di danau itu.
long_description.en: Lariosauro is a monster said to live in Lake Como. In November 1946 the Corriere comasco reported two hunters seeing a crested monster 2–3 metres long with reddish-brown scales, but the report was a press hoax; La Provincia later suggested a sturgeon. Its nickname comes from Lariosaurus balsami, a prehistoric reptile whose fossils were found at the lake.

long_description.id: Penampakan lain dilaporkan pada 1954, 1957, dan 2003, termasuk belut raksasa 10–12 m di Lecco, tetapi Giorgio Castiglioni menjelaskannya sebagai berang-berang, rekaan, ikan pike, dan kawanan ikan.
long_description.en: Other sightings were reported in 1954, 1957 and 2003, including a 10–12 m eel at Lecco, but Giorgio Castiglioni explained them as an otter, a hoax, a pike and a shoal of fish.

famous_for.en: The 1946 press hoax.

description.id: Danau tempat Lariosauro konon tinggal.
description.en: The lake Lariosauro is said to inhabit.

description.id: Laporan rekaan pers tentang penampakan monster.
description.en: A press hoax reports the monster.

description.id: Penampakan belut 10–12 m.
description.en: A 10–12 m eel is sighted.

claims.quote: In Italian folklore, Lariosauro is a lake monster said to live in Lake Como in Italy, about 50 km (30 miles) north of Milan.

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Italia, Lariosauro adalah monster danau yang konon tinggal di Danau Como, sekitar 50 km di utara Milan.
statement.en: In Italian folklore Lariosauro is a lake monster said to live in Lake Como, about 50 km (30 miles) north of Milan.

claims.quote: A sighting by two hunters was reported that on 18 November 1946 at Pian di Spagna (a reserve separated from Lake Como), was reported in the local newspaper Corriere comasco, but it was completely a hoax perpetrated by the press.

statement.id: Penampakan oleh dua pemburu pada 18 November 1946 di Pian di Spagna dilaporkan surat kabar Corriere comasco, tetapi sepenuhnya rekaan pers.
statement.en: A sighting by two hunters on 18 November 1946 at Pian di Spagna was reported in the Corriere comasco, but it was entirely a press hoax.

claims.quote: Achille Combi (who wrote the piece in  Corriere comasco) wrote that the crested head of the monster emerged out of water, its body length was 2–3 meters, and "bristling with extremely hard, reddish-brown scales".

statement.id: Achille Combi, penulis berita itu, menyebut kepala monster yang berjambul muncul dari air, panjang tubuhnya 2–3 meter, dan dipenuhi sisik keras berwarna cokelat kemerahan.
statement.en: Achille Combi, who wrote the piece, said the monster's crested head rose from the water, its body was 2–3 metres long and 'bristling with extremely hard, reddish-brown scales'.

claims.quote: La Provincia published a follow-up piece a few days later suggesting it might have been a sturgeon.

statement.id: Beberapa hari kemudian La Provincia menulis bahwa itu mungkin ikan sturgeon.
statement.en: A few days later La Provincia suggested it might have been a sturgeon.

claims.quote: The creature earned the nickname lariosauro, but this was the same name legitimately used a century before to name a prehistoric reptile whose fossilized remains were found by the lake (Lariosaurus balsami).

statement.id: Makhluk itu dijuluki lariosauro, nama yang seabad sebelumnya dipakai untuk reptil prasejarah yang fosilnya ditemukan di tepi danau (Lariosaurus balsami).
statement.en: The creature was nicknamed lariosauro, the name used a century earlier for a prehistoric reptile whose fossils were found by the lake (Lariosaurus balsami).

claims.quote: Skeptic researcher Giorgio Castiglioni, who studied these cases, thinks that the animal of 1954 was an otter, the monster of August 1957 a hoax, the beast of September 1957 possibly a pike, and the 2003 eel was a group of fish swimming together.

statement.id: Peneliti skeptis Giorgio Castiglioni menilai penampakan 1954 adalah berang-berang, monster Agustus 1957 rekaan, binatang September 1957 mungkin ikan pike, dan belut 2003 sekelompok ikan yang berenang bersama.
statement.en: The sceptical researcher Giorgio Castiglioni judged the 1954 animal an otter, the August 1957 monster a hoax, the September 1957 beast possibly a pike and the 2003 eel a group of fish swimming together.

claims.quote: En 2003 se avistó una anguila gigante de unos 10 – 12 m, en Lecco.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Spanyol, pada 2003 terlihat belut raksasa sepanjang 10–12 m di Lecco.
statement.en: According to the Spanish article, in 2003 a giant eel some 10–12 m long was sighted at Lecco.

claims.quote: 1946 m. liudininkai pranešė, kad matė į roplį panašų gyvūną, plaukusį ežere.

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Lituania menyebut pada 1946 saksi melaporkan melihat hewan mirip reptil berenang di danau.
statement.en: The Lithuanian article says that in 1946 witnesses reported seeing a reptile-like animal swimming in the lake.

short_description.id: Lí Ban adalah perempuan yang menjadi putri duyung dalam legenda terbentuknya Lough Neagh, Irlandia, kemudian dibaptis sebagai Santo Muirgen.
short_description.en: Lí Ban is a woman turned mermaid in the legend of the forming of Lough Neagh, Ireland, later baptised as Saint Muirgen.

long_description.id: Lí Ban atau Liban (dari bahasa Irlandia Kuno lí "kecantikan" dan ban "perempuan", berarti "teladan para perempuan") adalah perempuan yang menjadi putri duyung dalam legenda terbentuknya Lough Neagh. Keluarganya tenggelam saat danau besar itu menyembur, tetapi ia selamat setahun dalam ruang di bawah air, lalu berubah menjadi setengah manusia setengah salem. Menurut kisah Aided Echach maic Maireda dalam Lebor na hUidre abad ke-12, danau itu dinamai menurut ayahnya, Eochaid mac Mairidh.
long_description.en: Lí Ban or Liban (Old Irish lí, 'beauty', and ban, 'of women', so 'paragon of women') is a woman turned mermaid in the legend of how Lough Neagh came to be. Her family drowned when the great lake burst up, but she lived a year in an underwater chamber and then became half woman, half salmon. In the tale Aided Echach maic Maireda in the 12th-century Lebor na hUidre, the lake takes its name from her father Eochaid mac Mairidh.

long_description.id: Dalam wujud putri duyung ia terlihat oleh kapal yang membawa utusan St. Comgall ke Roma, berjanji bertemu di Inbhear nOllarbha (Larne Lough) setahun kemudian, dan tertangkap jaring. Ia dibaptis Comgall dengan nama Muirgein ("lahir dari laut") atau Muirgeilt, dan tercatat sebagai Santo Muirgen dengan hari raya 27 Januari. Annals of the Four Masters mencatat penangkapannya pada 558 M. Artikel fi menyebutnya memilih langsung ke surga setelah dibaptis.
long_description.en: In mermaid form she was seen from the ship carrying St. Comgall's messenger to Rome, promised to meet at Inbhear nOllarbha (Larne Lough) a year later, and was caught in a fishnet. Comgall baptised her Muirgein ('sea-born') or Muirgeilt, and she is listed as Saint Muirgen with a feast on 27 January. The Annals of the Four Masters date her capture to 558 AD. The fi article says that after baptism she chose to go straight to heaven.

famous_for.en: Caught in 558 AD.

did_you_know.id: Lí Ban, putri duyung yang dibaptis, tercatat sebagai Santo Muirgen dengan hari raya 27 Januari.
did_you_know.en: Lí Ban, the baptised mermaid, is listed as Saint Muirgen with a feast day of 27 January.

claims.quote: in the legend surrounding the formation of Lough Neagh, was a woman turned mermaid who inhabited the area before the great lake gushed up on dry land.

statement.id: Lí Ban (Liban; lí kecantikan + ban perempuan, Irlandia Kuno), perempuan menjadi putri duyung, legenda Lough Neagh, Irlandia.
statement.en: Lí Ban (Liban; Old Irish lí beauty + ban of women), a woman turned mermaid, legend of Lough Neagh, Ireland.

claims.quote: Her family was drowned, but she survived in an underwater chamber in the lake for a year, after which she was transformed into a being who was half-human, half-salmon.

statement.id: Keluarga tenggelam; setahun di ruang bawah air; menjadi setengah manusia setengah salem.
statement.en: Family drowned; a year in an underwater chamber; became half human, half salmon.

claims.quote: There she was baptised by Comgall, and given the Christened name Muirgein ("sea-born") or Muirgeilt ("sea-wander") . She appears as Saint Muirgen in genealogies of Irish saints with her feast day assigned to 27 January.

statement.id: Dibaptis Comgall (St. Comgall): Muirgein/Muirgeilt; Santo (Saint) Muirgen, 27 Januari (January); utusan ke Roma (Rome); Inbhear nOllarbha (Larne Lough).
statement.en: Baptised by St. Comgall: Muirgein/Muirgeilt; Saint Muirgen, 27 January; messenger to Rome; Inbhear nOllarbha (Larne Lough).

claims.quote: Liban, a mermaid (muirgelt) who was the daughter of Eochaid, was captured in the year 558 A.D. according to the Annals of the Four Masters

statement.id: Annals of the Four Masters: ditangkap 558 M (A.D.).
statement.en: Annals of the Four Masters: captured 558 AD.

claims.quote: According to this old tale, Liban turned into a mermaid when a spring burst under her house to form Lough Neagh (Old Irish: Loch nEchach ), named after Liban's father Eochaid mac Mairidh who was drowned by the gushing water.

statement.id: Aided Echach maic Maireda, Lebor na hUidre abad ke-12; Lough Neagh dinamai menurut ayahnya Eochaid mac Mairidh.
statement.en: Aided Echach maic Maireda, 12th-century Lebor na hUidre; Lough Neagh named after her father Eochaid mac Mairidh.

statement.en: fi article: Liban chose heaven, was baptised and died.

short_description.id: Lidérc adalah demon khas cerita rakyat Hungaria yang muncul sebagai anak ayam ajaib, setan kecil pembawa kekayaan, atau kekasih setan yang terbang sebagai cahaya api.
short_description.en: The lidérc is a demon unique to Hungarian folklore, appearing as a miracle chicken, a wealth-bringing little devil or a satanic lover flying as a fiery light.

long_description.id: Lidérc adalah demon mitologi Hungaria yang tersebar luas dalam tradisi rakyat, dengan banyak nama seperti lüdérc, lúdvérc, dan inglice. Ia punya tiga ragam yang sering saling meminjam ciri. Bentuk yang lebih tradisional adalah anak ayam ajaib yang menetas dari telur pertama ayam hitam yang dihangatkan di bawah ketiak manusia; ia menimbun emas sehingga pemiliknya kaya.
long_description.en: The lidérc is a demon of Hungarian mythology widespread in folk tradition, with many names such as lüdérc, lúdvérc and inglice. It has three varieties that often borrow traits from one another. The more traditional form is a miracle chicken hatched from a black hen's first egg kept warm under a person's arm; it hoards gold and makes its owner rich.

long_description.id: Lidérc melekat pada manusia sebagai kekasih, duduk di tubuh korbannya dan kadang mengisap darahnya hingga lemah dan sakit; dari sini muncul kata Hungaria untuk mimpi buruk, lidércnyomás. Ragam lain adalah kekasih setan yang mirip incubus atau succubus dan terbang pada malam hari sebagai cahaya berapi atau burung api.
long_description.en: The lidérc attaches itself to people as a lover, sitting on its victim's body and sometimes sucking blood until the victim grows weak and ill; hence the Hungarian word for nightmare, lidércnyomás. Another variety is a satanic lover much like an incubus or succubus that flies at night as a fiery light or a bird of fire.

long_description.id: Betapapun bergunanya, lidérc harus segera disingkirkan karena sifatnya jahat. Caranya dengan membujuknya mengerjakan tugas mustahil, seperti mengangkut pasir dengan tali atau air dengan saringan, atau mengurungnya dalam lubang pohon.
long_description.en: However useful it may be, the lidérc must be got rid of quickly because of its evil nature. This is done by persuading it to do an impossible task, such as hauling sand with a rope or water with a sieve, or by locking it in a tree hollow.

who.id: Lidérc adalah demon Hungaria dengan tiga ragam.
who.en: The lidérc is a Hungarian demon with three varieties.

origin.id: Ia berasal dari cerita rakyat Hungaria.

role.id: Ia membawa kekayaan tetapi menyiksa pemiliknya.
role.en: It brings wealth but torments its owner.

famous_for.id: Namanya menjadi asal kata Hungaria untuk mimpi buruk.
famous_for.en: Its name gave the Hungarian word for nightmare.

did_you_know.id: Kata Hungaria untuk mimpi buruk, lidércnyomás, berarti "tekanan lidérc".
did_you_know.en: The Hungarian word for nightmare, lidércnyomás, means "lidérc pressure".

description.id: Lidérc bisa disingkirkan dengan dibujuk mengangkut pasir dengan tali atau air dengan saringan.
description.en: The lidérc can be got rid of by making it haul sand with a rope or water with a sieve.

description.id: Mengurungnya dalam lubang pohon memusnahkannya.
description.en: Locking it in a tree hollow destroys it.

note.id: Ragam kekasih setan mirip incubus atau succubus.
note.en: The satanic-lover variety resembles an incubus or succubus.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa makhluk pembawa kekayaan sering digambarkan berbahaya bagi pemiliknya?
learning_questions.en: Why are wealth-bringing beings often shown as dangerous to their owners?

claims.quote: is a unique supernatural being of Hungarian folklore. It has three known varieties, which often borrow traits from one another. The first, more traditional form of the lidérc is as a miracle chicken, csodacsirke in Hungarian, which hatches from the first egg of a black hen kept warm under the arm of a human.

statement.id: Lidérc adalah makhluk gaib khas cerita rakyat Hungaria dengan tiga ragam yang sering saling meminjam ciri; bentuk pertama yang lebih tradisional adalah anak ayam ajaib (csodacsirke) yang menetas dari telur pertama ayam hitam yang dihangatkan di bawah ketiak manusia.
statement.en: The lidérc is a unique supernatural being of Hungarian folklore with three varieties that often borrow traits from one another; the first, more traditional form is a miracle chicken (csodacsirke) hatched from a black hen's first egg kept warm under a person's arm.

claims.quote: The lidérc attaches itself to people to become their lover. ... it fondles her, sits on her body, and sometimes sucks her blood, making her weak and sick after a time. From this source comes a Hungarian word for nightmare -- lidércnyomás, which literally means "lidérc pressure", from the pressure on the body while the being sits on it.

statement.id: Lidérc melekat pada manusia untuk menjadi kekasihnya; ia menggerayangi korbannya, duduk di tubuhnya, kadang mengisap darahnya hingga perempuan itu lemah dan sakit; dari sinilah kata Hungaria untuk mimpi buruk, lidércnyomás, "tekanan lidérc".
statement.en: The lidérc attaches itself to people as their lover; fondling its victim, sitting on her body and sometimes sucking her blood until she grows weak and ill; hence the Hungarian word for nightmare, lidércnyomás, "lidérc pressure".

claims.quote: The lidérc hoards gold and thus makes its owner rich. To dispose of this form of the lidérc, it must be persuaded to perform an impossible task, such as haul sand with rope, or water with a sieve. It can also be destroyed by locking it into a tree hollow.

statement.id: Lidérc menimbun emas sehingga pemiliknya kaya; untuk menyingkirkannya, ia harus dibujuk mengerjakan tugas mustahil, seperti mengangkut pasir dengan tali atau air dengan saringan, atau dimusnahkan dengan dikurung dalam lubang pohon.
statement.en: The lidérc hoards gold and so makes its owner rich; to get rid of it, it must be persuaded to do an impossible task, such as hauling sand with a rope or water with a sieve, or it can be destroyed by locking it in a tree hollow.

claims.quote: The third variety is as a Satanic lover, ördögszerető in Hungarian, quite similar to an incubus or succubus. This form of the lidérc flies at night, appearing as a fiery light, a will o' the wisp, or even as a bird of fire.

statement.id: Ragam ketiga adalah kekasih setan (ördögszerető), mirip incubus atau succubus, yang terbang pada malam hari sebagai cahaya berapi, api tipuan, atau burung api.
statement.en: The third variety is the satanic lover (ördögszerető), much like an incubus or succubus, which flies at night as a fiery light, a will-o'-the-wisp or a bird of fire.

claims.quote: A lidérc (lüdérc, lúdvérc, lederc, lidroc, lidröc, inglice stb) a magyar mitológia démona, mely a néphagyományban szélesen elterjedt.

statement.id: Lidérc (juga lüdérc, lúdvérc, lederc, lidroc, lidröc, inglice, dan lain-lain) adalah demon mitologi Hungaria yang tersebar luas dalam tradisi rakyat.
statement.en: The lidérc (also lüdérc, lúdvérc, lederc, lidroc, lidröc, inglice and so on) is a demon of Hungarian mythology widespread in folk tradition.

claims.quote: Az elnevezések különbözőek lehetnek, de minden nép folklórja megegyezik abban, bármilyen hasznos is lehet, gonosz természete miatt minél hamarabb meg kell szabadulni tőle.

statement.id: Namanya bisa berbeda-beda, tetapi folklor semua bangsa sepakat bahwa betapapun bergunanya, karena sifatnya yang jahat ia harus disingkirkan secepat mungkin.
statement.en: The names may differ, but every people's folklore agrees that, however useful it may be, because of its evil nature it must be got rid of as soon as possible.

short_description.id: Lou Carcolh adalah siput-ular raksasa bertentakel berbulu dari cerita rakyat Landes yang tinggal di gua di bawah Hastingues dan menyeret mangsa ke dalamnya.
short_description.en: Lou Carcolh is a giant hairy-tentacled snail-serpent of Landes folklore living in a cave under Hastingues and dragging prey inside.

long_description.id: Lou Carcolh adalah makhluk cerita rakyat Landes berupa siput atau ular raksasa berlendir, bertentakel berbulu, dan bercangkang besar, yang tinggal di gua di bawah bukit kota Hastingues. Lendirnya terlihat sebelum ia datang, dan tentakelnya yang panjang menyeret mangsa ke guanya; menurut artikel bahasa Rusia ia takut sinar matahari.
long_description.en: Lou Carcolh is a creature of Landes folklore, a giant slimy snail or serpent with hairy tentacles and a large shell, living in a cave under the hill of Hastingues. Its slime is seen before it arrives, and its long tentacles drag prey into its cave; the Russian article says it fears sunlight.

long_description.id: Legenda menyebut siput ini membuat penduduk Hastingues ketakutan sehingga kota itu sepi, dan bentuk bukitnya yang bulat seperti cangkang siput mendukung cerita ini. Rujukannya tidak lebih tua dari awal abad ke-20; Revue de Gascogne mencatatnya pada 1903.
long_description.en: Legend says the snail frightened Hastingues' people until the town emptied, and the hill's shell-like shape supports the story. References go back no further than the early 20th century; the Revue de Gascogne recorded it in 1903.

famous_for.en: Its very long hairy tentacles.

description.id: Kota di Landes yang berdiri di atas gua carcolh.
description.en: The Landes town built over the carcolh's cave.

description.id: Siput raksasa Hastingues dicatat.
description.en: The giant snail of Hastingues is recorded.

claims.quote: Lou Carcolh, or the Carcolh, is a mythical beast from French folklore. It is described as a large, slimy, snail-like serpent with hairy tentacles and a large shell. It is said to live in a cavern beneath Hastingues, a town in the Les Landes region in southwestern France.

statement.id: Lou Carcolh adalah binatang mitis cerita rakyat Prancis berupa ular mirip siput yang besar dan berlendir, bertentakel berbulu dan bercangkang besar, yang konon tinggal di gua di bawah Hastingues, Landes, Prancis barat daya.
statement.en: Lou Carcolh is a mythical beast of French folklore, a large, slimy, snail-like serpent with hairy tentacles and a big shell, said to live in a cave beneath Hastingues in the Landes, south-west France.

claims.quote: It is described to have a slime that could sometimes be seen long before the creature itself arrived, and its tentacles had a great reach that would be used to grab and drag prey into its cave without leaving.

statement.id: Lendirnya kadang terlihat jauh sebelum makhluk itu tiba, dan tentakelnya yang sangat panjang dipakai untuk meraih dan menyeret mangsa ke guanya tanpa ia keluar.
statement.en: Its slime could sometimes be seen long before it arrived, and its long-reaching tentacles grabbed prey and dragged it into its cave without its leaving.

claims.quote: Le carcolh (lou carcolh en gascon) est un escargot monstrueux appartenant au folklore du département français des Landes et propre à la ville de Hastingues. Toutefois, les références à cette créature ne sont pas antérieures au début du XXe siècle.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Prancis, carcolh adalah siput raksasa dari cerita rakyat Landes khas kota Hastingues, tetapi rujukan tentangnya tidak lebih tua dari awal abad ke-20.
statement.en: According to the French article the carcolh is a monstrous snail of Landes folklore peculiar to Hastingues, but references to it are no older than the early 20th century.

claims.quote: Mais, selon la légende, le tuc, qui offre protection, renferme également une caverne qui abrite un Carcolh, escargot formidable et monstrueux, qui serait la cause du départ des habitants, poussés par la peur, et du dépeuplement de la cité.

statement.id: Menurut legenda, bukit yang melindungi kota itu juga menyimpan gua tempat tinggal carcolh, siput mengerikan yang membuat penduduk ketakutan, pergi, dan kota pun sepi.
statement.en: By legend the hill that sheltered the town also held a cave housing a carcolh, a fearsome monstrous snail that frightened the inhabitants away and emptied the town.

claims.quote: Cette légende est favorisée par la forme arrondie du promontoire, rappelant celle d'une coquille d'escargot.

statement.id: Legenda ini didukung bentuk bukit yang bulat seperti cangkang siput.
statement.en: The legend is encouraged by the hill's rounded shape, like a snail's shell.

claims.quote: Concernant le Carcolh, la Revue de Gascogne de 1903 évoque un ... Escargot monstrueux qui a son gîte dans une vaste et sombre caverne au-dessus de laquelle est bâtie, d'après les traditions, la ville de Hastingues.

statement.id: Revue de Gascogne tahun 1903 menyebut siput raksasa yang tinggal di gua besar dan gelap yang di atasnya, menurut tradisi, berdiri kota Hastingues.
statement.en: The Revue de Gascogne of 1903 mentions a monstrous snail living in a vast, dark cave over which, by tradition, the town of Hastingues is built.

claims.quote: Также считается, что солнечный свет пугает улитку, поэтому она не показывается на поверхности.

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Rusia menyebut cahaya matahari menakutkan siput ini sehingga ia tidak muncul ke permukaan.
statement.en: The Russian article says sunlight frightens the snail, so it never comes to the surface.

short_description.id: Lubber fiend atau Lob adalah makhluk legenda folklor Inggris yang mirip brownie, roh rumah yang mengerjakan pekerjaan rumah tangga.
short_description.en: The lubber fiend, or Lob, is a creature of English folklore resembling the brownie, a household spirit that does chores.

long_description.id: Lubber fiend, juga Lob, lubberkin, lurdane atau Lob Lie-By-The-Fire, adalah makhluk legenda folklor Inggris yang mirip brownie (atau Urisk) Skotlandia, hob Inggris utara, domovoi Slavia dan tomte Skandinavia; ia juga dikaitkan dengan Robin Goodfellow. Ia terkenal karena disebut John Milton dalam puisi pastoral "L'Allegro". Biasanya ia digambarkan sebagai lelaki besar berbulu dan berekor yang mengerjakan pekerjaan rumah dengan imbalan semangkuk susu dan tempat di depan perapian.
long_description.en: The lubber fiend, also Lob, lubberkin, lurdane or Lob Lie-By-The-Fire, is a being of English folklore akin to the brownie (or Urisk) of Scotland, the hob of northern England, the Slavic domovoi and the Scandinavian tomte, and has been linked with Robin Goodfellow. John Milton's mention of it in the pastoral 'L'Allegro' is its best-known appearance. It is usually a big hairy man with a tail who does the housework in return for a saucer of milk and a spot by the fire.

long_description.id: Satu kisah menyebutnya putra raksasa seorang penyihir dan Iblis. Abbey lubber adalah setan kecil yang menghantui gudang anggur dan dapur biara, menggoda para biarawan untuk mabuk, rakus dan bernafsu; kisahnya yang paling terkenal adalah Friar Rush. Lob juga muncul dalam karya Edward Thomas, Juliana H. Ewing dan J. M. Barrie, serta dalam The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt sebagai roh pelindung rumah.
long_description.en: One story makes it the giant offspring of a witch and the Devil. The abbey lubber is a lesser demon that infests abbey wine cellars and kitchens, luring monks into drinking, gluttony and lust; Friar Rush is the best-known abbey lubber tale. Lob also turns up in works by Edward Thomas, Juliana H. Ewing and J. M. Barrie, and in The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt as a protective household spirit.

famous_for.en: Mentioned by Milton.

did_you_know.en: John Milton mentions the lubber fiend in his pastoral poem 'L'Allegro'.

short_description.id: Luisón adalah manusia serigala mitologi Guarani, putra ketujuh Tau dan Kerana, dan menurut kepercayaan Paraguay serta Argentina anak laki-laki ketujuh dalam keluarga akan menjadi Luisón.
short_description.en: The Luisón is the werewolf of Guarani mythology, seventh son of Tau and Kerana, and by belief in Paraguay and Argentina a family's seventh son will become one.

long_description.id: Luisón atau Lobizón adalah satu dari tujuh binatang legendaris Paraguay, putra ketujuh Tau dan Kerana yang menanggung kutukan terberat. Ia anjing raksasa yang mengerikan dan berada di persimpangan kehidupan dan kematian; versi Portugis menggambarkannya mirip serigala atau monyet bermata merah. Anak laki-laki ketujuh dipercaya berubah menjadi Luisón pada ulang tahun ke-13 atau pada malam bulan purnama hari Jumat dan Selasa.
long_description.en: Counted among Paraguay's seven legendary beasts, the Luisón or Lobizón is the seventh son of Tau and Kerana and bears the heaviest curse. He is a hideous giant dog standing at the crossroads of life and death; the Portuguese version likens him to a wolf or red-eyed monkey. A seventh son is believed to turn into a Luisón on his 13th birthday or on full-moon Friday and Tuesday nights.

long_description.id: Mitos ini mungkin berpadu dengan cerita manusia serigala yang dibawa pendatang lewat serigala surai. Karena dulu ada orang yang mengorbankan anak ketujuh, sejak abad ke-19 Presiden Argentina menjadi wali baptis anak laki-laki ketujuh, kebiasaan yang diresmikan Juan Domingo Perón pada 1973.
long_description.en: The myth may have merged with the werewolf lore settlers brought, through the maned wolf. Because some people once sacrificed their seventh sons, since the 19th century the President of Argentina has stood godparent to seventh sons, a custom made law by Juan Domingo Perón in 1973.

role.en: The curse of the seventh son.

famous_for.en: Presidential godparenthood in Argentina.

description.id: Perón meresmikan perwalian presiden atas anak ketujuh.
description.en: Perón makes presidential godparenthood of seventh sons law.
