His mother.

claims.quote: The Luison (Paraguayan Guaraní: Luisõ; Spanish: Luisón or Lobizón) is one of the seven legendary beasts of Paraguay, and is the seventh and last son of Tau and Kerana. The myth is known also in Argentina and says that in a family with seven male children, the last child will become Luisón.

statement.id: Luisón (Guarani Paraguay: Luisõ; Spanyol: Luisón atau Lobizón) adalah satu dari tujuh binatang legendaris Paraguay, putra ketujuh dan terakhir Tau dan Kerana; mitos ini juga dikenal di Argentina dan menyebut bahwa dalam keluarga dengan tujuh anak laki-laki, anak terakhir akan menjadi Luisón.
statement.en: The Luisón (Paraguayan Guarani Luisõ; Spanish Luisón or Lobizón) is one of the seven legendary beasts of Paraguay, the seventh and last son of Tau and Kerana; the myth is also known in Argentina and holds that in a family of seven sons the last will become a Luisón.

claims.quote: In the original version of the myth, Luisón was the seventh and last child of Tau and Kerana, and thus was the most accursed. He appeared to be a giant dog, and was said to be extremely ugly, even horrendous looking.

statement.id: Dalam versi asli, sebagai anak ketujuh Tau dan Kerana ia paling terkutuk, tampak seperti anjing raksasa yang sangat buruk rupa.
statement.en: In the original myth, as the seventh child of Tau and Kerana he was the most accursed, looking like a giant, hideous dog.

claims.quote: The myth tells that the seventh son in a family will transform on his 13th birthday.

statement.id: Mitos menyebut anak laki-laki ketujuh dalam keluarga akan berubah pada ulang tahunnya yang ke-13.
statement.en: The myth says a family's seventh son will transform on his 13th birthday.

claims.quote: The maned wolf, a slender, wolf-like, stilted canid that moves with shambling steps, fitted the popular depiction of the werewolf and ultimately it was syncretized with local guarani myths.

statement.id: Serigala surai, anjing liar ramping berkaki panjang yang berjalan terseok, cocok dengan gambaran manusia serigala yang dibawa pendatang dan akhirnya berpadu dengan mitos Guarani setempat.
statement.en: The maned wolf, a slender long-legged wolf-like canid with a shambling gait, fitted the werewolf image brought by settlers and was eventually blended with local Guarani myths.

claims.quote: It has been customary since the 19th century for the President of Argentina to be named the "godparent" of each seventh male child of a married couple. This custom arose because superstitious people sometimes sacrificed their seventh son out of fear of the "possibility" that a Luisón had been born.

statement.id: Sejak abad ke-19 Presiden Argentina biasa menjadi wali baptis setiap anak laki-laki ketujuh, kebiasaan yang muncul karena orang yang percaya takhayul kadang mengorbankan anak ketujuh mereka karena takut ia Luisón.
statement.en: Since the 19th century the President of Argentina has customarily been godparent to every seventh son, a custom born because superstitious people sometimes sacrificed their seventh son for fear he was a Luisón.

claims.quote: On 12 March 1973, President Juan Domingo Perón gave legal form to this custom through Decree No. 848, known as the presidential sponsorship law.

statement.id: Pada 12 Maret 1973 Presiden Juan Domingo Perón meresmikan kebiasaan ini lewat Dekret No. 848, yang dikenal sebagai undang-undang perwalian presiden.
statement.en: On 12 March 1973 President Juan Domingo Perón made the custom law through Decree No. 848, the presidential sponsorship law.

claims.quote: Luisón es el séptimo hijo de Tau y Keraná en la mitología guaraní, sobre él cayó la mayor maldición que pesaba sobre los progenitores. Su solo nombre aterroriza. Este ser espeluznante se encuentra ubicado en la encrucijada de los caminos de la vida y de la muerte.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Spanyol, sebagai putra ketujuh Tau dan Keraná ia menanggung kutukan terberat orang tuanya; namanya saja menakutkan, dan ia berada di persimpangan jalan kehidupan dan kematian.
statement.en: According to the Spanish article, as the seventh son of Tau and Keraná he bears his parents' heaviest curse; his very name terrifies, and he stands at the crossroads of life and death.

claims.quote: Acredita-se que seja semelhante a um lobo sul-americano ou a um macaco de olhos vermelhos, com barbatanas de peixe e um enorme falo (de anta).

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Portugis, ia dipercaya mirip serigala Amerika Selatan atau monyet bermata merah, bersirip ikan, dan berzakar besar seperti tapir.
statement.en: According to the Portuguese article it is believed to look like a South American wolf or a red-eyed monkey, with fish fins and a huge tapir-like phallus.

statement.id: Pada malam bulan purnama hari Jumat atau Selasa, orang itu berubah menjadi makhluk setengah binatang.
statement.en: On full-moon nights falling on Friday and/or Tuesday the person turned into a half-animal creature.

short_description.id: Lusca adalah monster laut dalam cerita rakyat Karibia yang konon hidup di blue hole dekat Pulau Andros, Bahama, dan digambarkan sebagai gurita atau sotong raksasa.
short_description.en: The Lusca is a sea monster of Caribbean folklore said to live in the blue holes near Andros, Bahamas, described as a giant octopus or cuttlefish.

long_description.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Karibia, Lusca adalah monster laut yang konon hidup di blue hole dekat Andros, Bahama. Ia digambarkan sebagai gurita raksasa, sotong raksasa, atau setengah hiu setengah gurita; namanya penggalan dari Mollusca.
long_description.en: In Caribbean folklore the Lusca is a sea monster said to live in the blue holes near Andros in the Bahamas. It is described as a giant octopus, a giant cuttlefish or half shark, half octopus; its name is a clipped form of Mollusca.

long_description.id: Pada 1872 J. S. George dari Nassau melaporkan gurita raksasa yang ditemukan mati di pantai. Kemudian pemandu setempat bercerita kepada ahli biologi laut Bruce S. Wright tentang lusca setengah gurita setengah naga yang tinggal di gua kapur bawah danau. Monster St. Augustine yang terdampar di Florida pada 1896 dianggap salah satu kandidat spesimen lusca.
long_description.en: In 1872 J. S. George of Nassau reported a colossal octopus found dead on the beach. Later a local guide told marine biologist Bruce S. Wright of a half-octopus, half-dragon lusca living in limestone caves under a lake. The St. Augustine monster stranded in Florida in 1896 is considered a candidate lusca specimen.

claims.quote: In Caribbean folklore, the Lusca is a name given to an alleged sea monster said to exist in the region of the blue holes nearby Andros, an island in The Bahamas.

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Karibia, Lusca adalah monster laut yang konon hidup di kawasan blue hole dekat Andros, sebuah pulau di Bahama.
statement.en: In Caribbean folklore the Lusca is a sea monster said to live around the blue holes near Andros, an island in the Bahamas.

claims.quote: The first reported sighting of something resembling the traditional description of the Lusca in the area was in 1872, when J. S. George of Nassau in the Bahamas wrote to the American Naturalist describing a "colossal octopus" found dead on the beach.

statement.id: Laporan pertama yang mirip gambaran Lusca muncul pada 1872, ketika J. S. George dari Nassau menulis ke American Naturalist tentang "gurita raksasa" yang ditemukan mati di pantai.
statement.en: The first report resembling the Lusca came in 1872, when J. S. George of Nassau wrote to the American Naturalist about a "colossal octopus" found dead on the beach.

claims.quote: marine biologist Bruce S. Wright was told by a local guide that some limestone caverns beneath a lake were home to a monster called the lusca, described as a large, half-octopus, half-dragon animal, with powerful, sucker-tipped tentacles, which lived in banana holes and blue holes.

statement.id: Ahli biologi laut Bruce S. Wright mendengar dari pemandu setempat bahwa gua kapur di bawah sebuah danau dihuni lusca, makhluk besar setengah gurita setengah naga dengan tentakel bermangkuk isap.
statement.en: Marine biologist Bruce S. Wright was told by a local guide that limestone caves under a lake were home to the lusca, a large half-octopus, half-dragon animal with sucker-tipped tentacles.

claims.quote: Lusca is a clipped form of Mollusca (a phylum containing octopus, squid, cuttlefish, and other cephalopods), referring to the creature's varied mollusk features, such as tentacles.

statement.id: Nama Lusca adalah penggalan dari Mollusca, merujuk pada ciri moluska makhluk ini seperti tentakel.
statement.en: Lusca is a clipped form of Mollusca, referring to the creature's mollusc features such as tentacles.

statement.en: It is described as a giant octopus, a giant cuttlefish, or half shark, half octopus.

statement.en: The St. Augustine monster found on the Florida coast in 1896 is considered one of the best candidates for a lusca specimen.

short_description.id: Manipogo adalah monster danau dalam cerita rakyat Kanada yang konon hidup di Danau Manitoba, digambarkan sebagai makhluk mirip ular dengan punuk.
short_description.en: Manipogo is a lake monster of Canadian folklore said to live in Lake Manitoba, described as a serpent-like creature with a hump.

long_description.id: Manipogo adalah monster danau yang konon hidup di Danau Manitoba, Kanada. Namanya meniru Ogopogo dari British Columbia. Ia digambarkan bertubuh cokelat kehitaman dengan sedikitnya satu punuk di atas air; kepalanya disamakan dengan kepala kuda, unta, atau domba, atau disebut pipih berbentuk belah ketupat. Saat muncul ke permukaan, ia konon menjerit.
long_description.en: Manipogo is a lake monster said to live in Lake Manitoba, Canada. Its name echoes British Columbia's Ogopogo. It is described as brownish-black with at least one hump above the water; its head is likened to a horse's, camel's or sheep's, or said to be flat and diamond-shaped. It reportedly shrieks as it surfaces.

long_description.id: Penduduk First Nations setempat sudah lama punya legenda tentang makhluk mirip ular di danau itu. Penampakan pertama yang terdokumentasi oleh pemukim kulit putih dilaporkan pedagang bulu Valentine McKay pada September 1909. Pada 1936 nelayan Oscar Fredrickson konon menjaring sebuah tengkorak hewan, tetapi tengkorak itu hilang ketika rumahnya terbakar.
long_description.en: Local First Nations people have long told of serpent-like creatures in the lake. The first documented sighting by a white settler was reported by fur trader Valentine McKay in September 1909. In 1936 fisherman Oscar Fredrickson reportedly netted an animal skull, but it was lost when his house burned down.

long_description.id: Sebagian skeptis menduga yang terlihat sebenarnya rusa moose yang berenang. Makhluk ini memberi nama Taman Provinsi Manipogo, dan komunitas St. Laurent mengadakan Festival Manipogo setiap minggu pertama Maret.
long_description.en: Some sceptics think witnesses saw a swimming moose. The creature gives its name to Manipogo Provincial Park, and the community of St. Laurent holds a Manipogo Festival every first week of March.

role.en: A creature reported in sightings since 1909.

did_you_know.en: A skull thought to be Manipogo's was reportedly lost in a house fire.

short_description.id: Manticore adalah monster Persia pemakan manusia, bertubuh singa dan berwajah manusia.
short_description.en: The manticore is a Persian man-eating monster with a lion’s body and a human face.

long_description.id: Manticore adalah monster Persia pemakan manusia, bertubuh singa dan berwajah manusia. Nama manticore ditelusuri ke kata Persia untuk pemakan manusia.
long_description.en: The manticore is a Persian man-eating monster with a lion’s body and a human face. The name manticore is traced to a Persian word for man-eater.

long_description.id: Manticore juga muncul dalam bestiarium abad pertengahan. Uraian Ctesias yang dikutip memberi tiga baris gigi, telinga manusia, dan mata biru muda. Uraian itu menggambarkan ekor menyerupai kalajengking dengan sengat panjang. Pausanias menduga hewan dalam laporan Ctesias itu sebenarnya harimau. Manticore dipercaya tinggal di tempat sepi di luar permukiman.
long_description.en: The manticore also appears in medieval bestiaries. The quoted account of Ctesias gives it three rows of teeth, human ears, and light-blue eyes. That account depicts a scorpion-like tail with a long sting. Pausanias writes that he is inclined to think the reported creature is a tiger. The manticore is believed to inhabit lonely places outside communities.

short_description.id: Marraco adalah naga atau momok penakut anak dari kota Lleida dalam mitos Katalan, bermulut cukup lebar untuk menelan manusia, kini diarak sebagai figur naga hijau dalam pesta kota.
short_description.en: The Marraco is a dragon or child-scaring bogey of Catalan myth in Lleida, with a mouth wide enough to swallow a person, now paraded as a green dragon figure at city festivals.

long_description.id: Lo Marraco adalah naga atau makhluk menakutkan dalam mitos Katalan di Lleida. Dalam cerita untuk menakuti anak, mulutnya cukup lebar untuk menelan manusia bulat-bulat; ia juga dikenal sebagai kadal sebesar naga yang memakan dot bayi sebagai lambang pertumbuhan. Nama marreco dipakai untuk momok serupa di Maestrat dan Menorca.
long_description.en: Lo Marraco is a dragon or fearsome creature of Catalan myth in Lleida. In tales to scare children its mouth could swallow a person whole; it is also known as a dragon-sized lizard that eats babies' dummies as a sign of growing up. The name marreco was used for a similar bogey in the Maestrat and Menorca.

long_description.id: Asal-usulnya diperdebatkan. Artikel bahasa Spanyol menyebutnya hewan totem dari abad ke-5 SM, tetapi artikel bahasa Katalan menyebut dugaan itu tidak berdasar karena totem kaum Ilerget adalah serigala. Figur naga dipakai dalam prosesi kota sejak 1551, dan menurut satu sumber properti tahun 1907-lah yang memberi makhluk ini bentuk dan warna. Figur sekarang, naga hijau tanpa sayap sepanjang 8,5 m yang mengeluarkan asap dari hidung, dibuat pada 1957.
long_description.en: Its origin is disputed. The Spanish article calls it a totem animal from the 5th century BC, but the Catalan article calls this baseless, since the Ilergetes' totem was the wolf. A dragon figure joined city processions from 1551, and one authority says the 1907 prop gave the creature its shape and colour. The present figure, a wingless green dragon 8.5 m long that blows smoke from its nostrils, was built in 1957.

claims.quote: The Marraco (Catalan: Lo Marraco, Catalan pronunciation: [məˈraku])  is a dragon or frightening creature in Catalan myth in the city of Lleida. It possessed a mouth wide enough to swallow a human whole according to tales told to frighten children.

statement.id: Marraco (bahasa Katalan: Lo Marraco) adalah naga atau makhluk menakutkan dalam mitos Katalan di kota Lleida; menurut cerita untuk menakuti anak, mulutnya cukup lebar untuk menelan manusia bulat-bulat.
statement.en: The Marraco (Catalan: Lo Marraco) is a dragon or frightening creature of Catalan myth in the city of Lleida; in tales told to frighten children, its mouth was wide enough to swallow a person whole.

claims.quote: Amb el nom de lo Marraco es coneix a la ciutat de Lleida un lluert de la mida d'un drac, amb una boca especialment ampla i grossa amb la qual es menja els xumets dels infants, com a símbol del seu creixement.

statement.id: Di Lleida, Lo Marraco dikenal sebagai kadal sebesar naga dengan mulut sangat lebar yang memakan dot bayi, sebagai lambang pertumbuhan anak.
statement.en: In Lleida, Lo Marraco is known as a dragon-sized lizard with a very wide mouth that eats babies' dummies, as a symbol of their growing up.

claims.quote: Lo Marraco és també un espantamainades tradicional de Lleida. Hi ha altres indrets on es feia servir el mateix nom (en la variant, però, marreco) per a fer por a la mainada, com ara el Maestrat i Menorca.

statement.id: Lo Marraco juga momok penakut anak tradisional Lleida; nama yang sama (dalam varian marreco) dipakai untuk menakuti anak di tempat lain seperti Maestrat dan Menorca.
statement.en: Lo Marraco is also a traditional child-scarer of Lleida; the same name (as marreco) was used to frighten children elsewhere, such as the Maestrat and Menorca.

claims.quote: El Marraco es un animal totémico de Lérida que data del siglo V a. C. Como animal mitológico no ha existido nunca y su representación es libre.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Spanyol, Marraco adalah hewan totem Lérida dari abad ke-5 SM yang wujudnya bebas digambarkan.
statement.en: According to the Spanish article, the Marraco is a totem animal of Lérida dating from the 5th century BC, freely represented.

claims.quote: La veritat, però, és que tant aquestes conjectures com el fet d'atribuir al basc l'origen del nom (sovint es diu que "marraco" vol dir 'drac' en aquesta llengua) no tenen cap fonament històric ni científic. D'altra banda, l'animal totèmic dels ilergets era el llop, no pas el drac.

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Katalan menegaskan bahwa dugaan asal-usul kuno itu, juga anggapan namanya berasal dari kata Basque untuk naga, tidak berdasar sejarah maupun ilmiah; hewan totem kaum Ilerget adalah serigala, bukan naga.
statement.en: The Catalan article stresses that these ancient-origin conjectures, and the idea that the name comes from Basque for 'dragon', have no historical or scientific basis; the totem animal of the Ilergetes was the wolf, not the dragon.

claims.quote: However, this is contradicted by a different authority, which notes that it was the advent of the marraco prop built in 1907 for the parade which "gave shape and color to this imaginary creature".

statement.id: Sumber lain menyatakan bahwa properti marraco yang dibuat pada 1907 untuk pawai-lah yang "memberi bentuk dan warna pada makhluk khayalan ini".
statement.en: Another authority notes that the marraco prop built in 1907 for the parade 'gave shape and color to this imaginary creature'.

claims.quote: One recorded post-medieval precursor of "Lo Marraco de Lleida" was the drac or dragon figure used by the city during the procession of the Assumption of Mary for the year in 1551.

statement.id: Salah satu pendahulu Lo Marraco de Lleida yang tercatat adalah figur naga yang dipakai kota itu dalam prosesi Maria Diangkat ke Surga tahun 1551.
statement.en: A recorded precursor of Lo Marraco de Lleida was the dragon figure the city used in the procession of the Assumption of Mary in 1551.

statement.en: The figure is 8.5 m long, 2.90 m wide and 3.75 m high and weighs over two tonnes; it is a wingless green dragon with very sharp fangs that blows smoke from its nose.

claims.quote: The Catalan word marraco (regional variant of marraix) also denotes a type of shark, and the corresponding Basque word marraxo meaning 'shark' appears to be borrowed from the Spanish marrajo, according to a linguistic authority.

statement.id: Kata Katalan marraco (varian regional marraix) juga berarti sejenis hiu, dan kata Basque marraxo ("hiu") tampaknya dipinjam dari bahasa Spanyol marrajo.
statement.en: The Catalan word marraco (a regional variant of marraix) also means a kind of shark, and the Basque marraxo ('shark') appears borrowed from Spanish marrajo.

short_description.id: Meduza atau Meluza adalah makhluk mitis dalam cerita rakyat Rusia, digambarkan pada lubok abad ke-17 atau ke-18 sebagai setengah perempuan setengah ular atau ikan.
short_description.en: Meduza or Meluza is a mythical creature of Russian folklore, shown in a 17th- or 18th-century lubok as half woman and half snake or fish.

long_description.id: Meduza, juga disebut Meluza ("yang kecil") atau Meluzina, adalah makhluk mitis dalam cerita rakyat Rusia yang digambarkan pada lubok (gambar cetak rakyat) abad ke-17 atau ke-18. Ia dilukiskan sebagai setengah perempuan setengah ular, atau setengah perempuan setengah ikan, dan juga disebut dewi tipu daya.
long_description.en: Meduza, also called Meluza ("little one") or Meluzina, is a mythical creature of Russian folklore depicted in a lubok (popular print) of the 17th or 18th century. She is shown as half woman and half snake, or half woman and half fish, and is also said to be a deity of deception.

long_description.id: Ia digambarkan sebagai monster laut berkepala gadis cantik berambut gelap dan bermahkota, bertubuh binatang belang, berekor naga yang ujungnya mulut ular, dan berkaki seperti gajah yang ujungnya juga mulut ular. Mulut-mulut ular itu dipercaya mengandung racun naga yang mematikan. Ia tinggal di laut dekat jurang Ethiopia atau di Samudra Barat.
long_description.en: The lubok shows a sea creature whose crowned head is that of a lovely dark-haired girl, set on a striped animal's body, with a dragon's tail ending in a snake's mouth, and elephant-like legs that also end in snake mouths. Those snake mouths were believed to hold deadly dragon venom. Her home was said to be either the Western Ocean or the waters by the Ethiopian abyss.

long_description.id: Ia juga disebut dalam "Kitab Ilmu Alam" yang dikaitkan dengan Nikolai Spathari. Menurut B. M. Sokolov, kisah pada lubok ini misterius tetapi merujuk pada tema yang dikenal dari tradisi lisan.
long_description.en: She is also mentioned in the "Book of Natural Science" attributed to Nikolai Spathari. According to B. M. Sokolov, the subject of this lubok is mysterious but refers to a theme known from oral narrative.

claims.quote: Meduza (Russian: Медуза), Meluza (Russian: Мелуза, literally "small", "little") or Meluzina (Russian: Мелузина) is a mythical creature in Russian folklore. She was depicted in a Russian lubok of the 17th or 18th century. She is described as half-woman, half-snake, or as the half-woman, half-fish creature. She is also said to be the deity of deception.

statement.id: Meduza (Медуза), Meluza (harfiah "kecil") atau Meluzina adalah makhluk mitis cerita rakyat Rusia yang digambarkan pada lubok Rusia abad ke-17 atau ke-18 sebagai setengah perempuan setengah ular atau ikan, dan disebut dewi tipu daya.
statement.en: Meduza (Медуза), Meluza (literally "little") or Meluzina is a mythical creature of Russian folklore depicted in a 17th- or 18th-century Russian lubok as half woman, half snake or fish, and said to be the deity of deception.

claims.quote: She is represented as a sea monster with the head of a beautiful dark-haired maiden, having the body and belly of a striped beast, a dragon tail with a snake's mouth at the end, and legs resembling those of an elephant with the same snake mouths at the end. She also wears a crown.

statement.id: Ia digambarkan sebagai monster laut berkepala gadis cantik berambut gelap, bertubuh binatang belang, berekor naga dengan mulut ular di ujung, berkaki seperti gajah dengan mulut ular di ujungnya, dan bermahkota.
statement.en: She is shown as a sea monster with a beautiful dark-haired maiden's head, a striped beast's body, a dragon tail ending in a snake mouth, elephant-like legs ending in snake mouths, and a crown.

claims.quote: According to belief, her snake mouths contained a deadly dragon poison. She was said to live in the Sea near the Ethiopian abyss, or in the Western Ocean.

statement.id: Menurut kepercayaan, mulut-mulut ularnya mengandung racun naga yang mematikan; ia tinggal di laut dekat jurang Ethiopia atau di Samudra Barat.
statement.en: According to belief her snake mouths held deadly dragon poison; she lived in the sea near the Ethiopian abyss or in the Western Ocean.

claims.quote: Упоминается в «Книге естествословной», приписываемой Николаю Спафарию. По мнению Б. М. Соколова, сюжет этого лубка является загадочным, но содержит отсылку к знакомой теме из устного повествования.

statement.id: Ia disebut dalam "Kitab Ilmu Alam" yang dikaitkan dengan Nikolai Spathari; menurut B. M. Sokolov, kisah lubok ini misterius tetapi merujuk tema yang dikenal dari tradisi lisan.
statement.en: She is mentioned in the "Book of Natural Science" attributed to Nikolai Spathari; according to B. M. Sokolov, this lubok's subject is mysterious but refers to a theme known from oral narrative.

claims.quote: Мелуза (так же Медуза или Мелузина) — персонаж русских лубочных картинок второй половины XVII—XVIII века. Представляет собой мифическое существо в виде полуженщины-полузмеи или полурыбы.

statement.id: Meluza (juga Meduza atau Meluzina) adalah tokoh gambar lubok Rusia dari paruh kedua abad ke-17 (XVII) hingga abad ke-18 (XVIII), makhluk mitis setengah perempuan setengah ular atau ikan.
statement.en: Meluza (also Meduza or Meluzina) is a figure of Russian lubok pictures from the second half of the 17th (XVII) to the 18th (XVIII) century, a mythical being half woman, half snake or fish.

claims.quote: Змеиные пасти содержали в себе смертельный драконий яд. Обитала Мелуза в западном Океане, в «океане-море близ Эфиопской пучины».

statement.id: Mulut-mulut ularnya berisi racun naga yang mematikan; Meluza tinggal di Samudra barat, "di samudra-laut dekat jurang Ethiopia".
statement.en: Her snake mouths held deadly dragon venom; Meluza lived in the western Ocean, "in the ocean-sea near the Ethiopian abyss".

short_description.id: Putri Duyung Warsawa (Syrenka) adalah lambang kota Warsawa yang tampil pada lambang kota dan banyak patung, dikisahkan siap melindungi kota dengan pedang dan perisai.
short_description.en: The Mermaid of Warsaw (Syrenka) is the symbol of Warsaw, shown on its coat of arms and many statues, and said to stand ready to defend the city with sword and shield.

long_description.id: Putri Duyung Warsawa adalah lambang kota Warsawa dan tampil pada lambang kota serta pada banyak patung dan gambar lain. Kata Polandia syrenka seakar dengan "siren", tetapi sosok ini lebih tepat disebut melusina, putri duyung air tawar. Melusina sendiri adalah roh air tawar bersayap dan berekor ikan yang hidup di sungai atau sumur.
long_description.en: The Mermaid of Warsaw is the symbol of the city of Warsaw, appearing on its coat of arms and in many statues and other images. The Polish word syrenka is related to "siren", but the figure is more properly a freshwater mermaid called a melusina. A melusina is a winged, fish-tailed freshwater spirit living in rivers or wells.

long_description.id: Wujudnya pada lambang kota berubah dari masa ke masa. Pada 1390 lambang Warsawa memuat makhluk berkaki burung dengan tubuh bersisik naga; segel tahun 1459 menampilkan ciri perempuan, tubuh burung, tangan manusia, ekor ikan, serta kaki dan cakar burung; dan wujud putri duyung pertama berasal dari 1622 dan bertahan sampai sekarang. Ia memegang perisai di tangan kiri dan pedang di tangan kanan. Ilham lambang ini kemungkinan berasal dari buku Physiologus abad ke-2.
long_description.en: Its form on the coat of arms changed over time. In 1390 the Warsaw arms showed a creature with bird legs and a dragon-scaled body; the seal of 1459 had female features, a bird body, human hands, a fish tail and bird legs and claws; and the first mermaid form dates from 1622 and remains in use. She holds a shield in her left hand and a sword in her right. The arms were probably inspired by the 2nd-century book Physiologus.

long_description.id: Ada beberapa legenda tentangnya. Menurut kisah yang dituturkan pemandu wisata, putri duyung itu singgah di tepi sungai dekat Kota Tua dan memutuskan menetap; para nelayan yang kesal karena jaring mereka kusut dan ikan-ikan dilepaskan hendak menangkapnya, tetapi jatuh cinta setelah mendengar nyanyiannya. Ketika seorang saudagar kaya menangkap dan mengurungnya, para nelayan membebaskannya, dan sejak itu ia siap melindungi kota dengan pedang dan perisai. Versi lain menyebut ia menolong seorang pangeran yang tersesat saat berburu, lalu pangeran itu mendirikan kota untuk menghormatinya.
long_description.en: There are several legends about her. In the tale told by city guides, the mermaid paused on a riverbank near the Old Town and chose to stay; fishermen annoyed by tangled nets and freed fish planned to trap her but fell in love on hearing her sing. When a rich merchant caught and caged her, the fishermen set her free, and ever since she has stood ready to guard the city with sword and shield. Another version says she helped a prince lost while hunting, and he founded the city in her honour.

long_description.id: Kadang legenda ini diperluas dengan menyebut Putri Duyung Kecil di Kopenhagen sebagai saudarinya, yang berpisah jalan dengannya dari Laut Baltik. Di Warsawa terdapat banyak patungnya, antara lain karya Konstanty Hegel di alun-alun Kota Tua dan patung karya Ludwika Nitschowa yang didirikan pada April 1939 di Powiśle dekat Sungai Vistula.
long_description.en: The legend is sometimes extended to make the Little Mermaid of Copenhagen her sister, the two parting ways from the Baltic Sea. Warsaw has many statues of her, among them Konstanty Hegel's in the Old Town Square and Ludwika Nitschowa's, set up in April 1939 in Powiśle by the Vistula river.

short_description.id: Michigan Dogman adalah makhluk mirip anjing berkaki dua dalam legenda modern Michigan, yang menurut catatan berawal dari lagu lelucon April Mop Steve Cook tahun 1987.
short_description.en: The Michigan Dogman is a two-legged dog-like creature of modern Michigan legend which, by the record, began with Steve Cook's 1987 April Fool's song.

long_description.id: Michigan Dogman digambarkan sebagai anjing berkaki dua setinggi 2,1 m bertubuh manusia dengan lolongan seperti jeritan manusia, yang konon pertama terlihat pada 1887 di Wexford County dan muncul setiap tahun berakhiran tujuh. Namun catatan yang terdokumentasi berawal pada 1987, ketika Steve Cook memutar lagu The Legend sebagai lelucon April Mop; Cook mengaku mengarangnya sendiri, dan klaim legenda Odawa tidak pernah punya sumber autentik.
long_description.en: The Michigan Dogman is described as a 2.1 m two-legged canine with a man's torso and a scream-like howl, said to have been first seen in 1887 in Wexford County and to return in years ending in seven. But the documented record begins in 1987, when Steve Cook played his song The Legend as an April Fool's joke; Cook said he invented it, and the claimed Odawa legend has no authentic source.

long_description.id: Setelah lagu itu, banyak pendengar mengaku bertemu makhluk serupa. Kriptozoologi menggolongkannya makhluk mirip anjing yang berjalan tegak, sedangkan folkloris menganggapnya legenda regional modern.
long_description.en: After the song, many listeners claimed to have met such a creature. Cryptozoology classes it as an upright canid, while folklorists treat it as a modern regional legend.

who.en: A two-legged canine with a man's torso.

famous_for.en: The 1987 song The Legend.

description.id: Lagu lelucon April Mop yang melahirkan legenda ini.
description.en: The April Fool's song that launched the legend.

claims.quote: In folklore, the Michigan Dogman is an alleged creature first witnessed in 1887 in Wexford County, Michigan, United States. It was described as a seven-foot-tall (2.1 m), blue- or amber-eyed bipedal canid possessing the torso of a man with a fearsome howl resembling a human scream.

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat, Michigan Dogman adalah makhluk yang konon pertama terlihat pada 1887 di Wexford County, Michigan, Amerika Serikat, digambarkan sebagai anjing berkaki dua setinggi tujuh kaki (2,1 m) bermata biru atau kuning, bertubuh manusia, dengan lolongan seperti jeritan manusia.
statement.en: In folklore the Michigan Dogman is an alleged creature first seen in 1887 in Wexford County, Michigan, United States, described as a seven-foot (2.1 m), blue- or amber-eyed two-legged canine with a man's torso and a howl like a human scream.

claims.quote: Folklore claims that the creature reemerges on a recurring ten-year pattern linked to years ending in the number seven.

statement.id: Menurut cerita rakyat, makhluk ini muncul kembali setiap sepuluh tahun pada tahun yang berakhiran angka tujuh.
statement.en: Folklore says the creature reappears every ten years, in years ending in seven.

claims.quote: In 1987, disc jockey Steve Cook at WTCM-FM in Traverse City, Michigan, recorded a song titled "The Legend", which he initially played as an April Fool's Day joke.

statement.id: Pada 1987 penyiar radio Steve Cook di WTCM-FM, Traverse City, merekam lagu The Legend yang mula-mula diputar sebagai lelucon April Mop.
statement.en: In 1987 disc jockey Steve Cook of WTCM-FM in Traverse City recorded a song, The Legend, first played as an April Fool's joke.

claims.quote: I made it up completely from my own imagination as an April Fools' prank for the radio and stumbled my way to a legend that goes back all the way to Native American times.

statement.id: Cook mengaku mengarang lagu itu sepenuhnya dari imajinasinya sebagai lelucon April Mop untuk radio.
statement.en: Cook said he made it up entirely from his own imagination as an April Fools' prank for the radio.

claims.quote: After he played the song, Cook received calls from listeners who said that they had encountered a similar creature.

statement.id: Setelah lagu itu diputar, Cook menerima telepon dari pendengar yang mengaku pernah bertemu makhluk serupa.
statement.en: After he played the song, Cook got calls from listeners who said they had met a similar creature.

claims.quote: L'Homme chien du Michigan (Dogman of Michigan) animal bipède ressemblant à un canidé issu du folklore du Michigan et née d'une chanson locale sortie en 1987 faisant potentiellement écho à des récits plus anciens.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Prancis, Dogman adalah hewan berkaki dua mirip anjing dari cerita rakyat Michigan yang lahir dari lagu lokal tahun 1987, mungkin menggemakan cerita yang lebih tua.
statement.en: According to the French article, the Dogman is a two-legged dog-like animal of Michigan folklore born of a 1987 local song, possibly echoing older tales.

claims.quote: Selon Cook, une légende amérindienne existerait, ce qui fait dire que l'homme chien rode autour de la rivière Manistee depuis l'époque où les tribus Odawa y vivaient bien qu'aucune source authentique n'ait jamais été documentée.

statement.id: Menurut Cook ada legenda penduduk asli bahwa makhluk ini berkeliaran di sekitar Sungai Manistee sejak zaman suku Odawa, tetapi tidak ada sumber autentik yang pernah terdokumentasi.
statement.en: According to Cook a Native legend has the dogman roaming the Manistee River since Odawa times, though no authentic source has ever been documented.

claims.quote: В криптозоологической литературе догмена относят к предполагаемым прямоходящим псовоподобным существам, тогда как фольклористы рассматривают его прежде всего как персонажа современной региональной легенды.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Rusia, literatur kriptozoologi menggolongkannya makhluk mirip anjing yang berjalan tegak, sedangkan para folkloris memandangnya terutama sebagai tokoh legenda regional modern.
statement.en: According to the Russian article, cryptozoological literature classes the dogman as an alleged upright canid, while folklorists see it mainly as a figure of modern regional legend.

short_description.id: Minhocão adalah makhluk cerita rakyat Brasil, digambarkan sebagai cacing atau ikan raksasa yang menyeret ternak ke dalam air dan meninggalkan parit dalam.
short_description.en: The Minhocão is a creature of Brazilian folklore, described as a giant worm or fish that drags livestock under water and leaves deep trenches.

long_description.id: Minhocão adalah makhluk cerita rakyat Brasil yang diklaim berupa ikan besar atau menyerupai cacing raksasa; namanya bentuk pembesar dari minhoca, "cacing tanah" dalam bahasa Portugis. Ia konon mencabut pohon, meninggalkan parit dalam, dan menyukai tempat lembap.
long_description.en: The Minhocão is a creature of Brazilian folklore said to be a large fish or a giant worm; its name is an augmentative of minhoca, Portuguese for "earthworm". It was said to uproot trees, leave deep trenches and prefer damp places.

long_description.id: Penduduk setempat menceritakannya kepada naturalis Eropa pada abad ke-19. Pada Desember 1846 Augustin Saint-Hilaire mencatat Minhocão di danau Padre Aranda dan Feia yang konon menyeret kuda dan sapi ke dalam air, dan menduganya sejenis ikan paru besar. Fritz Müller melaporkannya dalam jurnal Jerman pada 1878, dan kriptozoolog Karl Shuker kemudian mengaitkannya dengan Sachamama dari Peru.
long_description.en: Locals described it to European naturalists in the 19th century. In December 1846 Augustin Saint-Hilaire recorded Minhocão in the Padre Aranda and Feia lakes that dragged horses and cattle under water, and guessed it was a large lungfish. Fritz Müller reported it in a German journal in 1878, and cryptozoologist Karl Shuker later linked it with the Sachamama of Peru.

short_description.id: Monster Ravenna adalah kelahiran aneh yang dilaporkan di Ravenna pada 1512, bertanduk dan bersayap kelelawar, yang ditafsirkan sebagai pertanda Pertempuran Ravenna.
short_description.en: The Monster of Ravenna is a monstrous birth reported at Ravenna in 1512, horned and bat-winged, read as an omen of the Battle of Ravenna.

long_description.id: Monster Ravenna adalah kelahiran aneh yang dilaporkan di dekat Ravenna pada awal 1512, mungkin apokrif. Catatan harian Tedallini menyebutnya anak biarawati dan biarawan yang bertanduk, bertanda YXV di dada, dan berkaki aneh; Luca Landucci menambahkan sayap kelelawar, mata di lutut, dan kaki bercakar elang. Bayi itu ditelantarkan hingga mati atas perintah Paus.
long_description.en: The Monster of Ravenna is a monstrous birth reported near Ravenna in early 1512, possibly apocryphal. Tedallini's diary calls it the child of a nun and a friar, horned, marked YXV on the chest and with strange legs; Luca Landucci added bat wings, an eye on the knee and an eagle's clawed foot. The infant was left to die on the Pope's order.

long_description.id: Ia paling sering ditafsirkan sebagai pertanda Pertempuran Ravenna (1512), dan tanda di dadanya dibaca sebagai pesan moral; tahun kelahirannya pun berbeda antara Lycosthenes (1511) dan Boaistuau (1512). Pihak Katolik maupun Protestan memakainya sebagai simbol. Konsensus medis modern menganggapnya anak dengan kelainan bawaan berat.
long_description.en: It was most often read as an omen of the Battle of Ravenna (1512), and the signs on its chest as a moral message; even its birth year differs between Lycosthenes (1511) and Boaistuau (1512). Catholic and Protestant opponents both used it as a symbol. Modern medical consensus sees a child with a severe congenital disorder.

who.en: A monstrous birth taken as an omen.

role.en: An omen of the Battle of Ravenna.

famous_for.en: The letters YXV on its chest.

description.id: Kota tempat kelahiran itu dilaporkan.
description.en: The city where the birth was reported.

description.id: Kabar kelahiran aneh di Ravenna menyebar lewat pamflet dan catatan harian.
description.en: News of the monstrous birth at Ravenna spreads in pamphlets and diaries.

claims.quote: The Monster of Ravenna was a possibly apocryphal late Renaissance-era monstrous birth whose appearance in early 1512 near the city of Ravenna was widely reported in contemporary European pamphlets and diaries.

statement.id: Monster Ravenna adalah kelahiran aneh dari akhir masa Renaisans, mungkin apokrif, yang kemunculannya di dekat Ravenna awal 1512 banyak dilaporkan dalam pamflet dan catatan harian Eropa masa itu.
statement.en: The Monster of Ravenna was a possibly apocryphal monstrous birth of the late Renaissance whose appearance near Ravenna in early 1512 was widely reported in European pamphlets and diaries of the time.

claims.quote: Images of its grotesque features were interpreted symbolically by opponents of both the Catholic Church and the Protestant Reformation, although a more common explanation at the time was that the beast was an omen regarding the outcome of the Battle of Ravenna (1512).

statement.id: Gambaran rupanya yang aneh ditafsirkan secara simbolis oleh penentang Gereja Katolik maupun Reformasi Protestan, tetapi penjelasan yang lebih umum saat itu ialah bahwa makhluk itu pertanda hasil Pertempuran Ravenna (1512).
statement.en: Its grotesque features were read symbolically by opponents of both the Catholic Church and the Protestant Reformation, though the commoner explanation then was that it was an omen of the Battle of Ravenna (1512).

claims.quote: Modern medical consensus identifies the monster as a child with some variety of severe congenital disorder.

statement.id: Konsensus medis modern mengenalinya sebagai anak dengan kelainan bawaan berat.
statement.en: Modern medical consensus identifies the monster as a child with a severe congenital disorder.

claims.quote: According to his account, the child was said to have been born of a nun and a friar, and was marked by a horned head, the letters YXV on its chest, and with one leg hairy and cloven-hoofed while the other leg's midsection grew a human eye.

statement.id: Menurut catatan harian Sebastiano di Branca Tedallini, anak itu konon lahir dari seorang biarawati dan biarawan, berkepala bertanduk, bertanda huruf YXV di dadanya, dengan satu kaki berbulu berkuku belah dan kaki lain bermata manusia di tengahnya.
statement.en: According to the diary of Sebastiano di Branca Tedallini, the child was said to be born of a nun and a friar, with a horned head, the letters YXV on its chest, one hairy cloven-hoofed leg and a human eye in the middle of the other.

claims.quote: Landucci described it to possess features such as a single horn, the wings of a bat, hermaphroditic genitalia, an eye on its right knee and a clawed left foot like an eagle's.

statement.id: Luca Landucci menggambarkannya bertanduk satu, bersayap kelelawar, berkelamin ganda, bermata di lutut kanan, dan berkaki kiri bercakar seperti elang.
statement.en: Luca Landucci described a single horn, bat wings, hermaphrodite genitals, an eye on the right knee and a clawed left foot like an eagle's.

claims.quote: In medieval Europe, it was common practice for malformed infants, especially those with little chance of survival, to be abandoned and left to die by starvation; this was done in Ravenna on the order of the Pope.

statement.id: Di Eropa abad pertengahan bayi cacat yang kecil peluang hidupnya biasa ditelantarkan hingga mati kelaparan, dan di Ravenna hal ini dilakukan atas perintah Paus.
statement.en: In medieval Europe malformed infants with little chance of survival were commonly left to starve, and in Ravenna this was done on the Pope's order.

claims.quote: Le monstre serait né en 1511 à Ravenne, selon Lycosthènes, année précédant la bataille, ou le jour même (11 avril 1512), selon Boaistuau.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Prancis, monster itu lahir pada 1511 menurut Lycosthenes, setahun sebelum pertempuran, atau pada hari pertempuran itu sendiri (11 April 1512) menurut Boaistuau.
statement.en: According to the French article, the monster was born in 1511 according to Lycosthenes, the year before the battle, or on the very day (11 April 1512) according to Boaistuau.

claims.quote: Les Italiens n'ont pas suivi les signes inscrits sur la poitrine du monstre : l'upsilon (Υ) signifiant désir de vertu, et la croix au-dessous l'enseignement du Christ.

statement.id: Tanda di dadanya ditafsirkan sebagai upsilon (Υ), lambang keinginan akan kebajikan, dan salib di bawahnya ajaran Kristus, yang tidak diikuti orang Italia.
statement.en: The signs on its chest were read as an upsilon (Υ), the desire for virtue, and a cross below it, Christ's teaching, which the Italians failed to follow.

short_description.id: Morvarc'h ("kuda laut" dalam bahasa Breton) adalah kuda ajaib legenda Bretagne yang dapat berlari di atas ombak dan menyemburkan api dari lubang hidungnya.
short_description.en: Morvarc'h ('sea horse' in Breton) is a fabulous horse of Breton legend that gallops over the waves and breathes fire from its nostrils.

long_description.id: Morvarc'h, yang dalam bahasa Breton berarti "kuda laut", adalah kuda ajaib legenda Bretagne yang muncul dalam dua dongeng yang digubah ulang pada abad ke-19 dan ke-20. Meski namanya ada dalam sumber lebih tua, kuda ini diciptakan atau ditafsirkan ulang oleh Charles Guyot, yang menamainya Morvark dalam versinya tentang legenda kota Ys pada 1926. Kuda ini milik Malgven, "Ratu Utara", yang memberikannya kepada suaminya Raja Gradlon. Ia mampu berlari di atas ombak, berbulu hitam, dan menyemburkan api dari lubang hidungnya.
long_description.en: Morvarc'h, Breton for 'sea horse', is a wondrous horse of Breton legend found in two folktales retold in the 19th and 20th centuries. Its name occurs in older sources, but the horse itself was invented or reimagined by Charles Guyot, who called it Morvark in his 1926 version of the legend of the city of Ys. It belongs to Malgven, the 'Queen of the North', who gives it to her husband King Gradlon. It can gallop across the waves, has a black coat, and breathes flames from its nostrils.

long_description.id: Ia juga muncul dalam dongeng Breton tentang Raja Marc'h dari Cornouaille: dalam perburuan rusa ia tewas oleh panah penunggangnya sendiri, yang dibelokkan sihir Dahud, putri Malgven, lalu Dahud memasang telinga kuda itu di kepala Raja Marc'h. Legenda ini menjadi subjek patung berkuda di Argol dan di Katedral Saint-Corentin di Quimper. Namanya tercatat dalam kamus Grégoire de Rostrenen tahun 1732.
long_description.en: It also appears in a Breton tale of King Marc'h of Cornouaille: during a stag hunt it is killed by its own rider's arrow, turned back by a spell of Dahud, Malgven's daughter, who then sets the horse's ears on King Marc'h's head. The legend inspired equestrian statues at Argol and on Saint Corentin's Cathedral in Quimper. The name is recorded in Grégoire de Rostrenen's dictionary of 1732.

famous_for.en: King Gradlon's horse.

did_you_know.id: Dalam satu dongeng, telinga Morvarc'h dipasang di kepala Raja Marc'h oleh sihir Dahud.
did_you_know.en: In one tale Dahud's spell set Morvarc'h's ears on King Marc'h's head.

short_description.id: Muladona adalah bagal betina berkepala perempuan dari mitologi Katalan, gadis terkutuk yang menyusup ke rombongan bagal pada malam hari dan membuat mereka berlari ke jurang.
short_description.en: The Muladona is a woman-headed female mule of Catalan mythology, a cursed girl who slips into mule trains at night and drives them over ravines.

long_description.id: Muladona atau Donamula, "bagal-perempuan", adalah gadis yang dikutuk warga desanya menjadi bagal karena tidak hormat dan tidak beragama. Ia tampak seperti bagal tetapi bersurai seperti rambut perempuan, berwajah manusia, dan berpayudara. Pada malam hari ia bergabung dengan rombongan bagal di pegunungan sehingga bagal-bagal ketakutan dan jatuh ke jurang.
long_description.en: The Muladona or Donamula, 'mule-woman', is a girl her townsfolk cursed into a mule for being irreverent and irreligious. She looks like a mule but has a woman's hair for a mane, a human face and breasts. At night she joins mule trains in the mountains, so the mules panic and fall into ravines.

long_description.id: Kusir bagal memberi hewannya roti berbentuk Muladona agar tidak takut, dan terus menghitung bagal mereka agar ia tidak menyusup tanpa ketahuan.
long_description.en: Muleteers fed their animals Muladona-shaped bread so they would not take fright, and kept counting their mules so she could not slip in unseen.

famous_for.en: Muladona-shaped bread.

description.id: Bagal yang makan roti ini tidak takut kepadanya.
description.en: Mules fed this bread are not frightened of her.

claims.quote: In Catalan mythology, a Muladona or Donamula (mule-woman or woman-mule in Catalan) is a female mule with a human woman's head. Legend has it that a young woman was cursed by the townspeople for being irreverent and irreligious, and the curse turned her into a mule.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Katalan, Muladona atau Donamula ("bagal-perempuan") adalah bagal betina berkepala perempuan; menurut legenda, seorang gadis yang tidak hormat dan tidak beragama dikutuk warga desanya menjadi bagal.
statement.en: In Catalan mythology the Muladona or Donamula ('mule-woman') is a female mule with a woman's head; by legend a young woman cursed by her townsfolk for being irreverent and irreligious was turned into a mule.

claims.quote: According to legend, she wandered mountains, especially at night, joining mule trains. It was claimed that mules were frightened by her presence enough to stampede into ravines and die.

statement.id: Ia berkeliaran di pegunungan, terutama malam hari, dan bergabung dengan rombongan bagal, yang ketakutan hingga berlari ke jurang dan mati.
statement.en: She roamed the mountains, especially at night, joining mule trains, whose mules were so frightened they stampeded into ravines and died.

claims.quote: The Muladona looks like a mule, but it is a mixture of human and animal, its mane is like a woman's hair and its face, while still appearing to be like that of an animal, is obviously human.

statement.id: Muladona tampak seperti bagal tetapi campuran manusia dan hewan: surainya seperti rambut perempuan dan wajahnya, walau seperti hewan, jelas manusia.
statement.en: The Muladona looks like a mule but is a mix of human and animal: her mane is like a woman's hair, and her face, though animal-like, is clearly human.

claims.quote: It is always represented with the four legs of a mule, but sometimes the front two legs join a thorax, located where a mule would have its neck. In addition, the animal is always represented with breasts to underline that it is female.

statement.id: Ia selalu digambarkan berkaki empat bagal, kadang dengan kaki depan menyatu pada dada manusia di tempat leher bagal, dan selalu berpayudara untuk menegaskan bahwa ia perempuan.
statement.en: She is always shown with a mule's four legs, sometimes with the front legs joined to a chest where a mule's neck would be, and always with breasts to stress she is female.

claims.quote: The muleteers used to give their mules small Muladona-shaped pieces of bread to eat, in the belief that this would stop the animals being frightened and allow them to ignore her if she appeared.

statement.id: Para kusir bagal memberi bagal mereka roti kecil berbentuk Muladona agar hewan itu tidak takut dan mengabaikannya bila ia muncul.
statement.en: Muleteers fed their mules little Muladona-shaped breads so the animals would not take fright and would ignore her if she appeared.

claims.quote: Así y todo, durante la marcha contaban las cabezas que llevaban para evitar que la muladona se hubiese mezclado con sus animales sin que ellos se diesen cuenta y acabasen pagándolo caro.

short_description.id: Muu shuvuu adalah burung iblis dalam mitologi Mongol dan Buryat, jiwa gadis yang mati muda, yang tampil sebagai gadis berparuh tajam dan mengisap darah korbannya.
short_description.en: Muu shuvuu is a demon bird of Mongolic and Buryat mythology, the soul of a girl who died young, appearing as a sharp-beaked girl that sucks its victims' blood.

long_description.id: Muu shuvuu, "burung jahat", adalah burung mitologis dalam mitologi Turkik dan Mongol. Ia tercipta dari jiwa gadis yang mati muda atau mati dengan kekerasan, atau dari putri yang di tangannya diselipkan batu api oleh sang ayah. Ia tampak seperti gadis muda tetapi berparuh tajam yang disembunyikan di balik kerudung atau tangan, dan dengan paruh itu ia mengisap darah pejalan dan pemburu yang sendirian.
long_description.en: Muu shuvuu, "evil bird", is a mythological bird of Turkic and Mongolic mythology. It arises from the soul of a girl who died young or violently, or of a daughter whose father hid a flint in her hand. It looks like a young girl but has a sharp beak hidden behind a veil or the hands, with which it sucks the blood of lone travellers and hunters.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Buryat, Muu Shubuun adalah makhluk iblis berwujud burung buruk rupa atau pemakan bangkai, personifikasi wabah, kematian mendadak, mata jahat, dan segala kemalangan.
long_description.en: In Buryat mythology Muu Shubuun is a demonic being shaped like an ugly or carrion bird, the personification of epidemics, sudden death, the evil eye and every misfortune.

short_description.id: Nahuelito adalah monster danau yang konon hidup di Danau Nahuel Huapi di Patagonia, Argentina, dan digambarkan sebagai ular raksasa atau plesiosaurus.
short_description.en: Nahuelito is a lake monster said to live in Nahuel Huapi Lake in Patagonia, Argentina, described as a giant serpent or a plesiosaur.

long_description.id: Nahuelito adalah monster danau yang konon menghuni Danau Nahuel Huapi di Patagonia, Argentina. Wujudnya digambarkan sebagai ular raksasa, punuk besar, atau plesiosaurus. Legenda ini diyakini berakar pada cerita penduduk asli dari masa sebelum kolonisasi Amerika.
long_description.en: Nahuelito is a lake monster said to inhabit Nahuel Huapi Lake in Patagonia, Argentina. It is described as a giant serpent, a huge hump or a plesiosaur. The legend is thought to be rooted in indigenous stories from before the colonization of the Americas.

long_description.id: Sejak 1897, Clemente Onelli dari Kebun Binatang Buenos Aires menerima laporan tentang makhluk aneh di danau-danau Patagonia. Penampakan George Garret tahun 1910 baru diumumkan pada 1922 lewat Toronto Globe. Pada 1960 Angkatan Laut Argentina dikabarkan mengejar benda bawah air tak dikenal di danau itu selama 18 hari, dan pada 1988 foto-foto yang diklaim sebagai Nahuelito dimuat di majalah surat kabar Río Negro.
long_description.en: From 1897, Clemente Onelli of the Buenos Aires Zoo received reports of a strange creature in the Patagonian lakes. George Garret's 1910 sighting was only published in 1922, in the Toronto Globe. In 1960 the Argentine Navy reportedly chased an unidentified underwater object in the lake for 18 days, and in 1988 photos claimed to show Nahuelito appeared in a magazine of the Río Negro newspaper.

long_description.en: Nahuelito is widely known in Argentina and is regarded as a classic case of cryptozoology.

short_description.id: Nekomata adalah yōkai kucing dalam cerita rakyat Jepang yang biasanya digambarkan memiliki ekor bercabang dua.
short_description.en: Nekomata is a cat yōkai in Japanese folklore usually depicted with a tail split in two.

long_description.id: Nekomata adalah yōkai yang dikisahkan berasal dari kucing tua atau besar. Ciri yang sering disebut ialah ekor bercabang dua. Dalam sebagian kisah ia berjalan dengan dua kaki, berbicara seperti manusia, dan mengganggu orang. Ada pula tradisi yang menempatkannya sebagai makhluk pegunungan berbahaya. Gambaran ini menunjukkan bahwa kisah nekomata tidak hanya tentang kucing peliharaan di rumah.
long_description.en: Nekomata are yōkai said to arise from old or large cats. A familiar sign is a tail divided in two. Some accounts have them walk on two legs, speak human language, and cause mischief. Other traditions place them among dangerous mountain creatures. The stories therefore extend beyond household cats.

long_description.id: Dalam seni Jepang, nekomata tampil sebagai kucing berekor bercabang yang menari pada dua kaki, termasuk dalam gambar Toriyama Sekien. Sebuah kajian koleksi seni mengingatkan bahwa batas antara nekomata dan bakeneko sering kabur. Satu kisah daerah Nakanomata di Niigata menuturkan seorang penduduk mengalahkan nekomata, sedangkan legenda Gunung Nekomata di Toyama mengisahkan makhluk yang menyerang manusia. Beragam contoh ini menunjukkan perkembangan penggambarannya dalam seni dan cerita setempat.
long_description.en: In Japanese art, nekomata appear as fork-tailed cats dancing on two legs, including in images by Toriyama Sekien. A study of an art collection notes that the boundary between nekomata and bakeneko is often unclear. A Niigata story tells of a villager defeating a nekomata, while a Toyama mountain legend tells of a creature that attacked people. These examples show their varied roles in art and local stories.

sources.title: Waneko Studies: A Journey into Japan’s Cat Lore
sources.author: Kimie Itakura

short_description.id: Nuggle adalah kuda air mitos dalam folklor Shetland, makhluk nokturnal jantan yang lebih suka iseng daripada mencelakai.
short_description.en: The nuggle is a mythical water horse of Shetland folklore, a nocturnal male creature given to pranks rather than malice.

long_description.id: Nuggle, njuggle atau neugle adalah kuda air mitos terutama dari folklor Shetland, di beberapa bagian kepulauan disebut juga shoepultie atau shoopiltee. Makhluk nokturnal yang selalu jantan ini sesekali dikaitkan dengan Kepulauan Orkney, tetapi lebih sering dengan sungai, aliran air dan loch di Shetland. Ia mudah dikenali dari ekornya yang mirip roda dan, tidak seperti each-uisge atau nuckelavee yang jahat, wataknya cukup lembut, lebih gemar iseng dan membuat kekacauan kecil.
long_description.en: The nuggle, njuggle or neugle is a mythical water horse mostly of Shetland folklore, called shoepultie or shoopiltee in some parts of the islands. Always male and active by night, it is now and then linked with Orkney but more often with the rivers, burns and lochs of Shetland. Its wheel-like tail gives it away, and unlike the wicked each-uisge or nuckelavee it is fairly mild, preferring tricks and mischief to real harm.

long_description.id: Nuggle juga ditemukan di dekat kincir air dan tak pernah jauh dari air. Ia dapat menyamar dalam banyak wujud tetapi biasanya memilih wujud kuda yang menarik, dan tak pernah menjadi manusia. Bila berhasil memperdaya orang untuk menungganginya, dengan berpura-pura jinak di tepi jalan, ia langsung lari ke air terdalam. Jessie Saxby menduga ketakutan akan nuggle menjauhkan anak-anak dari air dalam dan kincir air.
long_description.en: Nuggles also lurked by watermills and never went far from water. Though able to take many shapes, it usually chose that of a fine horse and never became a man. If it fooled a passer-by into mounting it, by standing quietly and tamely beside a path, it at once made for the nearest deep water. Jessie Saxby suggested that fear of the nuggle kept children away from deep water and mills.

short_description.id: Oilliphéist adalah ular laut atau monster mirip naga dalam mitologi dan cerita rakyat Irlandia, yang konon mengukir alur Sungai Shannon.
short_description.en: The Oilliphéist is a sea serpent or dragon-like monster of Irish myth and folklore said to have carved the course of the River Shannon.

long_description.id: Oilliphéist (dari oll "besar" dan péist "cacing, binatang ajaib, monster, reptil") adalah ular laut atau monster mirip naga dalam mitologi dan cerita rakyat Irlandia (Irish). Monster-monster ini diyakini menghuni banyak danau dan sungai di Irlandia (Ireland), dan ada banyak legenda tentang orang suci dan pahlawan yang melawan mereka. Dalam satu kisah, Sionnan, cucu Manannán mac Lir, membuat marah Salmon of Knowledge dengan melemparinya batu, dan ikan itu memanggil seekor Oilliphéist yang akhirnya membunuhnya.
long_description.en: Its name joining oll, 'great', to péist, a word for worm, beast or monster, the Oilliphéist is a dragon-like sea serpent of Irish legend. Such monsters were believed to live in many Irish lakes and rivers, and many legends tell of saints and heroes fighting them. One tale tells how Sionnan, a granddaughter of Manannán mac Lir, pelted the Salmon of Knowledge with stones; in revenge the fish summoned an Oilliphéist, which killed her.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah lain, seekor Oilliphéist mengukir alur Sungai Shannon dan danau-danau di dekatnya ketika mendengar bahwa Santo Patrick datang untuk mengusirnya: ia berangkat dari Shannon Pot, membentuk Lough Allen, dan melahap domba serta sapi penduduk. Penduduk dekat Athleague melawannya dipimpin peniup pipa mabuk bernama O'Rourke, yang ditelan monster itu tetapi terus bermain pipa di dalam perutnya selama berhari-hari hingga dimuntahkan. Menurut artikel pt, Ollphéist adalah sekelompok monster laut yang kadang digambarkan bercirikan naga, ular, atau serangga, di selatan disebut Ollpiasta, dan kadang dapat terbang atau berbicara.
long_description.en: In another tale an Oilliphéist carves the course of the Shannon and nearby lakes on hearing that Saint Patrick has come to drive it out: setting off from Shannon Pot, it forms Lough Allen and devours the locals' sheep and cattle. People near Athleague stand against it led by a drunken piper named O'Rourke, whom it swallows; he keeps piping in its stomach for days until it coughs him up. According to the pt article Ollphéist names a group of sea monsters sometimes given dragon, snake or even insect traits, called Ollpiasta in the south, and at times able to fly or speak.

famous_for.en: Swallowed a piper.

did_you_know.id: Menurut legenda, seorang peniup pipa yang ditelan Oilliphéist terus bermain di dalam perutnya sampai monster itu memuntahkannya.
did_you_know.en: Legend says a piper swallowed by the Oilliphéist kept playing in its stomach until the monster spat him out.

description.en: Sometimes able to fly or speak.

Summoned it to attack Sionnan.

claims.quote: 'great' and péist 'worm, fabulous beast, monster, reptile') is a sea serpent or dragon-like monster in Irish mythology and folklore.

statement.id: Oilliphéist (oll besar, péist cacing/monster) ular laut atau monster mirip naga mitologi Irlandia (Irish); di Irlandia.
statement.en: The Oilliphéist (oll great, péist worm/monster) is a sea serpent or dragon-like monster of Irish mythology.

claims.quote: These monsters were believed to inhabit many lakes and rivers in Ireland and there are many legends of saints and heroes fighting them. One story has a girl named Sionnan, grand daughter of Manannán mac Lir, angered the Salmon of Knowledge by throwing stones at it.

statement.id: Menghuni danau dan sungai Irlandia (Ireland); Sionnan cucu Manannán mac Lir membuat marah Salmon of Knowledge.
statement.en: They live in Irish lakes and rivers; Sionnan, granddaughter of Manannán mac Lir, angered the Salmon of Knowledge.

claims.quote: In one story, an Oilliphéist cuts the route of the River Shannon (as well as adjacent lakes) when it hears that Saint Patrick has come to drive out it and its kind. It started its journey in Shannon Pot, then carved out Lough Allen.

statement.id: Oilliphéist mengukir Sungai Shannon (River Shannon) saat Santo Patrick (Saint Patrick) datang; dari Shannon Pot, membentuk Lough Allen.
statement.en: An Oilliphéist carves the River Shannon when Saint Patrick comes; from Shannon Pot it carves Lough Allen.

claims.quote: The monster swallows O'Rourke but he survives, continuing to play the pipe inside the Oilliphéist's stomach for several days. The monster becomes so annoyed with Ó Ruairc's music that it coughs him up and spits him out.

statement.id: Menelan O'Rourke (Ó Ruairc) yang terus bermain pipa di perutnya, lalu memuntahkannya.
statement.en: It swallows O'Rourke (Ó Ruairc), who keeps piping in its stomach, then spits him out.

claims.quote: Ollphéist é um grupo de monstros marinhos, por vezes descritos  com características de dragões, cobras ou mesmo de insectos, referidos como monstros nas lendas e folclore gaélicos. Chamam-se 'Ollpiasta' no sul.

statement.id: Ollphéist sekelompok monster laut (monstros marinhos) bercirikan naga, ular, serangga, dalam folklore Gaelik (gaélicos); di selatan Ollpiasta.
statement.en: Ollphéist is a group of sea monsters (monstros marinhos) with dragon, snake or insect traits in Gaelic (gaélicos) lore; Ollpiasta in the south.

claims.quote: Por vezes possuem poderes especiais, como a virtude do voo ou da fala. Normalmente habitam lagos e, mais raramente, rios ou o oceano.

statement.id: Kadang dapat terbang atau berbicara; tinggal di danau, sungai, laut.
statement.en: Sometimes able to fly or speak; they live in lakes, rivers or the ocean.

claims.quote: It then went through Leitrim village and Carrick-on-Shannon, devouring the resident's sheep and cattle.

statement.id: Melahap domba dan sapi penduduk Leitrim dan Carrick-on-Shannon.
statement.en: It devoured residents' sheep and cattle at Leitrim and Carrick-on-Shannon.

claims.quote: The people near Athleague were angered by the loss of their livestock and took a stand against the beast, led by a drunken piper named O'Rourke (Ó Ruairc).

statement.id: Penduduk Athleague melawannya dipimpin peniup pipa mabuk O'Rourke.
statement.en: People near Athleague, led by the drunken piper O'Rourke, stood against it.

short_description.id: Ojáncanu adalah raksasa bermata satu dalam mitologi Cantabria, perwujudan kekejaman, yang hanya dapat dibunuh dengan mencabut rambut putih di janggutnya.
short_description.en: The Ojáncanu is a one-eyed giant of Cantabrian mythology, an embodiment of cruelty, killed only by pulling the white hair from its beard.

long_description.id: Ojáncanu adalah raksasa mirip kiklops dalam mitologi Cantabria dan perwujudan kekejaman. Ia bermata satu, setinggi 10 sampai 20 kaki, sangat kuat, berjari sepuluh di tiap tangan dan kaki, dan bergigi dua baris. Ia tinggal di gua-gua suram di daerah terpencil La Montaña. Pasangannya disebut ojáncana.
long_description.en: The Ojáncanu is a cyclops-like giant of Cantabrian mythology and the embodiment of cruelty. It is one-eyed, 10 to 20 ft tall, immensely strong, with ten digits on each hand and foot and two rows of teeth. It lives in gloomy caves in remote parts of La Montaña. Its female is called the ojáncana.

long_description.id: Ia terus berbuat jahat: mencabut batu, merusak gubuk, dan menyumbat mata air, dan selalu menang melawan beruang dan banteng. Ia hanya takut pada Anjana, juga pada katak terbang dan burung hantu. Cara termudah membunuhnya adalah mencabut satu-satunya rambut putih di janggutnya. Ojáncanu tidak kawin; jasad yang tua dikubur di bawah pohon ek atau yew.
long_description.en: It constantly does evil, pulling up rocks, wrecking huts and blocking springs, and always beats bears and bulls. It fears only the Anjanas, as well as flying toads and barn owls. The easiest way to kill it is to pull the single white hair from its beard. Ojáncanus do not mate; an old one's corpse is buried under an oak or yew.

famous_for.en: The white hair in its beard.

name.en: The white hair in its beard

description.id: Mencabutnya membunuh Ojáncanu.
description.en: Pulling it out kills the Ojáncanu.

description.id: Satu-satunya yang ia takuti.
description.en: The only beings it fears.

note.id: Peri baik Cantabria yang ia takuti.
note.en: The good Cantabrian fairy it fears.

claims.quote: The Ojáncanu (Cantabrian: [oˈhankanu]) is a cyclops-like giant found in Cantabrian mythology, and is an embodiment of cruelty and brutality.

statement.id: Ojáncanu adalah raksasa mirip kiklops dalam mitologi Cantabria, perwujudan kekejaman dan kebrutalan.
statement.en: The Ojáncanu is a cyclops-like giant of Cantabrian mythology, an embodiment of cruelty and brutality.

claims.quote: It appears as a 10 to 20 ft. one-eyed giant with superhuman strength, with hands and feet that contain ten digits each, and two rows of teeth.

statement.id: Ia raksasa bermata satu setinggi 10 sampai 20 kaki dengan kekuatan luar biasa, berjari sepuluh di tiap tangan dan kaki, dan bergigi dua baris.
statement.en: It appears as a one-eyed giant 10 to 20 ft tall with superhuman strength, ten digits on each hand and foot, and two rows of teeth.

claims.quote: Apparently the easiest way of killing an Ojancanu is to pull the single white hair found in its mess of a beard.

statement.id: Cara termudah membunuh Ojáncanu konon dengan mencabut satu-satunya rambut putih di janggutnya yang kusut.
statement.en: The easiest way to kill an Ojáncanu is said to be pulling out the single white hair in its tangled beard.

claims.quote: He is constantly doing evil deeds such as pulling up rocks, destroying huts and trees, and blocking water sources. He fights Cantabrian brown bears and Tudanca bulls, and always wins. He only fears the Anjanas, the good Cantabrian fairies.

statement.id: Ia terus berbuat jahat, seperti mencabut batu, merusak gubuk dan pohon, dan menyumbat mata air; ia selalu menang melawan beruang cokelat dan banteng Tudanca, dan hanya takut pada Anjana, peri baik Cantabria.
statement.en: He constantly does evil, pulling up rocks, wrecking huts and trees and blocking springs; he fights brown bears and Tudanca bulls and always wins, fearing only the Anjanas, the good fairies of Cantabria.

claims.quote: Instead of mating when an old Ojancanu dies, the others distribute the insides and bury the corpse under an oak or yew tree.

statement.id: Mereka tidak berkembang biak dengan kawin; ketika Ojáncanu tua mati, yang lain membagi isi perutnya dan mengubur jasadnya di bawah pohon ek atau yew.
statement.en: Instead of mating, when an old Ojáncanu dies the others share out its insides and bury the corpse under an oak or yew.

claims.quote: De carácter salvaje, fiero y vengativo, esta criatura habita en las profundas y lúgubres grutas de los parajes más recónditos de La Montaña, cuyas entradas suelen estar cerradas con maleza y grandes rocas.

statement.id: Makhluk liar, buas, dan pendendam ini tinggal di gua-gua dalam dan suram di tempat paling terpencil di La Montaña, yang pintunya tertutup semak dan batu besar.
statement.en: This wild, fierce and vengeful creature lives in deep, gloomy caves in the remotest parts of La Montaña, their entrances blocked with brush and boulders.

claims.quote: Por otro lado la tradición dice que tienen mucho miedo a los sapos voladores y a las lechuzas.

statement.id: Tradisi juga menyebut mereka sangat takut pada katak terbang dan burung hantu.
statement.en: Tradition also says they greatly fear flying toads and barn owls.

claims.quote: Ojáncanu estas virseksulo kaj ĝia edzino estas in-seksa ojáncana. Ilia kontraŭulo estas anjana, bonfarema feino en la kantabra mitaro, kiun ili timas.

statement.id: Menurut artikel Esperanto, Ojáncanu jantan dan pasangannya disebut ojáncana; lawan mereka adalah anjana, peri baik Cantabria yang mereka takuti.
statement.en: According to the Esperanto article, the Ojáncanu is male and its female is the ojáncana; their opponent is the anjana, the benevolent Cantabrian fairy they fear.

short_description.id: Ördög adalah makhluk iblis pengubah wujud dalam mitologi dan paganisme awal Hungaria yang menguasai kekuatan gelap dan jahat di dunia.
short_description.en: Ördög is a shape-shifting demonic being of Hungarian mythology and early paganism who controls the dark and evil forces of the world.

long_description.id: Ördög, dalam bahasa Hungaria Kuno Ürdüng, adalah makhluk iblis pengubah wujud dari mitologi dan paganisme awal Hungaria yang menguasai kekuatan gelap dan jahat di dunia. Setelah Kristenisasi ia disamakan dengan Iblis. Dalam mitologi Hungaria, Isten (Tuhan) dibantu Ördög saat menciptakan dunia.
long_description.en: Ördög, Ürdüng in Old Hungarian, is a form-changing demon of Hungarian myth and early paganism who commands the world's dark and evil powers. After Christianisation he was equated with the Devil. In Hungarian myth Isten, God, had Ördög's help in creating the world.

long_description.id: Ia agak mirip satir atau faun: tubuh atas lelaki dan tubuh bawah kambing, biasanya hitam pekat, berkuku belah, bertanduk domba, berekor panjang yang ujungnya seperti bilah, dan membawa garpu. Ia tinggal di dunia bawah atau neraka, Pokol, sambil terus mengaduk kuali besar berisi jiwa orang berdosa. Bila datang ke bumi ia bersembunyi di dinding rumah korbannya, atau menjelma rubah, nyala api gelap, atau gembala Hungaria bermata gelap berkilat; ia suka bertaruh dengan manusia untuk mengumpulkan jiwa.
long_description.en: He resembles a satyr or faun, man above and goat below, usually jet black, with cloven hooves, ram's horns, a long blade-tipped tail and a pitchfork. He lives in the underworld or hell, Pokol, forever stirring a vast cauldron of sinners' souls. On earth he may lurk inside his victims' walls making faint squeaks, or take the guise of a fox, a dark flame or a Hungarian herdsman whose dark eyes sparkle; he likes to wager with people in order to win their souls.

who.id: Ördög adalah iblis dalam mitologi Hungaria.
who.en: Ördög is a demon of Hungarian mythology.

origin.id: Ia berasal dari paganisme awal Hungaria.
origin.en: He comes from early Hungarian paganism.

famous_for.en: He loves betting with humans to collect souls.

did_you_know.en: According to Hungarian mythology, Isten had Ördög's help in creating the world.

claims.quote: (Ürdüng in Old Hungarian) is a shape-shifting, demonic creature from Hungarian mythology and early Hungarian paganism who controls the dark and evil forces of the world.

statement.id: Ördög (Ürdüng dalam bahasa Hungaria Kuno) adalah makhluk iblis pengubah wujud dari mitologi dan paganisme awal Hungaria yang menguasai kekuatan gelap dan jahat di dunia.
statement.en: Ördög (Ürdüng in Old Hungarian) is a shape-shifting demonic creature of Hungarian mythology and early paganism who controls the dark and evil forces of the world.

claims.quote: After Christianization, it was identified with the devil. In Hungarian mythology God (Isten in Hungarian) had help from Ördög when creating the world.

statement.id: Setelah Kristenisasi ia disamakan dengan Iblis; dalam mitologi Hungaria Tuhan (Isten) dibantu Ördög saat menciptakan dunia.
statement.en: After Christianisation it was identified with the Devil; in Hungarian mythology God (Isten) had Ördög's help in creating the world.

claims.quote: Ördög looks somewhat like a satyr or faun, a humanoid with the upper torso of a human male and lower portions of a goat; usually pitch-black, with cloven hooves, ram-like horns, a long tail ending in a blade; and he carries a pitchfork.

statement.id: Ördög agak mirip satir atau faun, bertubuh atas lelaki dan bawah kambing, biasanya hitam pekat, berkuku belah, bertanduk domba, berekor panjang berujung bilah, dan membawa garpu.
statement.en: Ördög looks somewhat like a satyr or faun, man above and goat below, usually pitch-black, with cloven hooves, ram-like horns, a long blade-tipped tail, carrying a pitchfork.

claims.quote: He dwells in the underworld or hell (Pokol in Hungarian), constantly stirring a huge cauldron filled with souls of those who lived in sin (however, it is uncertain whether the underworld was regarded as place of punishment or not in pre-Christian Hungarian mythology

statement.id: Ia tinggal di dunia bawah atau neraka (Pokol), terus mengaduk kuali besar berisi jiwa orang berdosa; namun tidak pasti apakah dunia bawah dianggap tempat hukuman dalam mitologi Hungaria pra-Kristen.
statement.en: He dwells in the underworld or hell (Pokol), constantly stirring a huge cauldron of sinners' souls; it is uncertain, however, whether the underworld was a place of punishment in pre-Christian Hungarian mythology.

claims.quote: In other legends, when he comes to earth, he takes the form of a fox, a dark flame or a Hungarian shepherd with dark, sparkling eyes. It is his habit to make bets with humans to see if they become corrupted. His long-term goal is to collect more human souls

statement.id: Dalam legenda lain, saat ke bumi ia menjelma rubah, nyala api gelap, atau gembala Hungaria bermata gelap berkilat; ia biasa bertaruh dengan manusia untuk melihat apakah mereka menjadi rusak, dengan tujuan mengumpulkan jiwa; menurut legenda lain ia bersembunyi di dinding rumah korban.
statement.en: In other legends, on earth he becomes a fox, a dark flame or a Hungarian shepherd with dark, sparkling eyes; he habitually bets with humans to see if they become corrupted, aiming to collect souls; other legends have him hide in victims' walls.

claims.quote: Когда он всё-таки приходит на землю, то, согласно некоторым легендам, он прячется в стенах жертв и издаёт едва уловимые звуки, звучащие пронзительно и даже пискляво.

statement.id: Menurut beberapa legenda, saat datang ke bumi ia bersembunyi di dinding rumah korban dan mengeluarkan bunyi halus yang melengking.
statement.en: According to some legends, when he comes to earth he hides in victims' walls and makes faint, shrill, squeaky sounds.

summary.id: Ördög mengaduk kuali jiwa para pendosa di Pokol.
summary.en: Ördög stirs a cauldron of sinners' souls in Pokol.

summary.id: Tidak pasti apakah dunia bawah dianggap tempat hukuman dalam mitologi Hungaria pra-Kristen.
summary.en: It is uncertain whether the underworld was a place of punishment in pre-Christian Hungarian myth.
