short_description.id: Pard adalah kucing besar berbintik dalam bestiari abad pertengahan yang dianggap kawin dengan singa dan, sejak abad ke-13, makhluk haus darah yang hampir iblis.
short_description.en: The pard is a spotted big cat of medieval bestiaries believed to mate with lions and, from the 13th century, seen as a bloodthirsty, almost demonic creature.

long_description.id: Pard, dari kata Yunani Kuno untuk macan tutul, tercantum dalam Naturalis Historia karya Plinius Tua dan bestiari abad pertengahan. Plinius menulis bahwa cheetah lahir dari singa betina yang kawin dengan pard, dan bahwa singa jantan membalas dendam bila mencium bau pard pada pasangannya. Isidorus dari Sevilla menggambarkan bulunya berbintik seperti jerapah dan menyebutnya haus darah.
long_description.en: The pard, from the Ancient Greek word for the leopard, appears in Pliny the Elder's Natural History and in medieval bestiaries. Pliny writes that cheetahs were born of lionesses mating with pards, and that the male lion takes revenge when he smells a pard on his mate. Isidore of Seville describes its coat as mottled like a giraffe's and calls it bloodthirsty.

long_description.id: Pada abad ke-13, terutama lewat Bestiari MS Bodley 764, pard menjadi makhluk haus darah yang hampir iblis, dengan bintik yang melambangkan dosa. Dalam bestiari ia juga disebut pardus, kucing besar yang sangat cepat yang kawin dengan singa untuk menghasilkan leopard.
long_description.en: In the 13th century, chiefly through the MS Bodley 764 Bestiary, the pard became a bloodthirsty, almost demonic creature whose spots symbolised sin. In bestiaries it is also called the pardus, an extremely fast big cat that mates with lions to produce leopards.

famous_for.en: Spots symbolising sin.

claims.quote: Pard (Ancient Greek: πάρδος) is the Ancient Greek word for the leopard, which is listed in medieval bestiaries and in Pliny the Elder's book Natural History.

statement.id: Pard (Yunani Kuno: πάρδος) adalah kata Yunani Kuno untuk macan tutul, yang tercantum dalam bestiari abad pertengahan dan Naturalis Historia karya Plinius Tua.
statement.en: Pard (Ancient Greek πάρδος) is the Ancient Greek word for the leopard, listed in medieval bestiaries and in Pliny the Elder's Natural History.

claims.quote: Pliny writes about the origin of cheetahs (though he does not have a clearly separate word for these animals) which were believed to be a hybrid animal (like mules or ligers) resulting from the union between a promiscuous lioness and the pard, i.e. the leopard.

statement.id: Plinius menulis bahwa cheetah dipercaya hewan hibrida hasil perkawinan singa betina yang tidak setia dengan pard.
statement.en: Pliny writes that cheetahs were believed to be hybrids born of a promiscuous lioness and the pard.

claims.quote: Pliny also states that the sexual passion between the pard and lioness is so violent that it enrages the male lion, who will often seek revenge on a lioness when smelling the pard.

statement.id: Menurut Plinius, gairah antara pard dan singa betina begitu hebat sehingga membuat singa jantan murka dan membalas dendam bila mencium bau pard pada singa betina.
statement.en: Pliny also says the passion between pard and lioness is so violent that it enrages the male lion, who takes revenge on the lioness when he smells the pard on her.

claims.quote: In the seventh-century book Etymologies, Isidore of Seville describes their coats as being mottled like a giraffe's. He goes on to describe them as being "headlong for blood" by being capable of killing their prey in a single leap.

statement.id: Dalam Etymologiae abad ke-7, Isidorus dari Sevilla menggambarkan bulunya berbintik seperti jerapah dan menyebutnya haus darah karena dapat membunuh mangsa dalam satu lompatan.
statement.en: In the 7th-century Etymologies, Isidore of Seville describes their coats as mottled like a giraffe's and calls them 'headlong for blood', able to kill prey in one leap.

claims.quote: It was not until the 13th century that pards acquired their mythical reputation for being bloodthirsty and almost demonic creatures, primarily thanks to the MS Bodley 764 Bestiary. In this source, their spots were said to symbolize sins, the devil, or even the variety of vices in mankind.

statement.id: Baru pada abad ke-13 pard mendapat reputasi mitis sebagai makhluk haus darah yang hampir iblis, terutama berkat Bestiari MS Bodley 764, yang menyebut bintik-bintiknya melambangkan dosa, iblis, atau aneka kebejatan manusia.
statement.en: Only in the 13th century did pards gain their mythic reputation as bloodthirsty, almost demonic creatures, chiefly through the MS Bodley 764 Bestiary, in which their spots symbolised sins, the devil or the many vices of mankind.

claims.quote: El pardus es un animal de los bestiarios medievales. Fueron felinos con pelaje manchado y eran extremadamente rápidos (lo que recuerda a un guepardo). Se creía que se apareaban con los leones para producir leopardos.

statement.id: Pardus adalah hewan bestiari abad pertengahan, kucing besar berbulu bintik yang sangat cepat, yang dipercaya kawin dengan singa untuk menghasilkan leopard.
statement.en: The pardus is an animal of medieval bestiaries, a spotted, extremely fast feline believed to mate with lions to produce leopards.

short_description.id: Patasola adalah monster perempuan berkaki satu dalam cerita rakyat Kolombia yang menyamar sebagai perempuan cantik untuk memikat pria ke dalam hutan.
short_description.en: The Patasola is a one-legged female monster of Colombian folklore who disguises herself as a beautiful woman to lure men into the jungle.

long_description.id: Patasola, yang berarti "satu kaki", adalah monster perempuan hutan dalam cerita rakyat Kolombia. Ia mendatangi pemburu atau penebang kayu di belantara, menyamar sebagai perempuan cantik yang sering menyerupai orang terkasih, lalu memikat pria menjauh dari rekan-rekannya. Di dalam hutan ia menampakkan wujud aslinya: makhluk berkaki satu yang haus daging dan darah manusia.
long_description.en: The Patasola, meaning "single leg", is a female jungle monster of Colombian folklore. She appears to hunters or loggers in the wilderness disguised as a beautiful woman, often resembling a loved one, and lures a man away from his companions. Deep in the forest she reveals her true form: a one-legged creature hungry for human flesh and blood.

long_description.id: Kaki tunggalnya berakhir dengan kuku belah seperti kuku sapi, dan ia dipercaya bisa berubah menjadi anjing hitam besar atau sapi. Ia menghuni pegunungan dan hutan lebat, dan biasanya dianggap pelindung alam serta satwa hutan yang tidak mengampuni perusak hutan.
long_description.en: Her single leg ends in a cloven, cow-like hoof, and she is believed to turn into a large black dog or a cow. She lives in mountains and dense forest and is usually seen as a protector of nature and forest animals who shows no mercy to those who damage them.

long_description.id: Asal-usulnya beragam: seorang ibu yang membunuh anaknya lalu dibuang ke hutan, penggoda kejam yang kakinya dipotong dengan kapak, atau arwah perempuan tidak setia yang mempermalukan suaminya.
long_description.en: Her origin varies: a mother who killed her son and was banished to the woods, a cruel temptress whose leg was cut off with an axe, or the soul of an unfaithful woman who dishonoured her husband.

who.id: Monster perempuan berkaki satu dari hutan Kolombia.
who.en: A one-legged female monster of the Colombian jungle.

role.id: Memikat pemburu dan penebang kayu ke dalam hutan.
role.en: Lures hunters and loggers into the forest.

famous_for.en: Her single hoofed leg.

did_you_know.id: Patasola juga dianggap pelindung satwa hutan.
did_you_know.en: The Patasola is also seen as a protector of forest animals.

description.id: Menyamar sebagai perempuan cantik atau berubah menjadi anjing hitam atau sapi.
description.en: Disguises herself as a beautiful woman or turns into a black dog or a cow.

claims.quote: The Patasola or "single leg" is one of many legends in Colombian folklore about female monster from jungle, appearing to male hunters or loggers in the middle of the wilderness if they think about women.

statement.id: Patasola atau "satu kaki" adalah legenda cerita rakyat Kolombia tentang monster perempuan hutan yang mendatangi pemburu atau penebang kayu di tengah belantara bila mereka memikirkan perempuan.
statement.en: The Patasola, or "single leg", is a Colombian folk legend of a female jungle monster who appears to hunters or loggers in the wilderness when they think about women.

claims.quote: The Patasola appears in the form of a beautiful seductive woman, often in the likeness of a loved one, who lures a man away from his companions, deep into jungle.

statement.id: Patasola muncul sebagai perempuan cantik yang menggoda, sering menyerupai orang terkasih, lalu memikat seorang pria menjauh dari rekan-rekannya ke dalam hutan.
statement.en: The Patasola appears as a beautiful, seductive woman, often like a loved one, and lures a man away from his companions into the jungle.

claims.quote: There, the Patasola reveals it's true, hideous appearance as a one-legged creature with ferocious vampire-like lust for human flesh and blood

statement.id: Di sana ia menampakkan wujud aslinya yang mengerikan: makhluk berkaki satu yang haus daging dan darah manusia seperti vampir.
statement.en: There it reveals its true, hideous form: a one-legged creature with a vampire-like lust for human flesh and blood.

claims.quote: According to popular belief, it inhabits mountain ranges, virgin forests, and other heavily wooded or jungle-like areas.

statement.id: Menurut kepercayaan rakyat, ia menghuni pegunungan, hutan perawan, dan kawasan berhutan lebat.
statement.en: Popular belief places it in mountain ranges, virgin forests and other densely wooded areas.

claims.quote: The patasola is usually regarded as protective of nature and the forest animals and unforgiving when humans enter their domain to alter or destroy them.

statement.id: Patasola biasanya dianggap pelindung alam dan satwa hutan, dan tidak mengampuni manusia yang masuk untuk merusaknya.
statement.en: The Patasola is usually seen as a protector of nature and forest animals, unforgiving toward people who enter to damage them.

claims.quote: is her one leg which terminates in a cleaved bovine-like hoof

statement.id: Kaki tunggalnya berakhir dengan kuku belah seperti kuku sapi.
statement.en: Her single leg ends in a cloven, cow-like hoof.

claims.quote: It is also believed that she can transform into other animals, materializing as a large black dog or cow.

statement.id: Ia juga dipercaya dapat berubah menjadi hewan lain, seperti anjing hitam besar atau sapi.
statement.en: She is also believed to turn into other animals, such as a large black dog or a cow.

claims.quote: Some believe that she was a mother who killed her own son and was then banished to the woods as punishment.

statement.id: Sebagian orang percaya ia dulunya seorang ibu yang membunuh anaknya lalu dibuang ke hutan sebagai hukuman.
statement.en: Some believe she was a mother who killed her own son and was banished to the woods as punishment.

claims.quote: Others believe that she was a wicked temptress who was cruel to both men and women and for this reason they mutilated her with an axe, chopping off one leg and throwing it into a fire.

statement.id: Versi lain menyebut ia penggoda kejam yang kakinya dipotong dengan kapak lalu dilempar ke api.
statement.en: Others say she was a cruel temptress whose leg was chopped off with an axe and thrown into a fire.

statement.id: Menurut legenda, ia arwah penasaran seorang perempuan tidak setia yang mempermalukan suaminya.
statement.en: According to legend, she is the tormented soul of an unfaithful woman who dishonoured her husband.

short_description.id: Pesanta adalah anjing atau kucing hitam raksasa dalam cerita rakyat Katalan yang masuk ke rumah pada malam hari dan menindih dada orang tidur, menimbulkan sesak dan mimpi buruk.
short_description.en: The Pesanta is a huge black dog or cat of Catalan folklore that enters houses at night and sits on sleepers' chests, causing breathlessness and nightmares.

long_description.id: Pesanta adalah makhluk legenda Katalan, biasanya anjing raksasa dan jarang berupa kucing, yang pada malam hari masuk ke rumah dan menginjak dada orang tidur hingga sesak napas dan bermimpi buruk. Ia hitam dan berbulu, berkaki baja yang berlubang sehingga tidak dapat memungut apa pun. Begitu orang terbangun, ia kabur lewat celah jendela atau lubang kunci.
long_description.en: The Pesanta is a creature of Catalan legend, usually a huge dog and rarely a cat, that comes into houses at night and treads on sleepers' chests until they gasp and dream badly. It is black and hairy, with holed steel paws that can hold nothing. As soon as someone wakes, it escapes through a window gap or the keyhole.

long_description.id: Pada siang hari ia bersembunyi di gereja atau rumah kosong, dan di Garrotxa di kawah gunung api. Sosoknya mirip Pisadeira dari Portugal dan dikaitkan dengan kelumpuhan tidur.
long_description.en: By day it hides in churches or empty houses, and in the Garrotxa in volcanic craters. It resembles the Portuguese Pisadeira and is linked to sleep paralysis.

statement.en: The Pesanta is a creature of Catalan legend and popular culture, usually a huge dog or cat that enters houses at night and treads on people's chests, making it hard to breathe and causing nightmares.

short_description.id: Piasa adalah nama belakangan untuk makhluk pada mural penduduk asli Amerika di tebing Sungai Mississippi dekat Alton, Illinois, yang dicatat penjelajah Prancis pada 1673.
short_description.en: Piasa is a later name for the creature on a Native American cliff mural above the Mississippi near Alton, Illinois, recorded by French explorers in 1673.

long_description.id: Piasa adalah nama yang diberikan belakangan untuk makhluk pada mural penduduk asli Amerika di tebing tinggi di atas Sungai Mississippi, di tempat yang kini menjadi Alton, Illinois. Pada 1673 penjelajah Prancis Marquette dan Louis Jolliet menggambarkannya sebagai makhluk berwarna-warni berwajah manusia dengan ekor panjang bersirip ikan. Sketsa sezaman menunjukkan makhluk tanpa sayap yang dapat dikenali sebagai jenis panter bawah air.
long_description.en: Piasa is a name given later to the creature on a Native American mural high on cliffs above the Mississippi, at what is now Alton, Illinois. In 1673 French explorers Marquette and Louis Jolliet described it as a multicoloured human-faced creature with a long fish-finned tail. A contemporary sketch shows a wingless beast identifiable as the underwater panther type.

long_description.id: Legenda kepala suku Ouatoga yang melawan burung Piasa dianggap para ahli folklor sebagai karangan John Russell (1836, 1848), dan satu sumber bahkan menyebut piasa sebagai makhluk rekaan abad ke-19. Dinding lukisan aslinya kemungkinan hancur sekitar tahun 1850-an, dan pada abad ke-20 mural itu beberapa kali dipulihkan dengan replika.
long_description.en: Folklorists regard the legend of chieftain Ouatoga fighting the Piasa bird as an invention of John Russell (1836, 1848), and one source even calls the piasa a 19th-century fabrication. The original painted wall was probably destroyed around the 1850s, and the mural was restored with replicas several times in the 20th century.

short_description.id: Pictish Beast adalah gambaran hewan yang khas dalam budaya Pikt di Skotlandia pada awal Abad Pertengahan, terutama pada batu-batu Pikt.
short_description.en: The Pictish Beast is a stylised animal image peculiar to the early medieval Picts of Scotland, found mostly on Pictish stones.

long_description.id: Pictish Beast (kadang Pictish Dragon atau Pictish Elephant) adalah representasi hewan yang khas dalam budaya Pikt di Skotlandia pada awal Abad Pertengahan, sebagian besar pada batu Pikt. Satu contoh juga terdapat di Doo Cave, East Wemyss, yang dicatat Anderson pada 1881. Menurut artikel de, simbol ini dibuat antara abad ke-7 dan ke-9 dan muncul 29 kali pada batu Kelas I, 25 kali pada batu Kelas II, dan lima kali di dinding gua.
long_description.en: The Pictish Beast (sometimes Pictish Dragon or Pictish Elephant) is a stylised animal unique to the early medieval Picts of Scotland, and most surviving examples are carved on Pictish stones. One example also appears in the Doo Cave at East Wemyss, noted by Anderson in 1881. The de article dates the figures to the 7th to 9th centuries and counts 29 occurrences on Class I stones, 25 on Class II stones and five on cave walls.

long_description.id: Hewan apa yang digambarkan masih belum jelas. Jill Harden menulis bahwa sosok itu jelas sedang berenang dan bertanya apakah ia lumba-lumba, pesut, atau makhluk mitos. Identifikasi lain yang pernah diusulkan antara lain gajah, kelpie (each uisge) dan kuda laut. Artikel de menyebut ciri khasnya: moncong panjang seperti paruh, ujung kaki yang menggulung, jambul panjang dari belakang kepala, dan ekor menggantung.
long_description.en: What animal it shows is unresolved. Jill Harden writes that the figure is plainly swimming and asks whether it is a porpoise, a dolphin or a mythical creature. Other proposals include an elephant, a kelpie (each uisge) and a seahorse. The de article lists its marks: a long beak-like snout, curled limb ends, a long lappet trailing from the back of the head, and a hanging tail.

famous_for.en: Read as kelpie or dolphin.

did_you_know.en: The Pictish Beast appears 29 times on Class I stones and 25 times on Class II stones.

note.en: One proposed identification.

short_description.id: Pillywiggin adalah goblin dan peri mungil penjaga tumbuhan dalam folklor Inggris dan Irlandia, bersayap kupu-kupu atau capung.
short_description.en: Pillywiggins are tiny goblins and fairies who guard plant life in English and Irish folklore, with butterfly or dragonfly wings.

long_description.id: Pillywiggin adalah goblin dan peri mungil penjaga tumbuhan yang disebut dalam folklor Inggris dan Irlandia. Bertubuh sangat kecil, mereka memiliki antena dan sayap kupu-kupu atau capung, hidup berkelompok, dan menghabiskan waktu bermain di antara bunga. Mereka dikaitkan dengan bunga musim semi dan mempersonifikasikan "esensi ilahi tumbuhan". Nama "Pillywiggin" muncul pada 1977 dalam Field Guide to the Little People karya Nancy Arrowsmith, yang meyakini nama itu berasal dari county Dorset.
long_description.en: Pillywiggins are tiny goblins and fairies, keepers of the flowers, found in English and Irish folklore. Minute in size, with antennae and with wings like those of butterflies or dragonflies, they keep together in bands and spend their days at play among the blossoms. Linked with spring flowers, they embody the 'divine essence of plants'. The name 'Pillywiggin' appeared in 1977 in Nancy Arrowsmith's Field Guide to the Little People, which traces it to the county of Dorset.

long_description.id: Mereka biasanya berukuran satu sentimeter tetapi dapat berubah ukuran, dan makan embun serta serbuk sari. Sebagai peri berkelompok, mereka tak terlalu peduli pada manusia tetapi kadang ikut serta dalam pesta seperti pernikahan; tidak seperti peri Inggris lain, mereka tidak dikenal suka mengerjai manusia. Edain McCoy (1994) menggambarkan ratu pillywiggin bernama Ariel yang menunggang kelelawar.
long_description.en: They usually measure about a centimetre but can change size, and live on dew and pollen. As trooping fairies they take little interest in people, though they may join in weddings and other festivities; unlike many other fairies they are not known for playing tricks. Edain McCoy (1994) describes a pillywiggin queen named Ariel who rides bats.

famous_for.en: Not tricksters.

short_description.id: Pope Lick Monster adalah makhluk legenda urban setengah manusia setengah kambing yang konon tinggal di bawah jembatan kereta di Louisville, Kentucky.
short_description.en: The Pope Lick Monster is an urban-legend part-man, part-goat creature said to live under a railroad trestle in Louisville, Kentucky.

long_description.id: Pope Lick Monster, sering dijuluki Goat Man, adalah makhluk legendaris setengah manusia, setengah kambing dan domba yang konon hidup di bawah jembatan kereta di atas Pope Lick Creek di Louisville, Kentucky. Menurut sebagian kisah, ia memikat orang ke jembatan dengan hipnosis atau peniruan suara hingga tewas tertabrak kereta; kisah lain menyebut ia melompat ke atap mobil yang lewat.
long_description.en: The Pope Lick Monster, often called the Goat Man, is a legendary part-man, part-goat, part-sheep creature said to live under a railroad trestle over Pope Lick Creek in Louisville, Kentucky. Some accounts say it lures people onto the trestle with hypnosis or voice mimicry to be killed by trains; others say it leaps onto passing cars.

long_description.id: Satu legenda menyebut ia dulunya penampil sirkus yang membalas dendam setelah dianiaya. Legenda ini menarik pemburu sensasi, dan sudah terjadi sejumlah kematian serta kecelakaan di jembatan yang sebenarnya masih menjadi jalur kereta utama itu.
long_description.en: One legend says it was a mistreated circus performer seeking revenge. The legend draws thrill-seekers, and there have been several deaths and accidents on the trestle, which still carries a major rail line.

claims.quote: is a legendary part-man, part-goat and part-sheep creature reported to live beneath a railroad trestle bridge over Pope Lick Creek, in the Fisherville neighborhood of Louisville, Kentucky, United States.

statement.en: The Pope Lick Monster is a legendary part-man, part-goat, part-sheep creature said to live under a railroad trestle over Pope Lick Creek in Louisville, Kentucky.

claims.quote: According to some accounts, the creature uses either hypnosis or voice mimicry to lure trespassers onto the trestle to meet their death before an oncoming train.

statement.id: Menurut sebagian kisah, ia memakai hipnosis atau peniruan suara untuk memikat orang ke jembatan hingga tewas tertabrak kereta.

claims.quote: Other stories claim the monster jumps down from the trestle onto the roofs of cars passing beneath it.

claims.quote: Other legends hold that the monster is a human-goat hybrid, and that it was a circus freak who vowed revenge after being mistreated.

statement.id: Legenda lain menyebut ia dulunya penampil sirkus yang bersumpah membalas dendam setelah dianiaya.
statement.en: Other legends say it was a circus performer who vowed revenge after being mistreated.

short_description.id: Pricolici adalah vampir sekaligus manusia serigala Rumania, orang jahat yang setelah mati bangkit berwujud serigala atau anjing untuk terus mencelakai manusia.
short_description.en: The pricolici is a Romanian vampire-werewolf, a wicked person who after death rises as a wolf or dog to keep harming people.

long_description.id: Pricolici adalah vampir Rumania bercirikan manusia serigala yang selalu mirip serigala atau anjing, berbeda dari strigoi yang tetap mirip manusia. Lelaki jahat dan kejam dikatakan menjadi pricolici setelah mati; menurut sebagian cerita, mereka manusia serigala semasa hidup dan vampir setelah mati, dan ada pula yang berasal dari anak yang disusui lagi setelah disapih. Artikel bahasa Rusia juga memakai nama ini untuk orang hidup yang sementara dapat menjadi serigala.
long_description.en: The pricolici is a Romanian vampire with werewolf traits that always looks like a wolf or dog, unlike the human-looking strigoi. Wicked, violent men are said to become pricolici after death; some tales make them werewolves in life and vampires after death, and others say they come from a child breastfed after weaning. The Russian article also applies the name to living people who can turn into wolves for a while.

long_description.id: Sampai zaman modern, warga pedesaan Rumania mengaku diserang serigala raksasa yang menyerang diam-diam orang yang sendirian dan menganggapnya pricolici. Namanya mungkin dari bahasa Latin lycus, "serigala".
long_description.en: Into modern times rural Romanians have claimed attacks by huge wolves striking lone victims silently, which they took for pricolici. Its name may come from Latin lycus, 'wolf'.

famous_for.id: Serigala raksasa yang menyerang orang sendirian.
famous_for.en: Huge wolves attacking lone people.

note.id: Mayat hidup Rumania yang tetap mirip manusia.
note.en: The Romanian undead that keeps a human form.
A similar Romanian creature.

claims.quote: A Pricolici (pronounced /pri.koˈlit͡ʃʲ/) (same form in plural) is a Romanian vampire with werewolf-like attributes, transformed from a child breastfed after its mother has weaned it risks.

statement.id: Pricolici (bentuk jamaknya sama) adalah vampir Rumania bercirikan manusia serigala, yang berasal dari anak yang disusui lagi setelah disapih.
statement.en: A pricolici (same form in the plural) is a Romanian vampire with werewolf traits, arising from a child breastfed again after weaning.

claims.quote: Pricolici are similar to a vârcolac, although the latter sometimes symbolises a goblin, whereas the pricolici always has wolf-like characteristics, they have the ability to transform into ordinary people or animals.

statement.id: Pricolici mirip vârcolac, tetapi selalu bercirikan serigala dan dapat berubah menjadi manusia biasa atau hewan.
statement.en: Pricolici resemble the vârcolac, but always have wolf traits and can turn into ordinary people or animals.

claims.quote: While a strigoi possesses anthropomorphic qualities similar to the ones it had before death, a pricolici always resembles a wolf or dog. Malicious, violent men are often said to become pricolici after death, in order to continue harming other humans.

statement.id: Berbeda dari strigoi yang tetap mirip manusia, pricolici selalu mirip serigala atau anjing; lelaki jahat dan kejam sering dikatakan menjadi pricolici setelah mati untuk terus mencelakai manusia.
statement.en: Unlike the strigoi, which keeps a human look, the pricolici always resembles a wolf or dog; wicked, violent men are often said to become pricolici after death to keep harming people.

claims.quote: Some Romanian folklore delineates that Pricolici are werewolves in life and after they die, return as vampires.

statement.id: Sebagian cerita rakyat Rumania menyebut pricolici adalah manusia serigala semasa hidup dan kembali sebagai vampir setelah mati.
statement.en: Some Romanian folklore holds that pricolici are werewolves in life and return as vampires after death.

claims.quote: Even as recently as modern times, many people living in rural areas of Romania have claimed to have been viciously attacked by abnormally large and fierce wolves. Apparently, these wolves attack silently, unexpectedly and only solitary targets.

statement.id: Bahkan di zaman modern banyak warga pedesaan Rumania mengaku diserang serigala yang luar biasa besar dan buas, yang menyerang diam-diam, tiba-tiba, dan hanya orang yang sendirian.
statement.en: Even in modern times many rural Romanians have claimed to be attacked by unusually large, fierce wolves that strike silently, suddenly and only lone victims.

claims.quote: The etymology of the word is unknown; although it probably has Latin origins from the word "Lycus" i.e "wolf" (prico+lici).

statement.id: Asal katanya tidak diketahui, tetapi mungkin dari bahasa Latin lycus, "serigala".
statement.en: The word's origin is unknown, though it may come from Latin lycus, 'wolf'.

claims.quote: Algunos folclores rumano describen a los Pricolici como hombres lobo en vida que después de morir, regresan como vampiros. Esto también da lugar a la leyenda de los vampiros que pueden transformarse en animales como lobos, perros, búhos o murciélagos.

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Spanyol juga menyebut mereka manusia serigala semasa hidup yang kembali sebagai vampir, asal legenda vampir yang dapat menjadi serigala, anjing, burung hantu, atau kelelawar.
statement.en: The Spanish article also calls them werewolves in life who return as vampires, the root of the legend of vampires turning into wolves, dogs, owls or bats.

claims.quote: Приколичами называли: мертвецов, вставших из могилы в образе волка или собаки, реже других диких животных; живых людей, способных на время превращаться в волков или собак

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Rusia, pricolici adalah sebutan untuk orang mati yang bangkit dari kubur berwujud serigala atau anjing, maupun orang hidup yang untuk sementara dapat berubah menjadi serigala atau anjing.
statement.en: According to the Russian article, pricolici were the dead risen from the grave as wolves or dogs, and also living people able to turn into wolves or dogs for a time.

short_description.id: Psoglav ("kepala anjing") adalah makhluk iblis dalam mitologi Balkan, bertubuh manusia, berkaki kuda, berkepala anjing bergigi besi, dan bermata satu di dahi.
short_description.en: The psoglav ("dog-head") is a demonic creature of Balkan mythology with a human body, horse legs, a dog's head with iron teeth and one eye on its forehead.

long_description.id: Psoglav, harfiah "kepala anjing", adalah makhluk mitis bersifat iblis dalam mitologi Balkan; kepercayaan kepadanya ada di sebagian Bosnia dan Montenegro. Ia digambarkan bertubuh manusia dengan kaki kuda, berkepala anjing bergigi besi, dan bermata satu di dahi, seperti kiklop Yunani.
long_description.en: The psoglav, literally "dog-head", is a demonic mythical being of Balkan myth; people in parts of Bosnia and Montenegro believed in it. Its body is human but its legs are a horse's; its head is a dog's, armed with iron teeth, and like the Greek cyclops it has one eye set in its brow.

long_description.id: Psoglav dikatakan tinggal di gua atau di negeri gelap yang kaya batu permata tetapi tanpa matahari. Mereka memakan manusia, bahkan menggali kuburan untuk memakan mayat. Dalam bahasa Kroasia disebut psoglavac dan Slovenia psoglavec, dan banyak legenda tentangnya terutama di Semenanjung Istria. Vuk Karadžić dalam kamus Serbia tahun 1818 mencatat kata psoglav dengan arti "manusia berkepala anjing".
long_description.en: Psoglavs are said to live in caves or a dark land rich in gemstones but without sun. They eat people and even dig up graves to devour corpses. Croatian calls them psoglavac and Slovene psoglavec, and many legends about them come from the Istrian peninsula. Vuk Karadžić's 1818 Serbian dictionary records psoglav as "a man with a dog's head".

who.en: The psoglav is a dog-headed demon.

role.id: Ia memakan manusia dan menggali kuburan.
role.en: It eats people and digs up graves.

famous_for.id: Ia bermata satu di dahi dan bergigi besi.
famous_for.en: It has one eye on its forehead and iron teeth.

did_you_know.id: Psoglav dikatakan tinggal di negeri gelap yang kaya permata tetapi tanpa matahari.
did_you_know.en: Psoglavs are said to live in a dark land rich in gems but without sun.

There are numerous legends about them, particularly on the Istrian peninsula in Croatia.

statement.en: Psoglavs live in caves or a dark, gem-rich, sunless land, eat people and even dig up corpses; Croatian psoglavac, Slovene psoglavec; many legends exist, especially on the Istrian peninsula in Croatia.

short_description.id: Q'ursha adalah anjing legendaris dalam mitologi Georgia, paling dikenal sebagai teman setia pahlawan budaya Amirani.
short_description.en: Q'ursha is a legendary dog of Georgian mythology, best known as the faithful companion of the culture hero Amirani.

long_description.id: Q'ursha adalah anjing legendaris dalam mitologi Georgia. Ia muncul dalam berbagai cerita, tetapi paling terkenal sebagai teman setia Amirani. Namanya berarti "telinga hitam", nama anjing yang umum di Georgia. Ia dikatakan lahir dari burung gagak atau elang, sehingga kadang digambarkan bersayap elang, berkaki sangat besar, berbibir emas, dan bermata sebesar ayakan.
long_description.en: Q'ursha is a legendary dog of Georgian mythology. He features in many stories but is best remembered as Amirani's loyal friend. His name, a common Georgian dog name, means "black-ear". Born, it was said, of a raven or an eagle, he is sometimes shown with an eagle's wings, huge paws, golden lips and eyes the size of sieves.

long_description.id: Ia diberi kemampuan gaib: gonggongan seperti guntur, lompatan sejauh padang luas, dan kemampuan melacak buruan yang tak pernah gagal. Ketika Tuhan merantai Amirani di dalam gunung karena menantang-Nya, Q'ursha ikut terkurung dan terus menjilati rantai itu sampai hampir putus, tetapi setiap tahun rantainya diperbarui tepat sebelum Amirani bebas.
long_description.en: He was credited with uncanny powers: a bark like thunder, a leap the size of a great field and tracking that never failed. When God chained Amirani inside a mountain for his defiance, Q'ursha was shut in too and kept licking the chains until they were nearly worn through, but every year they were renewed just before Amirani could break free.

long_description.id: Q'ursha juga menjadi pokok lagu rakyat Georgia "O my Kursha!" yang setidaknya berasal dari abad ke-18; penyair Davit Guramishvili, yang lahir pada 1705, menulis bahwa ia ingin mendengarnya lagi. Setidaknya ada dua puluh tujuh versi lagu itu yang terdokumentasi. Ia juga disebut menemani pemburu Betkil.
long_description.en: Q'ursha is also the subject of the Georgian folk song "O my Kursha!", dating back to at least the 18th century; the poet Davit Guramishvili, born in 1705, wrote of wishing to hear it again. At least twenty-seven versions of the song are documented. He is also said to accompany the hunter Betkil.

who.en: Q'ursha is a legendary winged dog.

role.en: He is the faithful companion of the hero Amirani.

famous_for.en: He keeps licking Amirani's chains to free his master.

did_you_know.en: The name Q'ursha means "black-ear", a common Georgian dog name.

short_description.id: Quinotaur adalah "banteng bertanduk lima" dari laut dalam Kronik Fredegar abad ke-7, yang dianggap ayah Meroveus dan leluhur raja-raja Merovingia.
short_description.en: The Quinotaur is the five-horned sea bull of the 7th-century Chronicle of Fredegar, held to be the father of Meroveus and ancestor of the Merovingian kings.

long_description.id: Quinotaur, dari bahasa Latin "banteng bertanduk lima", adalah makhluk laut yang disebut Kronik Fredegar abad ke-7 sebagai binatang Neptunus. Ia dianggap menjadi ayah Meroveus dengan menyerang istri raja Frank Chlodio, menurut versi Italia saat sang ratu mandi di laut, sehingga menurunkan dinasti Merovingia.
long_description.en: The Quinotaur, Latin for 'bull with five horns', is a sea creature called a beast of Neptune in the 7th-century Chronicle of Fredegar. It is said to be the father of Meroveus, having assaulted King Chlodio's wife, in the Italian version as she bathed in the sea, and so the founder of the Merovingian line.

long_description.id: Pseudo-Fredegar menyamakannya dengan Neptunus dan Minotaurus; tidak jelas apakah ciri laut dan banteng itu asli atau tambahan penulis Kristen, dan apakah namanya terjemahan makhluk Frank atau ciptaan para rohaniwan.
long_description.en: Pseudo-Fredegar likened it to Neptune and the Minotaur; it is unclear whether the sea and bull traits are original or added by Christian writers, and whether the name translates a Frankish creature or was coined by clerics.

famous_for.en: Father of Meroveus.

note.en: Likened to it by Pseudo-Fredegar.

claims.quote: The Quinotaur (Latin: Quinotaurus) is a mythical sea creature mentioned in the 7th century Frankish Chronicle of Fredegar. Referred to as "the beast of Neptune which resembles a Quinotaur", it was held to have fathered Meroveus by attacking the wife of the Frankish king Chlodio and thus to have sired the line of Merovingian kings.

statement.id: Quinotaur (Latin: Quinotaurus) adalah makhluk laut mitis yang disebut dalam Kronik Fredegar abad ke-7 sebagai "binatang Neptunus yang menyerupai Quinotaur", yang dianggap menjadi ayah Meroveus dengan menyerang istri raja Frank Chlodio sehingga menurunkan raja-raja Merovingia.
statement.en: The Quinotaur (Latin Quinotaurus) is a mythical sea creature in the 7th-century Chronicle of Fredegar, 'the beast of Neptune which resembles a Quinotaur', held to have fathered Meroveus by attacking the wife of the Frankish king Chlodio and so sired the Merovingian kings.

claims.quote: The "bull with five horns" was likened by Pseudo-Fredegar (interpolating Gregory of Tours, who authored an earlier record of the legend) to both Neptune and the Minotaur, as it was both seaborne and taurine.

statement.id: "Banteng bertanduk lima" ini oleh Pseudo-Fredegar, yang menambahkan catatan Gregorius dari Tours, disamakan dengan Neptunus dan Minotaurus karena berasal dari laut dan berwujud banteng.
statement.en: The 'bull with five horns' was likened by Pseudo-Fredegar, interpolating Gregory of Tours, to both Neptune and the Minotaur, being both seaborne and bull-like.

claims.quote: It is not known whether one or both traits are original to the legend or if their combination is an accretion by one or both of the Christian authors. The clerical Latinity of the name does not indicate whether it is a translation of some genuine Frankish creature or a coining.

statement.id: Tidak diketahui apakah ciri laut dan banteng itu asli dari legenda atau tambahan penulis Kristen, dan nama Latinnya tidak menunjukkan apakah ia terjemahan makhluk Frank asli atau ciptaan baru.
statement.en: It is unknown whether the sea and bull traits are original or added by the Christian authors, and the clerical Latin name does not show whether it translates a genuine Frankish creature or is a coinage.

claims.quote: Le Quinotaure (Lat. Quinotaurus, « taureau à cinq cornes ») est une créature marine légendaire mentionnée dans la Chronique de Frédégaire du VIIe siècle.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Prancis, nama Quinotaurus berarti "banteng bertanduk lima".
statement.en: According to the French article, the name Quinotaurus means 'bull with five horns'.

claims.quote: Il est considéré comme le père de Mérovée (et donc à l'origine de la lignée des rois mérovingiens) à la suite du viol de la reine Altina, épouse du roi franc Clodion le Chevelu.

statement.id: Ia dianggap ayah Mérovée setelah memerkosa Ratu Altina, istri raja Frank Clodion si Berambut Panjang.
statement.en: It is considered the father of Merovech after raping Queen Altina, wife of the Frankish king Chlodio the Long-Haired.

claims.quote: Esso è ritenuto essere il padre di Meroveo, in quanto si unì alla moglie del re franco Clodione mentre ella stava facendo il bagno in mare

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Italia menyebut makhluk ini bersetubuh dengan istri raja Clodione ketika ia sedang mandi di laut.
statement.en: The Italian article says it coupled with King Chlodio's wife while she was bathing in the sea.

short_description.id: Ramidreju adalah hewan mitos Cantabria mirip musang bertubuh panjang seperti ular, lahir sekali tiap seratus tahun, yang bulunya menyembuhkan segala penyakit.
short_description.en: The ramidreju is a Cantabrian mythical weasel-like animal with a snake-long body, born once a century, whose fur cures every illness.

long_description.id: Ramidreju adalah makhluk mitologi Cantabria yang hidup di gunung dan hutan Spanyol utara. Hewan mirip musang ini lahir sekali setiap seratus tahun dari musang atau marten; tubuhnya panjang seperti ular, bulunya kehijauan, matanya kuning, dan dengan taring seperti babi hutan ia menggali lubang yang sangat dalam.
long_description.en: The ramidreju is a creature of Cantabrian mythology living in the mountains and forests of northern Spain. This weasel-like animal is born once every hundred years from a weasel or marten; it has a long snake-like body, greenish fur and yellow eyes, and digs very deep holes with boar-like tusks.

long_description.id: Ia sangat diburu karena bulunya menyembuhkan segala penyakit dan ia dapat membantu menemukan harta; menurut Manuel Llano, yang mendengarnya dari warga Viaña, empedunya diminum para anjana di lembah Cieza.
long_description.en: It is much hunted because its fur cures all ills and it can lead to treasure; according to Manuel Llano, who heard of it from a resident of Viaña, the anjanas of the Cieza valley drink its bile.

note.en: Cantabrian fairies who drink its bile.

claims.quote: In Cantabrian mythology, a ramidreju (Cantabrian: [ramiˈdrehu]) is a creature said to inhabit the mountains and forests of Cantabria in northern Spain. This animal, which resembles a weasel, is born once every hundred years from a weasel or a marten.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Cantabria, ramidreju adalah makhluk yang konon menghuni gunung dan hutan Cantabria di Spanyol utara; hewan mirip musang ini lahir sekali setiap seratus tahun dari musang atau marten.
statement.en: In Cantabrian mythology the ramidreju is a creature said to live in the mountains and forests of Cantabria in northern Spain; this weasel-like animal is born once every hundred years from a weasel or a marten.

claims.quote: These mythological creatures have a very long body, like a snake, and their fur is slightly green-colored. Its eyes are yellow, its nose is like that of a hog and its tusks are like those of the boar, which it uses to dig very deep holes.

statement.id: Tubuhnya sangat panjang seperti ular dengan bulu kehijauan, matanya kuning, hidungnya seperti babi, dan taringnya seperti babi hutan yang dipakai menggali lubang sangat dalam.
statement.en: Its body is very long like a snake's, its fur greenish, its eyes yellow, its nose like a hog's and its tusks like a boar's, which it uses to dig very deep holes.

claims.quote: Ramidrejus are a very sought-after animal in Cantabrian folklore because their fur heals every sickness and the animal has a strong desire for gold.

statement.id: Ramidreju sangat diburu dalam cerita rakyat Cantabria karena bulunya menyembuhkan segala penyakit dan hewan ini sangat menginginkan emas.
statement.en: Ramidrejus are much sought after in Cantabrian folklore because their fur cures every illness and the animal has a strong craving for gold.

claims.quote: Fue descrito por el cantabrista Manuel Llano, según un relato en el que dice haber oído a un vecino de Viaña (Cabuérniga) hablar de él.

statement.id: Ramidreju dideskripsikan oleh peneliti Cantabria Manuel Llano berdasarkan cerita yang katanya ia dengar dari seorang warga Viaña (Cabuérniga).
statement.en: It was described by the Cantabrian scholar Manuel Llano, from an account he said he heard from a resident of Viaña (Cabuérniga).

claims.quote: su hiel -que es bebida por las anjanas en el valle de Cieza- posee la capacidad de curar todas las enfermedades y desvelar tesoros ocultos.

statement.id: Empedunya, yang diminum para anjana di lembah Cieza, dapat menyembuhkan segala penyakit dan mengungkap harta tersembunyi.
statement.en: Its bile, drunk by the anjanas in the Cieza valley, can cure all illnesses and reveal hidden treasures.

claims.quote: descrito como híbrido de la monuca galana (comadreja) y de la rámila (garduña), delgado y largo, con piel rayada de negro y verde, y con cara de jabalí y ojos amarillos.

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Spanyol menggambarkannya sebagai hibrida monuca galana (musang) dan rámila (marten batu), ramping dan panjang, berkulit belang hitam-hijau, berwajah babi hutan, dan bermata kuning.
statement.en: The Spanish article describes it as a hybrid of the monuca galana (weasel) and the rámila (stone marten), slender and long, with black-and-green striped skin, a boar's face and yellow eyes.

claims.quote: Oni tre volas ilin ĉar per ili oni povas trovi kaŝitajn trezorojn kaj ĉar onidire ties felo kuracas ĉiun malsanon.

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Esperanto juga menyebut ramidreju sangat dicari karena dapat membantu menemukan harta tersembunyi dan bulunya konon menyembuhkan segala penyakit.
statement.en: The Esperanto article also says ramidrejus are much sought because they help find hidden treasure and their fur reputedly cures every disease.

short_description.id: Raróg adalah iblis api dalam mitologi Slavia, sering digambarkan sebagai elang api.
short_description.en: The Raróg is a fire demon of Slavic mythology, often depicted as a fiery falcon.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Slavia, Raróg atau Raróh adalah iblis api yang sering digambarkan sebagai elang api. Ia roh api yang terkait pemujaan perapian, dibayangkan sebagai burung, biasanya burung pemangsa, atau naga bertubuh berpercikan, juga sebagai pusaran api.
long_description.en: Slavic myth knows the Raróg or Raróh as a fire demon, often shown as a blazing falcon. A spirit of fire tied to the cult of the hearth, it was pictured as a bird, usually a bird of prey, or a dragon with a sparkling body, or a whirl of flame.

long_description.id: Menurut cerita rakyat Ceko, raroh dapat menetas dari telur yang dierami di atas tungku selama sembilan hari sembilan malam, dan dapat tampil sebagai elang api atau naga. Dalam cerita rakyat Polandia, raróg adalah burung mungil yang muat di saku dan membawa kebahagiaan. Rarášek juga dikatakan mampu berubah menjadi berbagai burung dan binatang; bila memusuhi manusia, ia menghancurkan gandum yang belum dipanen.
long_description.en: Czech lore says a raroh can hatch from an egg kept warm on a stove for nine days and nights, and may appear as a fiery falcon or a dragon. In Polish lore the raróg is a tiny bird that fits in a pocket and brings people happiness. The rarášek is also said to change into various birds and beasts; if hostile to someone, it scatters their unharvested grain to dust.

who.en: The Raróg is a fire demon in falcon form.

claims.quote: In Slavic mythology, the Raróg (Russian: Рарог) or Raróh (Ukrainian: Рарог) is a fire demon, often depicted as a fiery falcon.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Slavia, Raróg (Рарог) atau Raróh adalah iblis api yang sering digambarkan sebagai elang api.
statement.en: In Slavic mythology the Raróg or Raróh is a fire demon, often depicted as a fiery falcon.

claims.quote: According to Czech folklore, a raroh can hatch from an egg that was incubated on a stove for nine days and nights, and can appear either as a fiery falcon or a dragon. In Polish folklore, the rarog is a tiny bird that can be held in a pocket, and can bring people happiness.

statement.id: Menurut cerita rakyat Ceko, raroh dapat menetas dari telur yang dierami di atas tungku selama sembilan hari dan malam, dan tampil sebagai elang api atau naga; dalam cerita rakyat Polandia raróg adalah burung mungil yang muat di saku dan membawa kebahagiaan.
statement.en: In Czech folklore a raroh can hatch from an egg incubated on a stove for nine days and nights and appear as a fiery falcon or dragon; in Polish folklore the rarog is a tiny pocket-sized bird bringing happiness.

statement.en: Proto-Slavic *rarogъ, "falcon, hawk" (?), goes back to Proto-Indo-European.

statement.id: Sebuah kaldera di bulan Io milik Jupiter dinamai Rarog Patera.

claims.quote: в славянской мифологии огненный дух, связанный с культом очага. Рарога представляли в образе птицы (обычно хищной) или дракона с искрящимся телом, а также в виде огненного вихря.

statement.en: In Slavic mythology the Raróg is a fire spirit tied to the hearth cult, pictured as a bird (usually of prey) or a dragon with a sparkling body, or a fiery whirlwind.

short_description.id: Ratoncito Pérez adalah tikus kecil dalam tradisi Spanyol dan Amerika Hispanik yang datang malam hari menukar gigi susu anak di bawah bantal dengan uang atau hadiah.
short_description.en: Ratoncito Pérez is the little mouse of Spanish and Hispanic American tradition who comes at night to swap a child's milk tooth under the pillow for money or a gift.

long_description.id: Ratoncito Pérez atau Ratón Pérez adalah tokoh masa kecil dalam budaya Spanyol dan Amerika Hispanik: anak yang tanggal gigi susunya menaruhnya di bawah bantal, dan tikus kecil ini datang saat mereka tidur untuk menggantinya dengan uang atau hadiah, seperti Peri Gigi. Di sebagian Meksiko, Peru, dan Chili ia disebut Ratón de los Dientes.
long_description.en: Ratoncito Pérez or Ratón Pérez is a childhood figure of Spanish and Hispanic American culture: a child puts a lost milk tooth under the pillow, and the little mouse comes during sleep to replace it with money or a gift, like the Tooth Fairy. In parts of Mexico, Peru and Chile he is the Ratón de los Dientes.

long_description.id: Tikus bernama Ratón Pérez muncul dalam dongeng lisan, dan pada 1894 Luis Coloma menjadikannya pengumpul gigi dalam cerita pesanan Ratu Maria Christina untuk Alfonso XIII, dengan Pérez tinggal di kotak biskuit toko kue Prast di Madrid. Asal yang paling mungkin adalah dongeng Baroness d'Aulnoy abad ke-18. Ia dibintangi film The Hairy Tooth Fairy (2006).
long_description.en: A mouse called Ratón Pérez appeared in oral tales, and in 1894 Luis Coloma made him a tooth collector in a tale Queen Maria Christina commissioned for Alfonso XIII, with Pérez living in a biscuit box at the Prast confectionery in Madrid. The likeliest origin is an 18th-century tale by Baroness d'Aulnoy. He stars in the film The Hairy Tooth Fairy (2006).

famous_for.id: Rumah di toko kue Prast, Madrid.
famous_for.en: Home in the Prast confectionery, Madrid.

description.id: Coloma menjadikan Ratón Pérez pengumpul gigi untuk Alfonso XIII.
description.en: Coloma makes Ratón Pérez a tooth collector for Alfonso XIII.

note.en: Its counterpart in other cultures.

description.en: A Spanish-Argentine film starring Ratoncito Pérez.

claims.quote: El Ratoncito Pérez or Ratón Pérez ... Perez the Little Mouse or Perez Mouse) is a fantasy figure of early childhood in Spanish and Hispanic American cultures.

statement.id: Ratoncito Pérez atau Ratón Pérez ("Tikus Kecil Pérez") adalah tokoh khayalan masa kanak-kanak dalam budaya Spanyol dan Amerika Hispanik.
statement.en: El Ratoncito Pérez or Ratón Pérez ('Pérez the Little Mouse') is a fantasy figure of early childhood in Spanish and Hispanic American cultures.

claims.quote: The folklore states that when children lose one of their milk teeth, they should place it underneath their pillow or on their bedside table and he will visit while they sleep, replacing the lost tooth with a small payment or gift, as does the Tooth Fairy in other cultures.

statement.id: Menurut tradisi, anak yang tanggal gigi susunya menaruhnya di bawah bantal atau di meja samping tempat tidur, lalu Pérez datang saat mereka tidur dan menggantinya dengan uang atau hadiah kecil, seperti Peri Gigi di budaya lain.
statement.en: By tradition, children who lose a milk tooth put it under the pillow or on the bedside table, and he comes while they sleep and replaces it with a small payment or gift, like the Tooth Fairy elsewhere.

claims.quote: Although he first appeared in oral tradition folktales such as The Vain Little Mouse, it was Luis Coloma who in 1894 turned him into a tooth dealer in a tale written for an eight-year-old King Alfonso XIII.

statement.id: Ia pertama muncul dalam dongeng lisan seperti El ratoncito vanidoso, tetapi Luis Coloma-lah yang pada 1894 menjadikannya pengumpul gigi dalam cerita untuk Raja Alfonso XIII yang berusia delapan tahun.
statement.en: He first appeared in oral folktales such as The Vain Little Mouse, but it was Luis Coloma who in 1894 made him a tooth collector in a tale written for the eight-year-old King Alfonso XIII.

claims.quote: In 1894, Queen Maria Christina commissioned Coloma to write a tale for King Alfonso XIII, who had just lost a tooth at the age of eight. Coloma's story follows Ratón Pérez, who lived with his family in a box of cookies at the basement of Prast confectionery store in Madrid

statement.id: Ratu Maria Christina memesan cerita itu untuk Alfonso XIII yang baru tanggal giginya; dalam cerita Coloma, Ratón Pérez tinggal bersama keluarganya di kotak biskuit di ruang bawah tanah toko kue Prast di Madrid.
statement.en: Queen Maria Christina commissioned the tale for Alfonso XIII, who had just lost a tooth; in Coloma's story Ratón Pérez lives with his family in a biscuit box in the basement of the Prast confectionery in Madrid.

claims.quote: He is generally known as "El Ratoncito Pérez", except in some regions of Mexico, Guatemala, Peru and Chile, where he is called "El Ratón de los Dientes" ... The Tooth Mouse), and in Argentina, Venezuela, Uruguay and Colombia, where he is simply known as "El Ratón Pérez".

statement.id: Ia umumnya disebut El Ratoncito Pérez, kecuali di sebagian Meksiko, Guatemala, Peru, dan Chili, tempat ia disebut El Ratón de los Dientes (Tikus Gigi), dan di Argentina, Venezuela, Uruguay, dan Kolombia, tempat ia disebut El Ratón Pérez.
statement.en: He is usually called El Ratoncito Pérez, except in parts of Mexico, Guatemala, Peru and Chile, where he is El Ratón de los Dientes (the Tooth Mouse), and in Argentina, Venezuela, Uruguay and Colombia, where he is El Ratón Pérez.

claims.quote: El origen más probable del ratoncito y su enlace con un hada proviene de un cuento francés del siglo XVIII de la baronesa d'Aulnoy: La Bonne Petite Souris (El buen ratoncito).

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Spanyol, asal yang paling mungkin adalah dongeng Prancis abad ke-18 karya Baroness d'Aulnoy, La Bonne Petite Souris.
statement.en: According to the Spanish article, the most likely origin is the 18th-century French tale by Baroness d'Aulnoy, La Bonne Petite Souris.

claims.quote: En otros lugares hay otros seres fantásticos encargados de recoger los dientes, como Tooth Fairy («Hada de los dientes») en los países germanos, l'Angelet («el Angelito») o La rateta  («la Ratita») en Cataluña, Maritxu teilatukoa («Mari la del tejado») en el País Vasco

statement.id: Di tempat lain ada makhluk pengumpul gigi lain, seperti Tooth Fairy di negara Jermanik, l'Angelet atau La rateta di Katalonia, dan Maritxu teilatukoa di negeri Basque.
statement.en: Elsewhere other beings collect teeth, such as the Tooth Fairy in Germanic countries, l'Angelet or La rateta in Catalonia and Maritxu teilatukoa in the Basque Country.

claims.quote: El Ratoncito Pérez stars in the 2006 Spanish-Argentine film The Hairy Tooth Fairy and its 2008 sequel.

statement.id: Ratoncito Pérez dibintangi film Spanyol-Argentina The Hairy Tooth Fairy (2006) dan sekuelnya pada 2008.
statement.en: El Ratoncito Pérez stars in the 2006 Spanish-Argentine film The Hairy Tooth Fairy and its 2008 sequel.

claims.quote: По традиции дарит ребёнку подарок вместо выпавшего молочного зуба, положенного под подушку.

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Rusia juga menyebut ia memberi hadiah sebagai ganti gigi susu yang ditaruh di bawah bantal.
statement.en: The Russian article also says he gives a child a present in exchange for a milk tooth placed under the pillow.

short_description.id: Rougarou adalah manusia serigala dalam cerita rakyat Cajun, Kreol, dan Métis yang berkeliaran di rawa-rawa Louisiana, berkepala serigala atau anjing, dan dipakai untuk menakuti anak-anak.
short_description.en: The rougarou is a werewolf of Cajun, Creole and Métis folklore that prowls the swamps of Louisiana with a wolf's or dog's head, used to frighten children into behaving.

long_description.id: Rougarou, dari kata Prancis loup-garou, adalah makhluk mirip manusia serigala dalam cerita rakyat Cajun dan Kreol di Louisiana serta komunitas Métis dan berbahasa Prancis di Kanada. Ia bertubuh manusia berkepala serigala atau anjing dan berkeliaran di rawa sekitar Acadiana dan New Orleans, ladang tebu, dan hutan; kisah lain menjadikannya penunggang tanpa kepala atau penyihir.
long_description.en: The rougarou, from French loup-garou, is a werewolf-like creature of Cajun and Creole folklore in Louisiana and of Métis and French-speaking communities in Canada. It has a human body and a wolf's or dog's head and prowls the swamps around Acadiana and New Orleans, cane fields and woods; other tales make it a headless horseman or a witch.

long_description.id: Kisahnya dipakai untuk menakuti anak-anak. Menurut satu legenda kutukannya berlangsung 101 hari lalu berpindah ke orang yang darahnya ia tumpahkan, dan 13 benda kecil di depan pintu dapat menangkalnya karena ia tidak bisa menghitung lebih dari 12. Bagi orang Ojibwe, rugaru adalah lelaki berbulu pertanda bahaya. Ia muncul dalam serial Supernatural dan novel Empire of Wild.
long_description.en: Its tales were used to frighten children. One legend says its curse lasts 101 days and then passes to whoever's blood it draws, and 13 small objects by the door ward it off because it cannot count past 12. For the Ojibwe the rugaru is a hairy man who signals danger. It appears in the series Supernatural and the novel Empire of Wild.

origin.id: Cerita rakyat Cajun, Kreol, dan Métis.

famous_for.en: Cannot count past 12.

description.id: Ia manusia yang berubah menjadi makhluk berkepala serigala.
description.en: It is a person who turns into a wolf-headed creature.

description.id: Kutukannya berpindah kepada orang yang darahnya ia tumpahkan.
description.en: Its curse passes to the person whose blood it draws.

description.id: Rougarou tidak dapat menghitung lebih dari 12, sehingga 13 benda di depan pintu menangkalnya.
description.en: The rougarou cannot count past 12, so 13 objects by the door keep it away.

description.id: Rougarou menjadi monster utama satu episode.
description.en: The rougarou is the monster of one episode.

description.id: Novel Cherie Dimaline yang terilhami kisah Rogarou Métis.
description.en: Cherie Dimaline's novel inspired by the Métis Rogarou story.

claims.quote: alternatively spelled as roux-ga-roux, rugaroo, or rugaru) is a legendary creature in Cajun and Creole diaspora and a trickster in oral traditions in Métis and Francophone communities linked to traditional concepts of the werewolf.

statement.id: Rougarou (juga roux-ga-roux, rugaroo, atau rugaru) adalah makhluk legenda diaspora Cajun dan Kreol serta tokoh penipu dalam tradisi lisan komunitas Métis dan berbahasa Prancis, yang terkait dengan konsep manusia serigala.
statement.en: The rougarou (also roux-ga-roux, rugaroo or rugaru) is a legendary creature of the Cajun and Creole diaspora and a trickster in Métis and Francophone oral traditions, linked to the werewolf.

claims.quote: Loup is French for wolf, and garou (from Frankish warulf, cognate with English werewolf) is a man who transforms into an animal.

statement.id: Namanya dari loup-garou: loup berarti serigala dalam bahasa Prancis, dan garou (dari kata Franka warulf, sekerabat dengan werewolf) adalah manusia yang berubah menjadi binatang.
statement.en: The name comes from loup-garou: loup is French for wolf, and garou (from Frankish warulf, akin to werewolf) is a man who turns into an animal.

claims.quote: According to Barry Jean Ancelet, an academic expert on Cajun folklore and professor at the University of Louisiana at Lafayette in America, the tale of the rougarou is a common legend across French Louisiana.

statement.id: Menurut Barry Jean Ancelet, pakar cerita rakyat Cajun di University of Louisiana at Lafayette, kisah rougarou adalah legenda umum di seluruh Louisiana berbahasa Prancis.
statement.en: According to Barry Jean Ancelet, Cajun folklore expert at the University of Louisiana at Lafayette, the rougarou is a common legend across French Louisiana.

claims.quote: In the Creole and Cajun legends, the creature is said to prowl the swamps around Acadiana and Greater New Orleans, and the sugar cane fields and woodlands of the regions. The rougarou most often is described as a creature with a human body and the head of a wolf or dog, similar to the werewolf legend.

statement.id: Dalam legenda Kreol dan Cajun, rougarou berkeliaran di rawa-rawa sekitar Acadiana dan New Orleans serta ladang tebu dan hutan, dan biasanya bertubuh manusia berkepala serigala atau anjing.
statement.en: In Creole and Cajun legend the rougarou prowls the swamps around Acadiana and New Orleans and the cane fields and woods, usually with a human body and a wolf's or dog's head.

claims.quote: Often the story-telling has been used to inspire fear and obedience. One such example is stories that have been told by elders to persuade Creole and Cajun children to behave.

statement.id: Kisahnya sering dipakai untuk menanamkan rasa takut dan kepatuhan, misalnya oleh orang tua agar anak-anak Kreol dan Cajun berkelakuan baik.
statement.en: The tales were often used to instil fear and obedience, for instance by elders to make Creole and Cajun children behave.

claims.quote: A common blood sucking legend says that the rougarou is under the spell for 101 days. After that time, the curse is transferred from person to person when the rougarou draws another human's blood.

statement.id: Menurut legenda pengisap darah yang umum, rougarou berada di bawah kutukan selama 101 hari, lalu kutukan berpindah ke orang lain ketika rougarou menumpahkan darahnya.
statement.en: A common blood-drawing legend says the rougarou is under the spell for 101 days, after which the curse passes to another person whose blood the rougarou draws.

claims.quote: Some believe that placing 13 small objects by the door keeps the Rougarou at bay; the creature is said to be so simple-minded it can’t count beyond 12.

statement.id: Sebagian orang percaya meletakkan 13 benda kecil di dekat pintu dapat menangkal rougarou karena ia terlalu bodoh untuk menghitung lebih dari 12.
statement.en: Some believe that placing 13 small objects by the door keeps the rougarou away, since it is too simple to count past 12.

claims.quote: Rugaru is the Ojibwe name for "the hairy man who appears in symptom of danger or psychic disruption in the community."

statement.id: Rugaru adalah nama Ojibwe untuk "lelaki berbulu yang muncul sebagai tanda bahaya atau kekacauan batin dalam komunitas".
statement.en: Rugaru is the Ojibwe name for 'the hairy man who appears as a sign of danger or psychic disruption in the community'.

claims.quote: Rougarous have been repeatedly mentioned in the American TV series Supernatural, and is the monster of the week in season 4 episode "Metamorphosis".

statement.id: Rougarou berkali-kali disebut dalam serial televisi Amerika Supernatural dan menjadi monster utama episode "Metamorphosis" musim keempat.
statement.en: The rougarou is repeatedly mentioned in the American TV series Supernatural and is the monster of the season 4 episode 'Metamorphosis'.

claims.quote: The novel Empire of Wild (2019; Penguin Random House Canada) by Cherie Dimaline is "inspired by the traditional Métis story of the Rogarou

statement.id: Novel Empire of Wild (2019) karya Cherie Dimaline terilhami kisah tradisional Métis tentang Rogarou.
statement.en: Cherie Dimaline's novel Empire of Wild (2019) is inspired by the traditional Métis story of the Rogarou.

claims.quote: Le Rougarou, Roux-Ga-Roux, Rugaroo ou Rugaru est une créature lycanthrope appartenant au folklore des communautés francophones de Louisiane (États-Unis) et des Laurentides (Québec).

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Prancis, rougarou adalah makhluk manusia serigala dalam cerita rakyat komunitas berbahasa Prancis di Louisiana dan Laurentides, Québec.
statement.en: According to the French article, the rougarou is a werewolf creature in the folklore of French-speaking communities in Louisiana and the Laurentides, Quebec.

claims.quote: D'autres contes décrivent le rougarou comme un cavalier sans tête ou comme une sorcière.

statement.id: Kisah lain menggambarkan rougarou sebagai penunggang kuda tanpa kepala atau sebagai penyihir.
statement.en: Other tales describe the rougarou as a headless horseman or as a witch.

claims.quote: El Rougarou es una criatura legendaria en las comunidades francófonas en EEUU y Canadá, asociada a la noción europea del hombre lobo.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Spanyol, rougarou adalah makhluk legenda komunitas berbahasa Prancis di Amerika Serikat dan Kanada yang terkait dengan gagasan Eropa tentang manusia serigala.
statement.en: According to the Spanish article, the rougarou is a legendary creature of French-speaking communities in the United States and Canada, tied to the European werewolf idea.

short_description.id: Saci adalah tokoh populer mitologi Brasil: makhluk berkaki satu yang mengisap pipa dan memakai topi merah ajaib untuk muncul dan menghilang.
short_description.en: Saci is a popular figure of Brazilian mythology: a one-legged being who smokes a pipe and wears a magic red cap to appear and vanish.

long_description.id: Saci atau Saci-pererê adalah tokoh populer dalam mitologi Brasil: makhluk mirip kobold berkulit hitam dan berkaki satu yang mengisap pipa, meminta tembakau kepada orang, dan memakai topi merah ajaib untuk muncul dan menghilang, biasanya dalam pusaran debu. Tergantung daerahnya, ia bisa baik atau jahat; dalam versi jahatnya ia dipakai untuk menakut-nakuti anak di kalangan budak dan buruh tani.
long_description.en: The Saci or Saci-pererê is a popular figure of Brazilian mythology: a goblin-like, black-skinned, one-legged being who smokes a pipe, begs for tobacco and wears a magic red cap that lets him appear and vanish, usually in a dust devil. Depending on the region he may be good or bad; in his malicious version he served as a bogeyman for children among slaves and farm workers.

long_description.id: Saci yang tertangkap dapat dikurung dalam botol dan dipaksa mengabulkan permintaan sebagai tebusan kebebasannya. Namanya berasal dari bahasa Tupinambá: saci dari çua ci, "mata jahat", dan akhiran -pererê dari perérég, "melompat-lompat"; nama Saci-pererê awalnya merujuk pada burung kukuk bergaris.
long_description.en: A captured Saci can be shut in a bottle and forced to grant wishes in exchange for freedom. His name is Tupinambá: saci from çua ci, "evil eye", and the suffix -pererê from perérég, "bouncy, jumpy"; the name Saci-pererê originally referred to the striped cuckoo.

who.en: A one-legged being in a red cap.

role.id: Pengusil yang baik atau jahat tergantung daerah.
role.en: A trickster, good or bad depending on the region.

famous_for.id: Topi merah ajaib dan pusaran debu.
famous_for.en: His magic red cap and dust devils.

did_you_know.id: Saci yang dikurung dalam botol harus mengabulkan permintaan untuk bebas.
did_you_know.en: A Saci shut in a bottle must grant wishes to be freed.

description.id: Topi merahnya membuatnya bisa muncul dan menghilang kapan saja.
description.en: His red cap lets him appear and vanish at any time.

description.id: Saci yang tertangkap dapat dikurung dalam botol.
description.en: A captured Saci can be shut in a bottle.

claims.quote: Der Saci oder Saci-pererê ist eine populäre Figur der brasilianischen Mythologie.

statement.id: Saci atau Saci-pererê adalah tokoh populer dalam mitologi Brasil.
statement.en: The Saci or Saci-pererê is a popular figure of Brazilian mythology.

claims.quote: Er ist ein koboldähnliches Wesen mit schwarzer Hautfarbe und nur einem Bein. Er raucht eine Pfeife, bettelt die Menschen um Tabak an und trägt eine magische rote Mütze, mit deren Hilfe er jederzeit auftauchen und wieder verschwinden kann (meist in einem Staubwirbel).

statement.id: Saci makhluk mirip kobold berkulit hitam dan berkaki satu yang mengisap pipa, meminta tembakau kepada orang, dan memakai topi merah ajaib untuk muncul dan menghilang kapan saja, biasanya dalam pusaran debu.
statement.en: Saci is a goblin-like, black-skinned, one-legged being who smokes a pipe, begs people for tobacco and wears a magic red cap that lets him appear and vanish at any time, usually in a dust devil.

claims.quote: Je nach Region war er ein gutes oder schlechtes Wesen

statement.id: Tergantung daerahnya, ia makhluk baik atau jahat.
statement.en: Depending on the region he was a good or a bad being.

claims.quote: In seiner boshaften Varietät diente der Saci als Kinderschreck bei den Sklaven und Landarbeitern (Caboclos).

statement.id: Dalam versi jahatnya, Saci dipakai untuk menakut-nakuti anak di kalangan budak dan buruh tani (caboclo).
statement.en: In his malicious version the Saci served as a bogeyman for children among slaves and farm workers (caboclos).

claims.quote: The captured Saci can be imprisoned inside a bottle, and be forced to grant wishes in exchange for freedom, just like Aladdin and the Magic Lamp in Arabian Nights.

statement.id: Saci yang tertangkap dapat dikurung dalam botol dan dipaksa mengabulkan permintaan sebagai tebusan kebebasannya, mirip kisah Aladin dan lampu ajaib.
statement.en: A captured Saci can be shut in a bottle and made to grant wishes in exchange for freedom, like Aladdin and the Magic Lamp.

claims.quote: The term saci derives from Tupinambá: çaci meaning "sick eye", or rather Tupinambá: çua ci "evil eye".

statement.id: Kata saci berasal dari bahasa Tupinambá çaci, "mata sakit", atau lebih tepatnya çua ci, "mata jahat".
statement.en: The word saci comes from Tupinambá çaci, "sick eye", or rather çua ci, "evil eye".

claims.quote: The suffixed -pererê also derives from Tupinambá perérég meaning "bouncy, jumpy".

statement.id: Akhiran -pererê berasal dari kata Tupinambá perérég yang berarti "melompat-lompat".
statement.en: The suffix -pererê comes from Tupinambá perérég, meaning "bouncy, jumpy".

claims.quote: The Saci-pererê of myth originally referred to a Cuculiformes (cuckoo family) bird, more specifically the striped cuckoo.

statement.id: Nama Saci-pererê awalnya merujuk pada sejenis burung kukuk, yaitu kukuk bergaris.
statement.en: The name Saci-pererê originally referred to a bird of the cuckoo family, the striped cuckoo.

short_description.id: Samca adalah roh jahat dalam mitologi Rumania yang menakuti anak kecil dan perempuan yang akan melahirkan, dan bisa ditangkal dengan menulis ke-19 namanya.
short_description.en: Samca is an evil spirit of Romanian mythology who frightens small children and women about to give birth, and can be warded off by writing her 19 names.

long_description.id: Samca adalah roh jahat dalam mitologi Rumania. Ia paling sering tampil sebagai perempuan telanjang berambut kusut hingga tumit, bertangan besi dengan kuku setajam jarum rajut, dan berlidah api, tetapi bisa juga menjadi babi ganas, anjing menyeringai, kucing tak berbulu, gagak bermata darah, atau laba-laba hitam besar. Dalam beberapa legenda ia juga muncul dalam mimpi pengantin pria muda untuk menggoda mereka.
long_description.en: Samca is an evil spirit of Romanian mythology. She most often appears as a naked woman with dishevelled hair to her heels, iron hands with nails sharp as knitting needles and a tongue of fire, but can also become a fierce pig, a grinning dog, a hairless cat, a bloody-eyed crow or a big black spider. In some legends she also appears in the dreams of young bridegrooms to tempt them.

long_description.id: Sekitar bulan purnama pada akhir bulan, Samca menampakkan diri kepada anak di bawah empat tahun hingga mereka jatuh sakit, dan kepada perempuan yang akan melahirkan. Untuk melindungi diri, orang menulis ke-19 namanya di dinding rumah. Pada 1900 Rabbi Moses Gaster mencatat kemiripan jimat-jimat semacam ini di Balkan dan menyebut Samca sebagai Avezuha, "sayap Setan".
long_description.en: Around the full moon at the month's end, Samca appears to children under four, who fall ill, and to women about to give birth. To protect themselves people write her 19 names on a wall of the house. In 1900 Rabbi Moses Gaster noted the similarity of such charms across the Balkans and called Samca Avezuha, the "wing of Satan".

role.id: Ia menakuti anak kecil dan perempuan yang akan melahirkan.
role.en: She frightens small children and women about to give birth.

famous_for.en: She has 19 names.

did_you_know.id: Untuk menangkal Samca, orang menulis ke-19 namanya di dinding rumah.
did_you_know.en: To ward off Samca, people wrote all 19 of her names on a wall of the house.

description.id: Menulis ke-19 namanya di dinding rumah melindungi penghuninya.
description.en: Writing her 19 names on a wall of the house protects those inside.

description.id: Drama karya Natalia Bushnik dan Kathleen Welch yang memenangi lomba naskah Hamilton Fringe Festival.
description.en: A play by Natalia Bushnik and Kathleen Welch that won the Hamilton Fringe Festival new play contest.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa menuliskan nama-nama makhluk jahat dianggap bisa melindungi dari makhluk itu?
learning_questions.en: Why is writing down an evil being's names thought to protect against it?

claims.quote: Samca is an evil spirit in Romanian mythology. She most commonly takes the appearance of a naked woman with disheveled hair growing down to her heels, with small eyes that shine as brightly as the stars, with iron hands and long nails sharp as knitting needles or hooked as sickles and a tongue of fire.

statement.id: Samca adalah roh jahat dalam mitologi Rumania yang paling sering tampil sebagai perempuan telanjang berambut kusut hingga tumit, bermata kecil berkilau seperti bintang, bertangan besi dengan kuku panjang setajam jarum rajut atau melengkung seperti sabit, dan berlidah api.
statement.en: Samca is an evil spirit of Romanian mythology who most often appears as a naked woman with dishevelled hair down to her heels, small eyes shining like stars, iron hands with long nails sharp as knitting needles or hooked like sickles, and a tongue of fire.

claims.quote: Other forms Samca can take are: a very large and fierce pig, a grinning dog showing awful teeth, a hairless cat with fiery, bulging eyes, a crow with bloody eyes, and a big black spider.

statement.id: Samca juga bisa berwujud babi besar yang ganas, anjing menyeringai dengan gigi mengerikan, kucing tak berbulu bermata menyala dan melotot, gagak bermata darah, dan laba-laba hitam besar.
statement.en: Samca can also take the form of a huge fierce pig, a grinning dog with awful teeth, a hairless cat with fiery bulging eyes, a crow with bloody eyes and a big black spider.

claims.quote: It can come out at the end of each month, around full moon, and it usually appears to children under the age of four, who are so frightened that they become sick immediately. The disease children develop after Samca appears to them is called "the children's malice". This demon can also appear to women who are about to give birth.

statement.id: Ia bisa keluar pada akhir setiap bulan, sekitar bulan purnama, biasanya menampakkan diri kepada anak di bawah empat tahun yang begitu ketakutan hingga langsung sakit; penyakit itu disebut "kedengkian anak-anak"; demon ini juga muncul kepada perempuan yang akan melahirkan.
statement.en: It may come out at the end of each month, around full moon, usually appearing to children under four, who are so frightened they fall ill at once; the illness is called "the children's malice"; the demon can also appear to women about to give birth.

claims.quote: Samca has 19 names: Vestitia, Navadaraia, Valnomia, Sina, Nicosda, Avezuha, Scorcoila, Tiha, Miha, Grompa, Slalo, Necauza, Hatavu, Hulila, Huva, Ghiana, Gluviana, Prava, and Samca. To defend against Samca, people need to write all her 19 names on a wall of the house

statement.id: Samca punya 19 nama: Vestitia, Navadaraia, Valnomia, Sina, Nicosda, Avezuha, Scorcoila, Tiha, Miha, Grompa, Slalo, Necauza, Hatavu, Hulila, Huva, Ghiana, Gluviana, Prava, dan Samca; untuk melindungi diri, orang harus menulis ke-19 nama itu di dinding rumah.
statement.en: Samca has 19 names: Vestitia, Navadaraia, Valnomia, Sina, Nicosda, Avezuha, Scorcoila, Tiha, Miha, Grompa, Slalo, Necauza, Hatavu, Hulila, Huva, Ghiana, Gluviana, Prava and Samca; to protect themselves people must write all 19 names on a wall of the house.

claims.quote: The Samca was described in 1900 by Rabbi Moses Gaster, who noted the similarities between Christian (namely Romanian, Greek, and Slavonic) and Semitic (Aramaic) charms against child-stealing, and the frequency of these tales, both oral and written, in the Balkans. Per a folk incantation recorded from "the mouth of the peasants of Roumania", Gaster described Samca as Avezuha, the "wing of Satan".

statement.id: Samca dideskripsikan pada 1900 oleh Rabbi Moses Gaster, yang mencatat kemiripan jimat Kristen (Rumania, Yunani, Slavonik) dan Semit (Aram) melawan pencurian anak serta seringnya kisah ini di Balkan; berdasarkan mantra rakyat dari "mulut para petani Rumania", Gaster menyebut Samca sebagai Avezuha, "sayap Setan".
statement.en: Samca was described in 1900 by Rabbi Moses Gaster, who noted the similarity of Christian (Romanian, Greek, Slavonic) and Semitic (Aramaic) charms against child-stealing and how common these tales were in the Balkans; from a folk incantation recorded "from the mouth of the peasants of Roumania", Gaster called Samca Avezuha, the "wing of Satan".

claims.quote: Samca este un personaj al legendelor românești, un spirit necurat, foarte urât și fioros

statement.id: Artikel Rumania menyebut Samca sebagai tokoh legenda Rumania, roh najis yang sangat buruk rupa dan ganas.
statement.en: The Romanian article calls Samca a figure of Romanian legends, an unclean spirit, very ugly and fierce.

claims.quote: În tradiție ea este de asemenea asociată în mai multe legende cu Sfârșitul Lumii, cu hedonismul, sexul și plăcerile carnale. Ea le apărea în vis tinerilor miri în încercarea de a-i face să păcătuiască și să își însele proaspetele neveste.

statement.id: Dalam tradisi ia juga dikaitkan dalam beberapa legenda dengan Akhir Dunia, hedonisme, seks, dan kenikmatan jasmani, dan muncul dalam mimpi para pengantin pria muda untuk membujuk mereka berdosa dan mengkhianati istri baru mereka.
statement.en: In tradition she is also linked in several legends with the End of the World, hedonism, sex and carnal pleasures, appearing in the dreams of young bridegrooms to tempt them to sin and betray their new wives.

claims.quote: In 2022, Hamilton Fringe Festival's new play contest was won by playwrights Natalia Bushnik and Kathleen Welch for their play, Samca, which used the mythology of Samca attacking pregnant women as a metaphor for abortion.

statement.id: Pada 2022 lomba naskah baru Hamilton Fringe Festival dimenangkan Natalia Bushnik dan Kathleen Welch lewat drama Samca, yang memakai mitos Samca menyerang perempuan hamil sebagai metafora aborsi.
statement.en: In 2022 the Hamilton Fringe Festival new play contest was won by Natalia Bushnik and Kathleen Welch with their play Samca, which used the myth of Samca attacking pregnant women as a metaphor for abortion.
