short_description.id: Wulver adalah makhluk berkepala serigala dari cerita rakyat Shetland yang baik hati, suka memancing, dan meninggalkan ikan bagi orang miskin, meski asal-usulnya diperdebatkan.
short_description.en: The wulver is a kindly wolf-headed being of Shetland folklore who loves fishing and leaves fish for the poor, though its origin is disputed.

long_description.id: Wulver adalah makhluk Kepulauan Shetland berwujud lelaki berkepala serigala dan berbulu cokelat pendek, yang tinggal di gua di lereng bukit. Menurut Jessie Saxby ia baik hati, ramah kepada warga, dan memancing berjam-jam dari batu yang disebut Wulver's Stane, lalu meninggalkan ikan di jendela orang miskin; kisah lain menyebutnya buas bila diusik.
long_description.en: The wulver is a being of the Shetland Islands, a man with a wolf's head and short brown hair who lives in a cave on a hillside. According to Jessie Saxby it is kindly and friendly to locals, fishing for hours from a rock called the Wulver's Stane and leaving fish on poor people's windowsills; other accounts say it turns violent if provoked.

long_description.id: Asal-usulnya diperdebatkan: Susan Schoon Eberly menduga kisah ini berasal dari orang dengan penyakit seperti sindrom Hunter, sedangkan Brian Smith dari Shetland Museum menganggapnya rekaan Saxby sendiri.
long_description.en: Its origin is disputed: Susan Schoon Eberly suggests the tale arose from people with conditions such as Hunter syndrome, while Brian Smith of the Shetland Museum considers it Saxby's own invention.

famous_for.en: The Wulver's Stane.

description.id: Batu di air dalam tempat wulver memancing.
description.en: The rock in deep water where the wulver fished.

claims.quote: The wulver or wullver is a kind of wolf-like humanoid creature in the folklore of the Shetland Islands of Scotland.  In modern times, the origin of the wulver has been disputed.

statement.id: Wulver atau wullver adalah makhluk mirip manusia berwujud serigala dalam cerita rakyat Kepulauan Shetland, Skotlandia, yang asal-usulnya kini diperdebatkan.
statement.en: The wulver or wullver is a wolf-like humanoid of the folklore of the Shetland Islands of Scotland, whose origin is now disputed.

claims.quote: The wulver is said by the Shetland folklorist Jessie Saxby to be benevolent, although later accounts state that they became violent if provoked. They were generally friendly to locals, however, and were known to share the fish they caught with them.

statement.id: Menurut folkloris Shetland Jessie Saxby, wulver baik hati, meski kisah lain menyebutnya menjadi buas bila diusik; mereka umumnya ramah kepada warga dan berbagi ikan tangkapannya.
statement.en: The Shetland folklorist Jessie Saxby calls the wulver benevolent, though later accounts say it turned violent if provoked; wulvers were usually friendly to locals and shared the fish they caught.

claims.quote: The Wulver was a creature like a man with a wolf's head. He had short brown hair all over him. His home was a cave dug out of the side of a steep knowe, half-way up a hill.

statement.id: Saxby menulis bahwa wulver seperti lelaki berkepala serigala, berbulu cokelat pendek di seluruh tubuh, dan tinggal di gua di lereng bukit yang curam.
statement.en: Saxby wrote that the wulver was like a man with a wolf's head, covered in short brown hair, living in a cave dug into a steep knoll halfway up a hill.

claims.quote: He was fond of catching and eating fish, and had a small rock in the deep water which is known to this day as the "Wulver's Stane". There he would sit fishing sillaks and piltaks for hour after hour. He was reported to have frequently left a few fish on the window-sill of some poor body.

statement.id: Ia suka menangkap dan memakan ikan dari batu kecil di air dalam yang sampai kini disebut Wulver's Stane, dan sering meninggalkan beberapa ekor ikan di ambang jendela orang miskin.
statement.en: He liked catching and eating fish from a little rock in deep water still called the Wulver's Stane, and often left a few fish on a poor person's windowsill.

claims.quote: Susan Schoon Eberly, has speculated that the tale of the wulver may have its basis in humans suffering a medical condition; possibly Hunter syndrome or lycanthropy, she suggests.

statement.id: Susan Schoon Eberly menduga kisah wulver mungkin berasal dari manusia yang menderita penyakit, mungkin sindrom Hunter atau likantropi.
statement.en: Susan Schoon Eberly has speculated the wulver tale may come from people with a medical condition, perhaps Hunter syndrome or lycanthropy.

claims.quote: Others, such as the Shetland Museum archivist Brian Smith, argue that the wulver is an entirely fictitious creation that was never part of Shetland folklore, contending the creature is solely the creation of Saxby.

statement.id: Yang lain, seperti arsiparis Shetland Museum Brian Smith, berpendapat wulver sepenuhnya rekaan Saxby dan tidak pernah menjadi bagian cerita rakyat Shetland.

short_description.id: Wyvern adalah naga berkaki dua dan bersayap dua dari heraldik dan cerita rakyat Eropa, jarang menyemburkan api, yang namanya berasal dari kata Latin untuk ular berbisa.
short_description.en: The wyvern is a two-legged, two-winged dragon of heraldry and folklore, rarely fire-breathing, whose name comes from the Latin for viper.

long_description.id: Wyvern atau wivern adalah naga berkaki dua, bersayap dua, dan sering berekor runcing, penting dalam heraldik dan kini menjadi maskot sekolah dan tim olahraga. Berbeda dari naga lain, ia jarang menyemburkan api, meski menurut artikel bahasa Indonesia bergantung budayanya ia bisa menyemburkan api atau berbisa; ada pula wivern laut berekor sirip ikan. Membedakan naga berkaki dua sebagai wyvern adalah kekhasan Inggris.
long_description.en: The wyvern or wivern is a dragon with two legs, two wings and often a pointed tail, important in heraldry and now a mascot of schools and sports teams. Unlike other dragons it rarely breathes fire, though the Indonesian article says by culture it may breathe fire or carry venom; there is also a fish-tailed sea-wyvern. Distinguishing the two-legged dragon as a wyvern is a peculiarity of Britain.

long_description.id: Menurut Oxford English Dictionary, namanya dari bahasa Inggris Pertengahan wyver, Anglo-Prancis wivre, dan Latin vīpera, "ular berbisa"; akhiran -n muncul pada abad ke-17, seperti dalam gambaran John Guillim tahun 1610. William Sayers mengusulkan bahwa konsep ular terbang lahir dari perpaduan "ular berbisa" dan "lembing ringan". Konsep ular bersayap sudah ada sejak dewi Wadjet di Mesir.
long_description.en: Per the Oxford English Dictionary, the name runs from Middle English wyver and Anglo-French wivre to Latin vīpera, 'viper'; the final -n appeared in the 17th century, as in John Guillim's 1610 description. William Sayers suggests the flying snake was born of a blend of 'venomous snake' and 'light javelin'. Winged snakes go back to the Egyptian goddess Wadjet.

famous_for.en: School and sports mascot.

note.en: The French counterpart from the same root.

statement.en: The wyvern or wivern is a kind of mythical dragon with two legs, two wings and often a pointed tail.

claims.quote: The wyvern in its various forms is important in heraldry, frequently appearing as a mascot of schools and athletic teams (chiefly in the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada).

statement.id: Wyvern penting dalam heraldik dan sering menjadi maskot sekolah dan tim olahraga, terutama di Amerika Serikat, Britania Raya, dan Kanada.
statement.en: The wyvern is important in heraldry and often a mascot of schools and sports teams, mainly in the United States, United Kingdom and Canada.

statement.id: Berbeda dari naga lain, wyvern dalam heraldik dan cerita rakyat jarang menyemburkan api.
statement.en: Unlike other dragons, the wyvern of heraldry and folklore rarely breathes fire.

claims.quote: According to the Oxford English Dictionary, the word is a development of Middle English wyver (attested fourteenth century), from Anglo-French wivre (compare French: vouivre and guivre), which originate from Latin: vīpera, meaning "viper", "adder", or "asp".

statement.id: Menurut Oxford English Dictionary, kata ini berkembang dari bahasa Inggris Pertengahan wyver (abad ke-14), dari bahasa Anglo-Prancis wivre (bandingkan vouivre dan guivre), yang berasal dari bahasa Latin vīpera, "ular berbisa".
statement.en: According to the Oxford English Dictionary, the word developed from Middle English wyver (14th century), from Anglo-French wivre (compare vouivre and guivre), from Latin vīpera, 'viper'.

claims.quote: The concluding "–n" had been added by the beginning of the 17th century, when John Guillim in 1610 describes the "wiverne" as a creature that "partake[s] of a Fowle in the Wings and Legs ... and doth resemble a Serpent in the Taile".

statement.id: Akhiran -n sudah ditambahkan pada awal abad ke-17, ketika John Guillim pada 1610 menggambarkan "wiverne" sebagai makhluk bersayap dan berkaki burung dengan ekor seperti ular.
statement.en: The final -n was added by the early 17th century, when John Guillim in 1610 described the 'wiverne' as having a fowl's wings and legs and a serpent's tail.

claims.quote: By noting physical resemblances between the javelins and snakes, he proposed that the images of "venomous snake" and "light javelin" were melded to produce the novel concept of a flying snake.

statement.id: Medievalis William Sayers mengusulkan bahwa gambaran "ular berbisa" dan "lembing ringan" (guivre) berpadu menjadi konsep baru ular terbang.
statement.en: The medievalist William Sayers proposed that the images of 'venomous snake' and 'light javelin' (guivre) merged into the new idea of a flying snake.

claims.quote: The Egyptian goddess Wadjet, depicted as a winged cobra or uraeus, exemplifies this tradition and served as a protective deity of Lower Egypt from the Predynastic period onwards.

statement.en: Winged snakes appear across ancient Mediterranean and Near Eastern cultures, for example the Egyptian goddess Wadjet, a winged cobra protecting Lower Egypt from Predynastic times.

short_description.id: Xeglun adalah rusa besar langit dalam mitologi Tungusic yang perburuannya oleh Mangi dipercaya menciptakan galaksi Bima Sakti.
short_description.en: Xeglun is the celestial elk in Tungusic mythology whose pursuit by Mangi was said to have created the Milky Way.

long_description.id: Dalam kosmologi Tungusic, Xeglun diyakini sebagai rusa besar surgawi yang melintasi kubah angkasa. Legenda menuturkan bahwa pengejaran terhadap makhluk langit ini oleh sosok Mangi atau Xargi meninggalkan jejak kosmis yang kemudian membentuk formasi galaksi Bima Sakti atau Milky Way.
long_description.en: In Tungusic cosmology, Xeglun is held to be a celestial elk traversing the heavens. Lore recounts that the pursuit of this creature across the sky by Mangi or Xargi left a cosmic trail forming the Milky Way.

short_description.id: Xiuhcōātl adalah ular api dalam agama Aztek, wujud roh dewa api Xiuhtecuhtli dan senjata Huitzilopochtli; namanya berarti "ular pirus".
short_description.en: Xiuhcōātl is the fire serpent of Aztec religion, the spirit form of the fire god Xiuhtecuhtli and a weapon of Huitzilopochtli; its name means "turquoise serpent".

long_description.id: Dalam agama Aztek, Xiuhcōātl adalah ular mitologis, wujud roh dewa api Xiuhtecuhtli, yang kadang digambarkan sebagai atlatl atau senjata Huitzilopochtli. Namanya dalam bahasa Nahuatl berarti "ular pirus" dan secara simbolis "ular api". Ia ditafsirkan sebagai perwujudan musim kemarau dan senjata matahari; dalam kisah kelahiran Huitzilopochtli, sang dewa bertempur dengan perisai, tombak lempar, dan Xiuhcoatl.
long_description.en: In Aztec religion Xiuhcōātl was a mythological serpent, the spirit form of the fire god Xiuhtecuhtli, sometimes shown as an atlatl or weapon of Huitzilopochtli. Its Nahuatl name means "turquoise serpent" and symbolically "fire serpent". It is read as the embodiment of the dry season and the weapon of the sun; in the birth story of Huitzilopochtli, the god fights with shield, darts and Xiuhcoatl.

long_description.id: Xiuhcoatl sering muncul dalam seni dan kodeks Aztek, biasanya dengan moncong melengkung ke belakang dan tubuh beruas-ruas yang dililit pita kertas bersimpul, lambang persembahan darah. Ia juga menjadi hiasan punggung pada gambar Xiuhtecuhtli dan Huitzilopochtli, dan mahkota kaisar Aztek tampaknya melambangkan ekornya.
long_description.en: Xiuhcoatl was common in Aztec art and codices, usually with a back-turned snout and a segmented body wrapped in knotted paper strips, a sign of blood offering. It appears as a back ornament on images of Xiuhtecuhtli and Huitzilopochtli, and the Aztec emperors' diadem apparently represented its tail.

role.en: The weapon of Huitzilopochtli and the sun.

famous_for.en: The back ornament of Aztec gods.

did_you_know.en: The Aztec emperors' diadem apparently represented Xiuhcoatl's tail.

short_description.id: Yekyua atau "hewan induk" adalah roh pendamping berwujud hewan yang melindungi dukun Yakut, dan nasib dukun terikat pada hewannya.
short_description.en: A yekyua or "mother animal" is an animal-shaped familiar spirit protecting Yakut shamans, whose fate is bound to their animal.

long_description.id: Dalam kepercayaan Yakut, yekyua atau "hewan induk" adalah golongan roh yang bersembunyi sampai salju mencair pada musim semi. Setiap yekyua terkait dengan seekor hewan dan menjadi roh pendamping yang melindungi dukun; yang paling berbahaya melekat pada dukun perempuan. Hanya dukun yang dapat melihatnya.
long_description.en: In Yakut belief a yekyua or "mother animal" is a class of spirit that hides until the snow melts in spring. Each yekyua is tied to an animal and acts as a familiar that protects a shaman; the most dangerous belong to female shamans. Only shamans can see them.

long_description.id: Jenis hewan menentukan kekuatannya: yekyua anjing lemah, yekyua rusa elk kuat, dan yang terkuat adalah mamut. Nasib dukun terikat pada hewannya: saat para yekyua bertarung pada musim semi dukunnya jatuh sakit, dan bila hewannya dibunuh dukun lain, ia pun meninggal.
long_description.en: The animal decides its strength: dog yekyua are weak, elk yekyua strong, and the mammoth strongest. A shaman's fate is bound to the animal: when yekyua fight in spring their shamans fall ill, and if the animal is killed by another shaman, its shaman dies.

famous_for.en: The shaman's fate tied to the animal.

did_you_know.en: The strongest yekyua is said to be a mammoth.

short_description.id: Yelbeghen adalah monster pemakan manusia berkepala banyak dalam mitologi bangsa Turkik Siberia, awalnya naga lalu raksasa, yang dalam legenda Altai memangsa Matahari dan Bulan.
short_description.en: Yelbeghen is a many-headed man-eating monster in the mythology of the Turkic peoples of Siberia, first a dragon and later an ogre, that in an Altai legend devours the Sun and Moon.

long_description.id: Yelbeghen adalah monster pemakan manusia berkepala banyak dalam mitologi bangsa Turkik Siberia. Dalam mitos aslinya ia naga atau makhluk mirip ular, tetapi lama-kelamaan menjadi raksasa berkepala banyak; sebagian mitos menggambarkannya sebagai naga bersayap atau raksasa yang menunggang lembu bertanduk 99.
long_description.en: Yelbeghen is a many-headed man-eating monster of the mythology of the Turkic peoples of Siberia. In the original myths it was a dragon or serpent-like creature, but over time it became a many-headed ogre; some myths describe a winged dragon or an ogre riding an ox with 99 horns.

long_description.id: Beberapa epos menampilkan banyak Yelbegen, keturunan Altan Sibaldai, "penyihir emas" pengikut penguasa dunia bawah, termasuk seorang raja bernama Yelmogus. short_description.id: Ysgithyrwyn, "Si Taring Putih kepala para babi hutan", adalah babi hutan yang diburu rombongan Arthur dalam roman Welsh Culhwch ac Olwen.
short_description.en: Ysgithyrwyn, 'White-tusk chief of Boars', is a boar hunted by Arthur's band in the Welsh romance Culhwch ac Olwen.

long_description.id: Ysgithyrwyn Penbaedd, atau "Si Taring Putih kepala para babi hutan", adalah babi hutan lain yang diburu rombongan Arthur dalam roman Arthurian Welsh Culhwch ac Olwen, di samping babi hutan besar Twrch Trwyth. Taringnya (Welsh: ysgithyr) adalah alat yang diperlukan untuk mencukur raksasa Ysbaddaden, kepala para raksasa. Ysbaddaden menyatakan taring itu tak berguna kecuali dicabut selagi babi itu masih hidup, dan hanya Odgar putra Aedd, raja Irlandia, yang mampu melakukannya.
long_description.en: Ysgithyrwyn Penbaedd, the 'White-tusk chief of Boars', is a second boar hunted by Arthur's party in the Welsh Arthurian romance Culhwch ac Olwen, alongside the great boar Twrch Trwyth. Its tusk (Welsh ysgithyr) was the tool needed to shave the giant Ysbaddaden, chief of giants. Ysbaddaden declared the tusk useless unless pulled from the boar while it still lived, and only Odgar son of Aedd, king of Ireland, could do this.

long_description.id: Babi itu dibunuh, atau setidaknya dikejar hingga terpojok, bukan oleh anjing-anjing yang disebut Ysbaddaden melainkan oleh Cavall, anjing Arthur sendiri. Sebenarnya Kaw dari Britania Utara, menunggang kuda betina Arthur Llamrei, mengayunkan kapak dan membelah kepala babi itu, lalu mengambil taringnya sesuai sumpah Arthur. Artikel de menyebut babi dan babi jantan sebagai hewan penting bagi bangsa Kelt dan sering memicu perang dalam Mabinogion.
long_description.en: The boar was killed, or at least run down and cornered, not by the dogs Ysbaddaden had named but by Cavall, Arthur's own hound. In fact Kaw of North Britain, riding Arthur's mare Llamrei, swung an axe and split its head, then took charge of the tusk as Arthur had vowed. The de article notes that pigs and boars were key animals for the Celts and often set off wars in the Mabinogion.

short_description.id: Yuxa adalah ular tua dalam mitologi Turkik yang berubah menjadi makhluk berkepala naga dan dapat menjelma gadis cantik untuk menikahi lelaki.
short_description.en: Yuxa is an aged snake of Turkic mythology that becomes a dragon-headed creature and can take the form of a beautiful maiden to marry men.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Turkik, Yuxa adalah makhluk berkepala naga, bertubuh reptil, dan berekor berduri, yang konon menyemburkan api atau bergigitan berbisa. Menurut kepercayaan rakyat, ular berusia 100 tahun berubah menjadi Yuxa; versi Bashkir dan Tatar menyebut ajdaha yang hidup 500 hingga 1000 tahun. Dalam dongeng ia menjelma gadis cantik yang menikahi lelaki, dan ia juga bisa menjadi pemuda tampan untuk menggoda atau menakuti orang.
long_description.en: In Turkic mythology Yuxa is a dragon-headed, reptile-bodied creature with a barbed tail, said to breathe fire or bite venomously. Popular belief holds that a 100-year-old snake becomes a Yuxa; Bashkir and Tatar versions speak of an ajdaha that lives 500 to 1000 years. In fairy tales it becomes a beautiful maiden who marries men, and it can also become a handsome youth to seduce or frighten people.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Bashkir dan Tatar, Yuxa adalah iblis jahat yang terkait dengan air dan muncul dalam dongeng serta epos Ural-batyr. Bahasa Bashkir masih menyimpan ungkapan seperti yukha yylan untuk orang licik.
long_description.en: In Bashkir and Tatar mythology Yuxa is an evil demon linked with water, appearing in fairy tales and the epic Ural-batyr. Bashkir still uses phrases like yukha yylan for a treacherous person.

short_description.id: Žaltys ("ular rumput") adalah roh rumah dalam mitologi Lituania, binatang suci dewi matahari Saulė, penjaga rumah dan lambang kesuburan.
short_description.en: The žaltys ("grass snake") is a household spirit of Lithuanian mythology, sacred animal of the sun goddess Saulė, guardian of the home and symbol of fertility.

long_description.id: Žaltys, harfiah "ular rumput", adalah roh rumah dalam mitologi Lituania. Ia binatang suci dewi matahari Saulė dan dianggap penjaga rumah serta lambang kesuburan. Orang memeliharanya di dekat tungku atau tempat khusus di rumah, percaya ia membawa panen baik dan kekayaan; membunuhnya dipercaya mendatangkan malapetaka besar. Bila ditemukan di ladang, ia diberi susu agar mau menjadi hewan rumah yang suci.
long_description.en: The žaltys, literally "grass snake", is a house spirit of Lithuanian myth. It is the sacred animal of the sun goddess Saulė and was seen as guardian of the home and a sign of fertility. People kept it by the stove or in a special corner, trusting it to bring good harvests and wealth; killing one was thought to bring great disaster. One found in a field was offered milk to win it over as a sacred house pet.

long_description.id: Dalam satu kisah, gadis bernama Eglė menemukan žaltys di pakaiannya setelah mandi di danau; ular itu berjanji mengembalikan pakaiannya bila Eglė mau menikahinya. Ia ternyata Žilvinas, Raja Ular Rumput, yang menjelma pemuda tampan dan membawa Eglė ke rumahnya di bawah laut. Dalam mitologi Latvia dan Lituania, žaltys juga pelindung ternak dan utusan para dewa; ada pepatah Lituania, "Melihat ular rumput mati, Matahari pun menangis".
long_description.en: In one story a girl named Eglė finds a žaltys in her clothes after bathing in a lake; it promises to return them if she marries it. It turns out to be Žilvinas, King of the Grass Snakes, who becomes a handsome young man and takes her to his home under the sea. In Latvian and Lithuanian myth the žaltys also protects cattle and is a messenger of the gods; a Lithuanian proverb says that even the Sun weeps at the sight of a dead grass snake.

short_description.id: Zhytsen adalah roh ladang gandum hitam dalam mitologi Belarus, kakek kecil bermata tiga yang menjaga panen dan memindahkan bulir yang tertinggal ke ladang petani rajin.
short_description.en: Zhytsen is the rye-field spirit of Belarusian mythology, a little three-eyed old man who guards the harvest and moves leftover grain to diligent farmers' fields.

long_description.id: Zhytsen adalah makhluk baik dalam mitologi Belarus yang tinggal di ladang; namanya berarti "makhluk gandum hitam". Ia disebut roh kekayaan dan kesejahteraan yang membantu tanaman matang dan menjaga panen. Ia dibayangkan sebagai kakek kecil berjanggut panjang, "Kakek Gandum Hitam", dengan mata ketiga di tengkuk.
long_description.en: Zhytsen is a benevolent being of Belarusian mythology that lives in the fields; its name means "rye creature". It is called a spirit of wealth and wellbeing that helps crops ripen and cares for the harvest. It was imagined as a little long-bearded old man, the "Rye Grandfather", with a third eye on the back of its head.

long_description.id: Zhytsen berjalan melintasi ladang memastikan panen dituai dengan baik, dan bulir yang ditinggalkan petani ceroboh ia ikat menjadi berkas lalu bawa ke ladang petani yang lebih rajin. Sosoknya masih muncul dalam ungkapan "Zhytsen memberi roti". Namun sebagai dewa kesuburan Belarus kuno, ia digambarkan dan kemungkinan dikarang oleh folkloris Pavel Shpilevsky.
long_description.en: Zhytsen walks the fields making sure crops are well reaped, and the grain left by careless farmers it binds into sheaves and carries to the fields of more diligent ones. The figure still appears in the saying "Zhytsen gave bread". As an ancient Belarusian fertility god, however, it was described and probably invented by the folklorist Pavel Shpilevsky.

claims.quote: is a positive creature from Belarusian mythology said to live in fields. The name literally means "rye creature", from Belarusian жыта, "rye".

statement.id: Zhytsen atau Žycień adalah makhluk baik dalam mitologi Belarus yang konon tinggal di ladang; namanya secara harfiah berarti "makhluk gandum hitam", dari kata Belarus zhyta, "gandum hitam".
statement.en: Zhytsen or Žycień is a benevolent creature of Belarusian mythology said to live in fields; the name literally means "rye creature", from Belarusian zhyta, "rye".

claims.quote: Zhyten is often called a spirit of wealth and wellbeing. It is believed that Zhytsen contributes to good ripening of crops and vegetables, and accordingly, Zhyten is considered the caretaker of good harvests.

statement.id: Zhytsen sering disebut roh kekayaan dan kesejahteraan; ia dipercaya membantu tanaman dan sayuran matang dengan baik, sehingga dianggap pengurus panen yang baik.
statement.en: Zhytsen is often called a spirit of wealth and wellbeing; it is believed to help crops and vegetables ripen well and so is considered the caretaker of good harvests.

claims.quote: Zhytsen walks through the fields and ensures that crops there are well reaped. It is believed in Belarusian folklore that if Zhytsen finds some left ears of grain, it binds them in sheaves and brings to the fields of more diligent farmers.

statement.id: Zhytsen berjalan melintasi ladang memastikan panen dituai dengan baik; dalam folklor Belarus dipercaya bila ia menemukan bulir yang tertinggal, ia mengikatnya menjadi berkas dan membawanya ke ladang petani yang lebih rajin.
statement.en: Zhytsen walks the fields making sure the crops are well reaped; Belarusian folklore holds that if it finds ears of grain left behind, it binds them into sheaves and carries them to the fields of more diligent farmers.

claims.quote: Как древнебелорусский бог плодородия и осени описан (и, вероятно, придуман) фольклористом Павлом Шпилевским (Древлянским).

statement.id: Sebagai dewa kesuburan dan musim gugur Belarus kuno, Zhytsen digambarkan, dan kemungkinan dikarang, oleh folkloris Pavel Shpilevsky (Drevlyansky).
statement.en: As an ancient Belarusian god of fertility and autumn, Zhytsen was described, and probably invented, by the folklorist Pavel Shpilevsky (Drevlyansky).

claims.quote: Особенностью Житеня является третий глаз на затылке, который нужен для лучшего выполнения задач этого мифологического персонажа.

statement.id: Ciri khas Zhytsen adalah mata ketiga di tengkuk, yang membantunya menjalankan tugasnya dengan lebih baik.
statement.en: A peculiarity of Zhytsen is a third eye on the back of the head, which helps it do its work better.

short_description.id: Zilant adalah ular bersayap legendaris dalam mitologi Tatar, di antara naga dan wyvern, yang sejak 1730 menjadi lambang resmi kota Kazan.
short_description.en: Zilant is a legendary winged snake of Tatar mythology, between a dragon and a wyvern, and since 1730 the official symbol of Kazan.

long_description.id: Zilant adalah makhluk legendaris di antara naga dan wyvern dalam mitologi Tatar; namanya berasal dari kata Tatar yılan, "ular". Ia digambarkan sebagai ular bersayap dengan bagian depan seekor naga, dan termasuk cerita rakyat Tatar dan Rusia. Orang Tatar menganggapnya makhluk menjijikkan, dan menurut kepercayaan Idel-Ural ular yang hidup 100 tahun akan berubah menjadi ajdaha. Ia berbeda dari Aq Yılan, raja para ular.
long_description.en: Zilant is a legendary creature between a dragon and a wyvern in Tatar mythology; its name comes from Tatar yılan, "snake". It is described as a winged snake with the forepart of a dragon and belongs to Tatar and Russian folklore. Tatars saw it as repulsive, and in Idel-Ural belief a snake that lives 100 years becomes an ajdaha. It is distinct from Aq Yılan, king of the snakes.

long_description.id: Ular bersayap ini disebut dalam legenda pendirian Kazan dan sejak 1730 menjadi lambang resmi kota itu, ibu kota Tatarstan di Rusia. Meski posturnya mirip burung, ia berbeda dari basilisk karena berkepala naga.
long_description.en: This winged snake appears in the legends of Kazan's founding and since 1730 has been the official symbol of the city, capital of Tatarstan in Russia. Despite its bird-like stance it differs from the basilisk in having a dragon's head.

short_description.id: Zitiron atau sea knight adalah makhluk mitologi laut abad pertengahan berwujud kesatria bersenjata dengan ekor ikan.
short_description.en: A zitiron or sea knight is a medieval marine creature with the upper body of an armed knight and the tail of a fish.

long_description.id: Zitiron atau zytiron, juga dikenal sebagai sea knight, merupakan makhluk hibrida lautan pada era Moyen Âge dengan tubuh bagian atas berupa kesatria lengkap berbaju zirah dan bagian bawah berekor ikan. Makhluk ini tercatat dalam karya De natura rerum gubahan Thomas de Cantimpré sekitar tahun 1240, serta diadaptasi oleh Jacob van Maerlant dalam Der Naturen Bloeme pada tahun 1350.
long_description.en: A zitiron or zytiron, known as a sea knight, is a marine hybrid of the Moyen Âge having the upper body of an armed knight and a fish tail. It appears in Thomas de Cantimpré's De natura rerum circa 1240 and Jacob van Maerlant's Der Naturen Bloeme in 1350.

long_description.id: Makhluk ini juga dibahas dalam risalah Hortus sanitatis tahun 1491. Tubuhnya memiliki kulit tebal dan kasar, membawa perisai, serta memiliki lengan kokoh dengan dua jari. Konon zitiron kebal terhadap anak panah dan hanya dapat ditaklukkan menggunakan palu.
long_description.en: The creature is featured in the 1491 text Hortus sanitatis. It possesses rough, hard skin, bears a shield, and has thick arms with only two fingers. Lore states it cannot be slain by arrows, only by hammers.

short_description.id: Zmei ("ular") adalah bentuk naga dalam dongeng dan epos Rusia, kadang tokoh mirip manusia bersifat naga; yang terkenal antara lain Gorynych dan Tugarin.
short_description.en: Zmei ("serpent") is a form of dragon in Russian folk tales and epics, sometimes a human-like figure with dragon traits; famous ones include Gorynych and Tugarin.

long_description.id: Zmei (laki-laki) dan zmeya (perempuan), yang berarti "ular", adalah bentuk naga dalam dongeng dan epos Rusia, kadang tokoh mirip manusia yang bersifat naga. Dua zmei paling terkenal adalah Gorynych dan Tugarin, lawan para bogatyr Dobrynya Nikitich dan Alyosha Popovich. Walau berarti ular, istilah zmei untuk naga di seluruh Rusia selalu merujuk pada jenis yang terbang.
long_description.en: Zmei (masculine) and zmeya (feminine), "serpent", name a kind of dragon in Russian tales and epic songs, at times a human-like figure with dragonish traits. The best known are Gorynych and Tugarin, foes of the bogatyrs Dobrynya Nikitich and Alyosha Popovich. Though the word means serpent, across Russia zmei used of dragons always implies the flying kind.

long_description.id: Zmey Gorynych adalah naga cerita rakyat Rusia yang menculik perempuan. Ia biasanya tinggal di pegunungan, sering dekat sungai api, dan menjaga Jembatan Kalinov menuju alam orang mati. Kepala yang banyak adalah ciri tetapnya, biasanya kelipatan tiga seperti 3, 6, 9, atau 12; ia paling sering berkepala tiga, dan umumnya dapat terbang walau sayapnya jarang disebut.
long_description.en: Zmey Gorynych is a dragon of Russian folklore who carries off women. He usually lives in the mountains, often by a fiery river, and guards the Kalinov Bridge to the land of the dead. Many heads are his constant feature, usually a multiple of three such as 3, 6, 9 or 12; he is most often three-headed, and generally flies though his wings are seldom mentioned.

short_description.id: Zmeu adalah makhluk fantastis dalam cerita rakyat dan mitologi Rumania, mirip naga tetapi bersifat manusia, yang menculik gadis-gadis dan hampir selalu dikalahkan pangeran pemberani.
short_description.en: The zmeu is a fantastic creature of Romanian folklore and mythology, dragon-like yet human-like, who kidnaps young girls and is almost always defeated by a daring prince.

long_description.id: Zmeu (jamak zmei, perempuan zmeoaică) adalah makhluk fantastis dalam cerita rakyat dan mitologi Rumania. Walau sebagian sumber menyebutnya naga, zmeu berbeda karena biasanya jelas bersifat manusia: berkaki dan berlengan, membuat dan memakai senjata, menunggang kuda, dan ingin menikahi gadis muda. Ada pengulas yang menggolongkannya sebagai raksasa (setara ogre), iblis, bahkan vampir.
long_description.en: The zmeu (plural zmei, feminine zmeoaică) is a fantastic being of Romanian folk tales and myth. Some sources call it a dragon, yet it differs in being plainly human-like: it has arms and legs, makes and wields weapons, rides horses and wants to wed young girls. Commentators variously class it as a giant (an ogre), a devil or even a vampire.

long_description.id: Dalam beberapa cerita zmeu muncul di langit dan menyemburkan api atau dapat berubah wujud; dalam cerita lain ia punya batu permata ajaib di kepalanya yang bersinar seperti matahari. Ia menyukai gadis muda yang cantik dan menculiknya, biasanya untuk dinikahi, tetapi hampir selalu dikalahkan oleh pangeran atau kesatria pemberani. Dalam mitologi Rumania ia juga raksasa berkekuatan gaib, perwujudan kejahatan yang selalu kalah oleh kekuatan baik.
long_description.en: In some tales the zmeu appears in the sky spitting fire or can change shape; in others it bears a magic jewel on its head that shines like the sun. It loves beautiful young girls and carries them off, usually to marry them, but is almost always beaten by a bold prince or knight-errant. Romanian myth also makes it a giant with supernatural powers, the embodiment of evil, always overcome by the forces of good.

long_description.id: Kebanyakan sarjana sepakat istilah Rumania zmeu berasal dari kata Slavia zmey. Dalam bahasa Rumania kata zmeu juga berarti layang-layang.
long_description.en: Most scholars agree that the Romanian term zmeu comes from Slavic zmey. In Romanian the word zmeu also means a kite.

statement.id: Zmeu (jamak zmei, perempuan zmeoaică) adalah makhluk fantastis dalam cerita rakyat dan mitologi Rumania.
statement.en: The zmeu (plural zmei, feminine zmeoaică) is a fantastic creature of Romanian folklore and mythology.

claims.quote: Though referred by some sources as a dragon, the zmeu is nevertheless distinct, because it usually has clear anthropomorphic traits: it is humanoid and has legs, arms, the ability to create and use artifacts such as weapons, and to ride a horse, and has the desire to marry young girls. There are commentators that class it as a giant (equivalent of an ogre), or a devil, or even a vampire.

statement.id: Walau sebagian sumber menyebutnya naga, zmeu berbeda karena bersifat manusia: berkaki, berlengan, membuat dan memakai senjata, menunggang kuda, dan ingin menikahi gadis muda; ada pengulas yang menggolongkannya sebagai raksasa (ogre), iblis, atau vampir.
statement.en: Though some sources call it a dragon, the zmeu is distinct for its human-like traits: legs, arms, making and using weapons, riding a horse and wishing to marry young girls; some commentators class it as a giant (ogre), a devil or a vampire.

claims.quote: In some stories, Zmeu appears in the sky and spits fire, or has the ability to change form. In other stories, it has a magical precious stone on its head that shines like the sun.

statement.id: Dalam beberapa cerita zmeu muncul di langit dan menyemburkan api, atau dapat berubah wujud; dalam cerita lain ia punya batu permata ajaib di kepala yang bersinar seperti matahari.
statement.en: In some stories the zmeu appears in the sky and spits fire or can change form; in others it has a magic gem on its head shining like the sun.

claims.quote: It likes beautiful young girls, whom it kidnaps, usually for the purpose of marrying them. It is almost always defeated by a daring prince or knight-errant.

statement.id: Ia menyukai gadis muda yang cantik dan menculiknya, biasanya untuk dinikahi, dan hampir selalu dikalahkan pangeran atau kesatria pemberani.
statement.en: It likes beautiful young girls and kidnaps them, usually to marry them, and is almost always defeated by a daring prince or knight-errant.

claims.quote: Most scholars agree that the Romanian term zmeu derives from Slavic zmey.

statement.id: Kebanyakan sarjana sepakat istilah Rumania zmeu berasal dari kata Slavia zmey.
statement.en: Most scholars agree the Romanian term zmeu derives from Slavic zmey.

claims.quote: En la mitología rumana, un esmeuro o dracosmeu (en rumano zmeu) es un ser gigante con poderes sobrenaturales, encarnación del mal, pero que siempre es derrotado por las fuerzas del bien

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Rumania, zmeu adalah makhluk raksasa berkekuatan gaib, perwujudan kejahatan, yang selalu dikalahkan oleh kekuatan baik.
statement.en: In Romanian mythology the zmeu is a giant being with supernatural powers, the embodiment of evil, always defeated by the forces of good.

claims.quote: La palabra también se refiere a las cometas que vuelan los niños dado que la palabra zmeu también significa cometa en rumano.

statement.id: Kata zmeu dalam bahasa Rumania juga berarti layang-layang yang diterbangkan anak-anak.
statement.en: In Romanian the word zmeu also means the kites children fly.

claims.quote: The zmeu has also been conflated with or confused with the dracu or with the balaur type dragon. ... like Prâslea cel voinic

statement.id: Zmeu juga dikacaukan dengan dracu atau naga jenis balaur; dalam berbagai cerita ia dibunuh pangeran muda seperti Prâslea cel voinic.
statement.en: The zmeu has also been conflated with the dracu or the balaur dragon; various stories have it slain by a young prince like Prâslea cel voinic.
